nodes.summary: Partition of a UnionRDD that records which parent RDD and which partition of it this partition refers to. It refreshes the parent partition reference at task serialization time.

nodes.name: preferredLocations
nodes.summary: Delegates to the parent RDD's preferredLocations for the underlying parent partition.

nodes.name: writeObject
nodes.summary: Re-reads the parent partition from the parent RDD before default Java serialization of the task.

nodes.name: UnionRDD
nodes.summary: RDD that is the union of a sequence of RDDs: it simply appends their partitions (no shuffle) and uses one RangeDependency per parent, with no common partitioner assumed. For many parents the partitions are listed with a parallel collection and a shared fork-join pool defined in the companion.
nodes.languageNotes: Class and companion object (holding partitionEvalTaskSupport) share one node id; lineRange covers both (object 62-65, class 67-118).

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Builds one UnionPartition per partition of every parent RDD, computing partition counts in parallel when there are more RDDs than the configured threshold.

nodes.name: getDependencies
nodes.summary: Creates a RangeDependency for each parent RDD that maps its partitions to a contiguous range in the union.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Computes a union partition by iterating the corresponding parent RDD partition.

nodes.name: getPreferredLocations
nodes.summary: Returns the preferred locations of the underlying parent partition.

nodes.name: clearDependencies
nodes.summary: Clears dependencies via super and drops the reference to the parent RDD list.

nodes.name: ZippedPartitionsRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the RDDs behind zipPartitions: a base class that zips the partitions of several parent RDDs one to one, and variants for two, three and four parents that apply a user function to the iterators of corresponding partitions. All parents must have the same number of partitions.

nodes.name: ZippedPartitionsPartition
nodes.summary: Partition of a zipped RDD that holds the matching partition from each parent and the combined preferred locations; the parent partitions are refreshed when the task is serialized.

nodes.name: partitions
nodes.summary: Returns the parent partitions that are zipped together.

nodes.name: writeObject
nodes.summary: Recomputes the parent partition list from the parent RDDs before default Java serialization.

nodes.name: ZippedPartitionsBaseRDD
nodes.summary: Abstract base for zipping partitions of several RDDs with one-to-one dependencies. Its getPartitions throws IllegalArgumentException if the parents have unequal numbers of partitions, and the partitioner is the first parent's only when preservesPartitioning is set.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Requires equal partition counts across parents (else IllegalArgumentException), then builds one ZippedPartitionsPartition per index with locations that are the hosts shared by all parents or, failing that, the union of all hosts.

nodes.name: getPreferredLocations
nodes.summary: Returns the locations stored in the ZippedPartitionsPartition.

nodes.name: clearDependencies
nodes.summary: Clears dependencies via super and drops the reference to the parent RDD list.

nodes.name: ZippedPartitionsRDD2
nodes.summary: Zips the partitions of two parent RDDs by applying the function f to the iterators of the corresponding partitions, producing one RDD with the same partition count as the parents.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Takes the zipped parent partitions and calls f on the iterators of the two parent RDDs.

nodes.name: ZippedPartitionsRDD3
nodes.summary: Zips the partitions of three parent RDDs by applying the function f to the iterators of the corresponding partitions, producing one RDD with the same partition count as the parents.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Takes the zipped parent partitions and calls f on the iterators of the three parent RDDs.

nodes.name: ZippedPartitionsRDD4
nodes.summary: Zips the partitions of four parent RDDs by applying the function f to the iterators of the corresponding partitions, producing one RDD with the same partition count as the parents.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Takes the zipped parent partitions and calls f on the iterators of the four parent RDDs.

nodes.name: BlockId.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the sealed BlockId hierarchy that names every block Spark stores or ships (RDD partitions, shuffle data/index/checksum/merged files, broadcasts, task results, streaming input, Python worker logs, temp files, cache ids) plus the BlockId.apply parser from a string name back to a typed id. Each subclass builds its unique string name from its keys.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala sealed abstract class with many case-class subtypes and a companion object holding regexes used by BlockId.apply for name parsing.

nodes.name: BlockId
nodes.summary: Sealed abstract base class (DeveloperApi) identifying a Block of data, usually backed by a single file; each subtype has its own keys and produces a globally unique string name usable for ser/de. Provides helper predicates isRDD, isShuffle, isShuffleChunk, isBroadcast and asRDDId. The companion object BlockId (lines 264-337) holds the name regexes and the apply(name) parser.

nodes.name: RDDBlockId
nodes.summary: Block id of one cached RDD partition (rddId, splitIndex); its name is "rdd_<rddId>_<splitIndex>".

nodes.name: ShuffleBlockId
nodes.summary: Block id of one shuffle block (shuffleId, mapId, reduceId); its name is "shuffle_<shuffleId>_<mapId>_<reduceId>". The comment notes the format must stay in sync with ExternalShuffleBlockResolver#getBlockData().

nodes.name: ShuffleBlockBatchId
nodes.summary: Id for a batch of continuous shuffle blocks of the same mapId in the range [startReduceId, endReduceId); its name is "shuffle_<shuffleId>_<mapId>_<startReduceId>_<endReduceId>".

nodes.name: ShuffleBlockChunkId
nodes.summary: Since 3.2.0. Id of a chunk of merged shuffle data (shuffleId, shuffleMergeId, reduceId, chunkId); its name is "shuffleChunk_<shuffleId>_<shuffleMergeId>_<reduceId>_<chunkId>".

nodes.name: ShuffleDataBlockId
nodes.summary: Block id of a shuffle data file; its name is the shuffle block name plus the ".data" suffix, i.e. "shuffle_<shuffleId>_<mapId>_<reduceId>.data".

nodes.name: ShuffleIndexBlockId
nodes.summary: Block id of a shuffle index file; its name is the shuffle block name plus the ".index" suffix, i.e. "shuffle_<shuffleId>_<mapId>_<reduceId>.index".

nodes.name: ShuffleChecksumBlockId
nodes.summary: Since 3.2.0. Block id of a shuffle checksum file; its name is the shuffle block name plus the ".checksum" suffix.

nodes.name: ShufflePushBlockId
nodes.summary: Since 3.2.0. Id of a pushed shuffle block (shuffleId, shuffleMergeId, mapIndex, reduceId); its name is "shufflePush_<shuffleId>_<shuffleMergeId>_<mapIndex>_<reduceId>".

nodes.name: ShuffleMergedBlockId
nodes.summary: Since 3.2.0. Id of a merged shuffle block (shuffleId, shuffleMergeId, reduceId); its name is "shuffleMerged_<shuffleId>_<shuffleMergeId>_<reduceId>".

nodes.name: ShuffleMergedDataBlockId
nodes.summary: Since 3.2.0. Id of the merged shuffle data file for an application; its name starts with RemoteBlockPushResolver.MERGED_SHUFFLE_FILE_NAME_PREFIX followed by appId, shuffleId, shuffleMergeId, reduceId and the ".data" suffix.

nodes.name: ShuffleMergedIndexBlockId
nodes.summary: Since 3.2.0. Id of the merged shuffle index file for an application; same naming as the merged data id but with the ".index" suffix.

nodes.name: ShuffleMergedMetaBlockId
nodes.summary: Since 3.2.0. Id of the merged shuffle meta file for an application; same naming as the merged data id but with the ".meta" suffix.

nodes.name: BroadcastBlockId
nodes.summary: Block id of a broadcast variable (broadcastId, optional field); its name is "broadcast_<broadcastId>" with "_<field>" appended when field is non-empty.

nodes.name: TaskResultBlockId
nodes.summary: Block id for a task result (taskId); its name is "taskresult_<taskId>".

nodes.name: StreamBlockId
nodes.summary: Block id of a stream input block (streamId, uniqueId); its name is "input-<streamId>-<uniqueId>".

nodes.name: PythonStreamBlockId
nodes.summary: Block id of a Python stream block (streamId, uniqueId); its name is "python-stream-<streamId>-<uniqueId>".

nodes.name: LogBlockType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of log block kinds: TEST and PYTHON_WORKER. LogBlockId.empty switches on it to build a placeholder log block id.

nodes.name: LogBlockId
nodes.summary: Abstract sealed BlockId for blocks of log data, carrying lastLogTime (timestamp of the last log entry, used for filtering and log management), executorId and a logBlockType. Its companion object offers LogBlockId.empty(logBlockType).

nodes.name: TestLogBlockId
nodes.summary: Test-only LogBlockId (lastLogTime, executorId) of type TEST; its name is "test_log_<lastLogTime>_<executorId>".

nodes.name: PythonWorkerLogBlockId
nodes.summary: LogBlockId for Python worker logs (lastLogTime, executorId, sessionId, workerId) of type PYTHON_WORKER; its name is "python_worker_log_<lastLogTime>_<executorId>_<sessionId>_<workerId>". sessionId isolates logs and workerId distinguishes the Python worker process.

nodes.name: TempLocalBlockId
nodes.summary: Private[spark] id for temporary local data managed as blocks (not serializable); its name is "temp_local_<uuid>".

nodes.name: TempShuffleBlockId
nodes.summary: Private[spark] id for temporary shuffle data managed as blocks (not serializable); its name is "temp_shuffle_<uuid>".

nodes.name: TestBlockId
nodes.summary: Private[spark] block id intended only for testing; its name is "test_<id>".

nodes.name: UnrecognizedBlockId
nodes.summary: DeveloperApi exception (extends SparkException) with the message "Failed to parse <name> into a block ID".

nodes.name: CacheId
nodes.summary: DeveloperApi block id (sessionUUID, hash); its name is "cache_<sessionUUID>_<hash>".

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Parses a block name string back into a typed BlockId by matching the companion-object regexes (rdd_, shuffle_, shuffle_ batch, .data, .index, shufflePush_, shuffleMerged_, shuffleChunk_, broadcast_, taskresult_, input-, python-stream-, temp_local_, temp_shuffle_, test_log_, python_worker_log_, test_). Unknown names raise SparkCoreErrors.unrecognizedBlockIdError.

nodes.name: empty
nodes.summary: Returns a placeholder LogBlockId (timestamp 0 and empty strings) for the given LogBlockType, throwing SparkException for unsupported types.

nodes.name: AccumulatorV2.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the AccumulatorV2[IN, OUT] base class (the accumulator contract behind sc.accumulator-style shared counters and SQL metrics), the driver-side AccumulatorContext registry, and the built-in LongAccumulator, DoubleAccumulator and CollectionAccumulator implementations. Includes the serialization hooks that send a zero-value copy to executors and auto-register it in the task context.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala abstract class using writeReplace/readObject Java serialization hooks to behave differently on the driver and executor sides.

nodes.name: AccumulatorMetadata
nodes.summary: Private[spark] serializable case class holding an accumulator id, optional name and the countFailedValues flag; set when an accumulator is registered.

nodes.name: AccumulatorV2
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for accumulators that accumulate inputs of type IN and produce output of type OUT. Contract: isZero, copy, reset, add, merge (merge-in-place of another same-type accumulator) and value; OUT must be readable atomically or thread-safely because it is read from other threads. An accumulator must be registered on the driver before use; when serialized to executors a zero-value copy is sent, and it is re-registered with the TaskContext on deserialization so partial values can be merged back.

nodes.name: AccumulatorContext
nodes.summary: Private[spark] singleton that tracks driver-created accumulators in a global map of weak references keyed by id (so they can be garbage-collected), hands out globally unique ids, and interns the Some(0) and Some(-1) option values. The SQL_ACCUM_IDENTIFIER constant "sql" distinguishes SQL metrics from other accumulators.

nodes.name: LongAccumulator
nodes.summary: AccumulatorV2 for computing sum, count and average of 64-bit integers (inputs and output are java.lang.Long). Merging requires another LongAccumulator, otherwise UnsupportedOperationException. Since 2.0.0.

nodes.name: DoubleAccumulator
nodes.summary: AccumulatorV2 for computing sum, count and average of double precision numbers (java.lang.Double in and out). Merging requires another DoubleAccumulator. Since 2.0.0.

nodes.name: CollectionAccumulator
nodes.summary: AccumulatorV2 that collects elements of type T into a java.util.List (value returns an immutable copy); all operations are synchronized and the backing list is created lazily. Since 2.0.0.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Private[spark] driver-side registration: throws if already registered, assigns AccumulatorMetadata with a new id from AccumulatorContext, adds the accumulator to AccumulatorContext and registers it with the SparkContext cleaner for cleanup.

nodes.name: isRegistered
nodes.summary: Returns true if this accumulator has been registered. All accumulators must be registered before use or an exception is thrown.

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Returns the optional accumulator name; only valid after registration. On the driver it falls back to the name stored in the registered original.

nodes.name: toInfo
nodes.summary: Builds an AccumulableInfo (id, name, update, value, internal flag, countFailedValues) describing this accumulator.

nodes.name: toInfoUpdate
nodes.summary: Builds an AccumulableInfo for this accumulator as an update, using the current value.

nodes.name: isZero
nodes.summary: Abstract: returns whether this accumulator holds its zero value (0 for a counter, Nil for a list).

nodes.name: copyAndReset
nodes.summary: Creates a copy of this accumulator and resets it, so isZero is true on the copy.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Abstract: creates a new copy of this accumulator.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Abstract: resets this accumulator to its zero value.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Abstract: takes an input value and accumulates it.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Abstract: merges another same-type accumulator into this one in place.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Abstract: defines the current value of this accumulator.

nodes.name: withBufferSerialized
nodes.summary: Hook that serializes the accumulator buffer before it is sent back to the driver; the default implementation returns this unchanged.

nodes.name: writeReplace
nodes.summary: Java serialization hook. On the driver it requires registration, ships a zero-value copy (copyAndReset, asserted isZero) and drops the name for internal accumulators; on executors it returns withBufferSerialized() so partial results go back to the driver.

nodes.name: readObject
nodes.summary: Java deserialization hook. On the first deserialization it flips atDriverSide to false and registers the accumulator with the current TaskContext, so task completion can report its value; deserializing back on the driver restores the driver-side flag.

nodes.name: toString
nodes.summary: String form: "Un-registered Accumulator: <class>" when unregistered, otherwise "<class>(id: ..., name: ..., value: ...)".

nodes.name: newId
nodes.summary: Returns a globally unique id for a new accumulator using an atomic counter (ids are no longer unique once an accumulator is copied).

nodes.name: numAccums
nodes.summary: Returns the number of registered accumulators; used in testing.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a driver-created accumulator by id as a weak reference (putIfAbsent, so registering the same id twice does nothing) so it can be used on executors and merged to by the scheduler.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Unregisters the accumulator with the given id, if any.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Looks up the registered accumulator by id, logging a warning when the weak reference has been garbage collected.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Clears all registered accumulators; for testing only.

nodes.name: internOption
nodes.summary: Reduces duplicate Some objects by returning shared instances for the values 0 and -1.

nodes.name: isZero
nodes.summary: True when the sum is 0 and the count is 0.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Returns a new LongAccumulator with the same sum and count.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Resets sum and count to 0.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds a value (boxed java.lang.Long overload and primitive Long overload): sum += v and count += 1.

nodes.name: avg
nodes.summary: Returns the average as sum divided by count (as a Double).

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges another LongAccumulator by adding its sum and count; throws UnsupportedOperationException for other types.

nodes.name: setValue
nodes.summary: Private[spark] helper that overwrites the sum with a new value.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns the current sum as java.lang.Long.

nodes.name: isZero
nodes.summary: True when the sum is 0.0 and the count is 0.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Returns a new DoubleAccumulator with the same sum and count.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Resets sum to 0.0 and count to 0.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds a value (boxed java.lang.Double overload and primitive Double overload): sum += v and count += 1.

nodes.name: avg
nodes.summary: Returns the average as sum divided by count.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges another DoubleAccumulator by adding its sum and count; throws UnsupportedOperationException for other types.

nodes.name: setValue
nodes.summary: Private[spark] helper that overwrites the sum with a new value.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns the current sum as java.lang.Double.

nodes.name: getOrCreate
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the backing java.util.ArrayList and returns it.

nodes.name: isZero
nodes.summary: Synchronized check that the collection is empty.

nodes.name: copyAndReset
nodes.summary: Overrides the default by simply returning a new, empty CollectionAccumulator.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Returns a new CollectionAccumulator containing all elements of this one (synchronized copy).

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Synchronized reset by dropping the backing list.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Synchronized append of one element to the list.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges another CollectionAccumulator by adding all of its values; throws UnsupportedOperationException for other types.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns an immutable copy of the list (java.util.List.copyOf) under synchronization.

nodes.name: setValue
nodes.summary: Private[spark] helper that replaces the list contents with the given values.

nodes.name: MicroBatchScanExec.scala
nodes.summary: Physical plan node that scans one micro-batch of a streaming DSv2 source: it asks the MicroBatchStream for input partitions between a start and end Offset and wraps them in a DataSourceRDD. Used by Structured Streaming micro-batch queries.

nodes.name: MicroBatchScanExec
nodes.summary: Case class physical operator (output, scan, stream, start, end, optional keyGroupedPartitioning and ordering) extending DataSourceV2ScanExecBase and StreamSourceAwareSparkPlan. Equality and hashCode depend only on the MicroBatchStream; partitions come from stream.planInputPartitions(start, end), the reader factory from stream.createReaderFactory(), and getStream exposes the stream.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Two MicroBatchScanExec nodes are equal when their streams are equal; the TODO notes this should be unified across DSv2 plans.

nodes.name: hashCode
nodes.summary: Hash code is derived from the stream only, consistent with equals.

nodes.name: inputPartitions
nodes.summary: Lazily plans the input partitions of the micro-batch by calling stream.planInputPartitions(start, end).

nodes.name: readerFactory
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the PartitionReaderFactory via stream.createReaderFactory().

nodes.name: inputRDD
nodes.summary: Lazily builds a DataSourceRDD from the partitions, reader factory, columnar flag and custom metrics, then posts the scan driver metrics (scan.reportDriverMetrics()) before returning the RDD.

nodes.name: getStream
nodes.summary: Returns Some(stream), identifying the SparkDataStream this plan reads (StreamSourceAwareSparkPlan).

nodes.name: V2CommandExec.scala
nodes.summary: Base physical operators for DSv2 commands that do not need a Spark job: V2CommandExec runs the command once through a lazy cached result and serves collect, take, tail and execute from it, and LeafV2CommandExec marks leaf commands.

nodes.name: V2CommandExec
nodes.summary: Abstract SparkPlan whose subclasses implement run(); the result is stored in a lazy val so the command is executed only once, and executeCollect, executeToIterator, executeTake, executeTail and doExecute (a one-partition parallelize) all read that cached result. toCatalystRow converts values into an InternalRow with the output schema.

nodes.name: LeafV2CommandExec
nodes.summary: Trait combining V2CommandExec with LeafLike[SparkPlan] for commands without children.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Abstract method each concrete command implements to compute its result rows.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Lazy val that calls run() once and caches the rows, preventing multiple executions.

nodes.name: executeCollect
nodes.summary: Returns the cached result as an array.

nodes.name: executeToIterator
nodes.summary: Returns an iterator over the cached result.

nodes.name: executeTake
nodes.summary: Returns the first limit rows of the cached result.

nodes.name: executeTail
nodes.summary: Returns the last limit rows of the cached result.

nodes.name: doExecute
nodes.summary: Builds an RDD with sparkContext.parallelize(result, 1), a single partition holding the cached rows.

nodes.name: producedAttributes
nodes.summary: Declares all output attributes as produced by this command.

nodes.name: toCatalystRow
nodes.summary: Converts the given values to an InternalRow using the output schema and a row serializer, copying the row.

nodes.name: rowSerializer
nodes.summary: Lazy serializer from an ExpressionEncoder built on the output attributes.

nodes.name: ContinuousScanExec.scala
nodes.summary: Physical plan node that scans a streaming DSv2 source in continuous processing mode: it plans partitions from a ContinuousStream and builds a ContinuousDataSourceRDD after registering the reader partition count with the epoch coordinator.

nodes.name: ContinuousScanExec
nodes.summary: Case class physical operator (output, scan, stream, start, optional keyGroupedPartitioning and ordering) extending DataSourceV2ScanExecBase. Equality is based on the stream; inputPartitions come from stream.planInputPartitions(start) and the reader factory from stream.createContinuousReaderFactory().

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Two ContinuousScanExec nodes are equal when their streams are equal; the TODO notes this should be unified across DSv2 plans.

nodes.name: hashCode
nodes.summary: Hash code is derived from the stream only, consistent with equals.

nodes.name: inputPartitions
nodes.summary: Lazily plans partitions with stream.planInputPartitions(start).

nodes.name: readerFactory
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the ContinuousPartitionReaderFactory via stream.createContinuousReaderFactory().

nodes.name: inputRDD
nodes.summary: Asserts every partition is defined, tells the EpochCoordinator (looked up by the epoch coordinator id local property) how many reader partitions there are, then builds a ContinuousDataSourceRDD using the executor queue size and poll interval configs, and posts the scan driver metrics.

nodes.name: DataSourceV2ScanExecBase.scala
nodes.summary: Shared trait for DSv2 scan physical operators (batch, micro-batch and continuous). It defines the scan, reader factory, input partitions and RDD contract, reports partitioning and ordering from the source (SupportsReportPartitioning/SupportsReportOrdering), decides row vs columnar execution, and counts numOutputRows alongside custom data source metrics.

nodes.name: DataSourceV2ScanExecBase
nodes.summary: Trait extending LeafExecNode with SafeForKWayMerge and SupportsCustomDriverMetrics. Abstract members: scan, readerFactory, keyGroupedPartitioning, ordering, inputPartitions and inputRDD. It supplies explain strings with redaction, a KeyedPartitioning output partitioning when the source reports keys and all partitions implement HasPartitionKey (and v2 bucketing is on), output ordering, columnar-support detection, and doExecute/doExecuteColumnar that bump the numOutputRows metric.

nodes.name: customMetrics
nodes.summary: Lazy map of custom metrics created from scan.supportedCustomMetrics().

nodes.name: sparkMetrics
nodes.summary: Lazy map holding the built-in numOutputRows SQLMetric ("number of output rows").

nodes.name: simpleString
nodes.summary: One-line plan description: node name, truncated output and scan.description(), passed through redaction.

nodes.name: partitions
nodes.summary: Wraps each input partition in Some, giving the Seq[Option[InputPartition]] used to build the RDD.

nodes.name: redact
nodes.summary: Applies Utils.redact with the string redaction pattern from the SQL conf.

nodes.name: verboseStringWithOperatorId
nodes.summary: Builds the verbose explain block: formatted node name, Output fields and either scan metadata (for SupportsMetadata scans, skipping empty values) or scan.description().

nodes.name: outputPartitioning
nodes.summary: If the source reports key grouped partitioning, v2 bucketing is enabled, partitions are non-empty and all implement HasPartitionKey, returns a KeyedPartitioning with the sorted partition keys; otherwise falls back to the parent partitioning.

nodes.name: outputOrdering
nodes.summary: Returns the source-reported ordering if present; otherwise, if the output partitioning is a KeyedPartitioning and the partition-key-ordering conf is on, returns ascending sort orders on the key expressions; else empty.

nodes.name: supportsColumnar
nodes.summary: Uses scan.columnarSupportMode(): for PARTITION_DEFINED it requires all or none of the partitions to support columnar reads (no mixing) and returns whether any do; SUPPORTED returns true and UNSUPPORTED false.

nodes.name: inputRDDs
nodes.summary: Returns Seq(inputRDD), the RDD input for whole-stage codegen.

nodes.name: doExecute
nodes.summary: Maps inputRDD to count each row into the numOutputRows metric.

nodes.name: doExecuteColumnar
nodes.summary: Maps inputRDD (cast to ColumnarBatch) and adds the batch numRows to the numOutputRows metric.

nodes.name: UnsafeInMemorySorter.java
nodes.summary: Pointer-array sorter used by Tungsten external sorting. It stores, for each record, an 8-byte record pointer plus an 8-byte key prefix in one LongArray, sorts the pairs in memory with either radix sort (when the prefix comparator supports it) or TimSort via Sorter, and exposes the sorted records through an iterator. UnsafeExternalSorter owns it, grows its pointer array and spills it to disk.
nodes.languageNotes: Final Java class (AlphaSort-style key-prefix sort) working on off-heap/on-heap LongArray memory through Platform and TaskMemoryManager page addresses.

nodes.name: UnsafeInMemorySorter
nodes.summary: Sorts records with an AlphaSort-style key-prefix sort: the pointer array holds record pointer at position 2*i and key prefix at 2*i+1, so comparisons first compare prefixes and avoid random memory access to the record unless prefixes tie. Uses radix sort if the PrefixComparator provides RadixSortSupport and radix is allowed (nulls kept in a separate region), otherwise TimSort; the usable capacity leaves room for the sort buffer (array size divided by 2 for radix sort, by 1.5 for TimSort). Callers must expandPointerArray when hasSpaceForAnotherRecord is false.

nodes.name: SortComparator
nodes.summary: Private static nested comparator over RecordPointerAndKeyPrefix: compares key prefixes first, and only on equality resolves the record pointers through TaskMemoryManager to base object, offset and length and delegates to the RecordComparator.

nodes.name: SortedIterator
nodes.summary: Public final iterator (extends UnsafeSorterIterator, Cloneable) over the sorted pointer array. loadNext decodes the record pointer into page number, base object, base offset and record length and reads the key prefix, advancing two array slots at a time.

nodes.name: UnsafeInMemorySorter
nodes.summary: Two constructors: one allocates a pointer array of 2*initialSize longs through MemoryConsumer.allocateArray, the other takes an existing LongArray. If a RecordComparator is given it builds a SortComparator and enables radix sort only when canUseRadixSort is true and the PrefixComparator implements RadixSortSupport; with no RecordComparator, no sorting is done.

nodes.name: getUsableCapacity
nodes.summary: Computes how many array slots may hold pointers: array size divided by 2 for radix sort (needs a buffer as big as the data) or by 1.5 for TimSort (needs half as much buffer).

nodes.name: getInitialSize
nodes.summary: Returns the initial size of the pointer array.

nodes.name: freeMemory
nodes.summary: Frees the pointer array through the consumer and sets it to null instead of reallocating (allocating during a spill could trigger another spill); resets position and null boundary.

nodes.name: numRecords
nodes.summary: Returns the number of inserted records (pos / 2).

nodes.name: getSortTimeNanos
nodes.summary: Returns the accumulated in-memory sort time in nanoseconds.

nodes.name: getMemoryUsage
nodes.summary: Returns the pointer array size in bytes (array.size() * 8), or 0 if freed.

nodes.name: hasSpaceForAnotherRecord
nodes.summary: True while another pointer and prefix pair fits within the usable capacity.

nodes.name: expandPointerArray
nodes.summary: Copies the existing pairs into a larger LongArray (throws SparkOutOfMemoryError POINTER_ARRAY_OUT_OF_MEMORY if the new array is smaller), frees the old array and recomputes the usable capacity.

nodes.name: insertRecord
nodes.summary: Inserts a record pointer and its key prefix. With radix sort and a null prefix, the record is placed at the front null region (swapping a non-null entry to the end); otherwise it is appended. Throws IllegalStateException if there is no space.

nodes.name: getSortedIterator
nodes.summary: Sorts the pointer array and returns an iterator. Uses RadixSort.sortKeyPrefixArray on the non-null region when radix sort is enabled, otherwise TimSort via Sorter over a buffer carved from the unused part of the array. Null-prefixed records are chained before or after the sorted region according to nullsFirst. Time spent is added to totalSortTimeNanos.

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Compares two pointer/prefix entries: prefix comparison first; if equal, loads both records through TaskMemoryManager.getPage/getOffsetInPage and compares them with the RecordComparator.

nodes.name: clone
nodes.summary: Copies the iterator state (position, base object and offset, key prefix, record length, page number) into a new SortedIterator.

nodes.name: getNumRecords
nodes.summary: Returns the number of records this iterator covers.

nodes.name: hasNext
nodes.summary: True while position / 2 is below the record count.

nodes.name: loadNext
nodes.summary: Kills the task if it has been interrupted, then decodes the next record pointer to page number, base object, offset and length, and loads the key prefix, advancing two array slots.

nodes.name: ExecutorMetricType.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the sealed ExecutorMetricType hierarchy: each metric type reads one or more Long values for executor-level metrics stored in ExecutorMetrics. The companion object lists all metricGetters (JVM heap/off-heap, on/off-heap execution, storage and unified memory, direct and mapped buffer pools, process tree, garbage collection) and computes each metric name's offset (metricToOffset) and the total count (numMetrics).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a sealed trait with case objects so the full set of metric types is known at compile time; the companion object (lines 200-229) flattens all metric names into one indexed array layout.

nodes.name: ExecutorMetricType
nodes.summary: Sealed root trait for executor-level metric types. Declares getMetricValues(memoryManager), which returns an Array[Long], and names, the metric names produced. Its companion object (lines 200-229) holds metricGetters, metricToOffset and numMetrics.

nodes.name: SingleValueExecutorMetricType
nodes.summary: Base trait for metric types that produce exactly one value. It derives the metric name from the simple class name of the implementing object and wraps getMetricValue into a one-element array.

nodes.name: MemoryManagerExecutorMetricType
nodes.summary: Single-value metric type that applies a function MemoryManager => Long to read a memory-usage figure from the MemoryManager.

nodes.name: MBeanExecutorMetricType
nodes.summary: Single-value metric type that builds a BufferPoolMXBean proxy for a given MBean name and reports its getMemoryUsed value.

nodes.name: JVMHeapMemory
nodes.summary: Executor metric reporting the used heap memory of the JVM, read from the platform MemoryMXBean.

nodes.name: JVMOffHeapMemory
nodes.summary: Executor metric reporting the used non-heap memory of the JVM, read from the platform MemoryMXBean.

nodes.name: ProcessTreeMetrics
nodes.summary: Multi-value executor metric with six names: ProcessTreeJVMVMemory, ProcessTreeJVMRSSMemory, ProcessTreePythonVMemory, ProcessTreePythonRSSMemory, ProcessTreeOtherVMemory and ProcessTreeOtherRSSMemory. Values come from ProcfsMetricsGetter.pTreeInfo.computeAllMetrics().

nodes.name: GarbageCollectionMetrics
nodes.summary: Multi-value executor metric with seven names (MinorGCCount, MinorGCTime, MajorGCCount, MajorGCTime, TotalGCTime, ConcurrentGCCount, ConcurrentGCTime). It classifies each garbage collector MXBean as young, old or concurrent using built-in collector names plus the configured lists, and logs a warning the first time it sees a collector it does not recognise.

nodes.name: OnHeapExecutionMemory
nodes.summary: Reports on-heap execution memory used, via MemoryManager.onHeapExecutionMemoryUsed.

nodes.name: OffHeapExecutionMemory
nodes.summary: Reports off-heap execution memory used, via MemoryManager.offHeapExecutionMemoryUsed.

nodes.name: OnHeapStorageMemory
nodes.summary: Reports on-heap storage memory used, via MemoryManager.onHeapStorageMemoryUsed.

nodes.name: OffHeapStorageMemory
nodes.summary: Reports off-heap storage memory used, via MemoryManager.offHeapStorageMemoryUsed.

nodes.name: OnHeapUnifiedMemory
nodes.summary: Reports on-heap unified memory used as the sum of on-heap execution and storage memory used.

nodes.name: OffHeapUnifiedMemory
nodes.summary: Reports off-heap unified memory used as the sum of off-heap execution and storage memory used.

nodes.name: DirectPoolMemory
nodes.summary: Reports memory used by the direct buffer pool (MBean java.nio:type=BufferPool,name=direct).

nodes.name: MappedPoolMemory
nodes.summary: Reports memory used by the mapped buffer pool (MBean java.nio:type=BufferPool,name=mapped).

nodes.name: getMetricValues
nodes.summary: Wraps the single value from getMetricValue into a one-element Array[Long].

nodes.name: getMetricValues
nodes.summary: Calls ProcfsMetricsGetter.pTreeInfo.computeAllMetrics() and copies the JVM, Python and other virtual and RSS totals into a six-element array in the order of names.

nodes.name: getMetricValues
nodes.summary: Iterates the garbage collector MXBeans: sets TotalGCTime, fills the young, old and G1 concurrent count and time slots, and logs a warning once for each non-built-in collector it encounters.

nodes.name: MetricsConfig.scala
nodes.summary: Loads and resolves Spark metrics configuration. MetricsConfig starts from default servlet sink properties, loads a metrics.properties-style file (path from the METRICS_CONF setting, or from the class path), then overlays spark.metrics.conf.* entries from SparkConf and groups all keys by instance prefix, merging wildcard "*" defaults into each instance.

nodes.name: MetricsConfig
nodes.summary: Builds the per-instance metrics settings used by MetricsSystem. Keys follow [instance].[sink|source].[name].[options]; the instance is the part before the first dot and "*" means all instances. getInstance returns the sub-properties for one instance, falling back to the "*" set.

nodes.name: setDefaultProperties
nodes.summary: Sets the built-in defaults: a MetricsServlet sink for all instances at /metrics/json, plus servlet paths for master and applications.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Loads properties by precedence (defaults, the metrics file, then spark.metrics.conf.* entries from SparkConf), then builds perInstanceSubProperties and copies "*" defaults into each instance unless the instance already defines that key.

nodes.name: subProperties
nodes.summary: Splits flat dotted property keys using a regex into a map from first-level prefix to a Properties holding the remaining suffix keys; keys that do not match the regex are ignored.

nodes.name: getInstance
nodes.summary: Returns the sub-properties for the given instance name, or the "*" defaults (or an empty Properties) if that instance has none.

nodes.name: loadPropertiesFromFile
nodes.summary: Reads a properties file from the given path, or metrics.properties from the Spark class loader when no path is given; logs an error on failure and always closes the stream.

nodes.name: MetricsSystem.scala
nodes.summary: Defines MetricsSystem, which a Spark role (the "instance": master, worker, executor, driver, applications, ...) uses to expose metrics. It registers Sources into a Codahale MetricRegistry, instantiates Sinks (MetricsServlet, PrometheusServlet and other Sink classes named in configuration) by reflection, and starts, stops and reports them. Also holds the instance-name constants in MetricsSystemInstances.

nodes.name: MetricsSystem
nodes.summary: Spark metrics system for one instance. It loads configuration through MetricsConfig, keeps lists of sources and sinks plus one MetricRegistry, and starts, stops and reports sinks. Source and sink classes named in the configuration are created by reflection; the servlet sinks are kept separately so their web handlers can be exposed. The class body is lines 71-243; the companion object (lines 245-263) has SINK_REGEX, SOURCE_REGEX, checkMinimalPollingPeriod and createMetricsSystem.

nodes.name: MetricsSystemInstances
nodes.summary: Constants naming the metrics instances: master, applications, worker, executor, driver, shuffleService and applicationMaster.

nodes.name: getServletHandlers
nodes.summary: Returns the web UI handlers of the MetricsServlet and PrometheusServlet sinks; requires that the system is already running.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Marks the system running, optionally registers StaticSources.allSources and the sources listed in configuration, registers the sinks, then starts every sink.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops all sinks and removes all metrics from the registry, or logs a warning when the system is not running.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Asks every registered sink to report its metrics now.

nodes.name: buildRegistryName
nodes.summary: Builds the registry name for a source as <namespace or app ID>.<executor ID>.<source name> for driver and executor instances, falling back to just the source name (with warnings) when the IDs are not set.

nodes.name: getSourcesByName
nodes.summary: Returns registered sources whose sourceName matches the given name.

nodes.name: registerSource
nodes.summary: Adds a Source to the source list and registers its metricRegistry under its registry name; an already-registered name is only logged.

nodes.name: removeSource
nodes.summary: Removes a Source from the list and removes registry entries whose names start with its registry name.

nodes.name: registerSources
nodes.summary: Reads the instance configuration, picks the keys that match SOURCE_REGEX and instantiates each configured source class by reflection with a no-argument constructor, registering it.

nodes.name: registerSinks
nodes.summary: Reads the instance configuration for keys matching SINK_REGEX and instantiates each class by reflection. The "servlet" entry becomes a MetricsServlet, "prometheusServlet" becomes a PrometheusServlet, and any other class is created as a Sink with (Properties, MetricRegistry), falling back to a constructor that also takes SecurityManager.

nodes.name: metricsProperties
nodes.summary: Returns the raw properties held by the MetricsConfig.

nodes.name: checkMinimalPollingPeriod
nodes.summary: Throws IllegalArgumentException if a sink polling period is below the minimum of one second.

nodes.name: createMetricsSystem
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a MetricsSystem for the given instance name and SparkConf (the constructor is private).

nodes.name: Sink.scala
nodes.summary: Declares the Sink trait, the destination side of the metrics system. A sink supports start(), stop() and report().

nodes.name: Sink
nodes.summary: Interface implemented by metrics sinks: start(), stop() and report(). MetricsSystem creates sinks by reflection from configuration and calls these three methods.

nodes.name: Source.scala
nodes.summary: Declares the Source trait, the producer side of the metrics system. A source has a sourceName and a Codahale MetricRegistry.

nodes.name: Source
nodes.summary: Interface implemented by metric sources: sourceName and metricRegistry. MetricsSystem registers each source's registry under a name built from the application, executor and source name.

nodes.name: AppStatusListener.scala
nodes.summary: Defines AppStatusListener, the SparkListener that turns listener-bus events into Live* entities and writes immutable snapshots of them into the ElementTrackingStore (a KVStore). The Spark UI, the REST API and the history server read the application state from that store, and this file also trims it using the spark.ui.retained* limits.

nodes.name: AppStatusListener
nodes.summary: SparkListener that keeps mutable Live* entities (jobs, stages, tasks, executors, RDDs, pools) in memory and writes them to the ElementTrackingStore, either on every change (replay) or throttled by spark.ui.liveUpdate.period (live apps). It registers count triggers on the store so that old executors, jobs and stages are deleted when spark.ui.retainedDeadExecutors, spark.ui.retainedJobs and spark.ui.retainedStages are exceeded, and per-stage task cleanup uses spark.ui.retainedTasks.

nodes.name: onOtherEvent
nodes.summary: Handles events without a dedicated callback: records the Spark version from SparkListenerLogStart and forwards SparkListenerMiscellaneousProcessAdded to onMiscellaneousProcessAdded.

nodes.name: onApplicationStart
nodes.summary: Builds the first ApplicationAttemptInfo and ApplicationInfo from the application start event, writes ApplicationInfoWrapper and AppSummary to the store, and copies driver log URLs and attributes onto the driver LiveExecutor.

nodes.name: onResourceProfileAdded
nodes.summary: Creates a LiveResourceProfile for a new resource profile (computing max tasks per executor when the cores limit is known) and writes a ResourceProfileWrapper to the store.

nodes.name: onEnvironmentUpdate
nodes.summary: Converts the environment details (JVM info, Spark, Hadoop, system and metrics properties, classpath) into ApplicationEnvironmentInfo, remembers the configured cpus per task, and writes it to the store for the Environment tab and REST API.

nodes.name: onApplicationEnd
nodes.summary: Marks the application attempt as completed using the end event time, computes its duration and rewrites the ApplicationInfoWrapper in the store.

nodes.name: onExecutorAdded
nodes.summary: Gets or creates the LiveExecutor, fills host, cores, max tasks (from the resource profile or cores per task), logs, resources and attributes, and publishes it with liveUpdate.

nodes.name: onExecutorRemoved
nodes.summary: Marks the LiveExecutor as dead, writes it, removes its RDD distributions and partitions (adjusting RDD memory and disk usage), and keeps it in deadExecutors while live stages that overlapped it are still running.

nodes.name: isExecutorActiveForLiveStages
nodes.summary: Returns true when any currently live stage was submitted before the given executor was removed.

nodes.name: onExecutorBlacklisted
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible handler for the old blacklist event name so that older event logs still display correctly; marks the executor excluded.

nodes.name: onExecutorExcluded
nodes.summary: Marks the executor as excluded via updateExecExclusionStatus.

nodes.name: onExecutorBlacklistedForStage
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible handler for the old blacklist-for-stage event; records the executor as excluded for that stage.

nodes.name: onExecutorExcludedForStage
nodes.summary: Records an executor as excluded for a given stage attempt through updateExclusionStatusForStage.

nodes.name: onNodeBlacklistedForStage
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible handler for the old node blacklist-for-stage event.

nodes.name: onNodeExcludedForStage
nodes.summary: Excludes every executor on a host for a given stage attempt through updateNodeExclusionStatusForStage.

nodes.name: addExcludedStageTo
nodes.summary: Adds a stage id to the executor's excludedInStages set and publishes the executor.

nodes.name: setStageExcludedStatus
nodes.summary: Flags the given executors as excluded in the stage's per-executor summaries and in the stage itself, writing both with throttling.

nodes.name: onExecutorUnblacklisted
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible handler that clears the excluded flag of an executor.

nodes.name: onExecutorUnexcluded
nodes.summary: Clears the excluded flag of an executor.

nodes.name: onNodeBlacklisted
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible handler that excludes all executors of a node.

nodes.name: onNodeExcluded
nodes.summary: Excludes every non-driver executor running on the given host.

nodes.name: onNodeUnblacklisted
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible handler that un-excludes all executors of a node.

nodes.name: onNodeUnexcluded
nodes.summary: Clears the excluded flag of every non-driver executor on the given host.

nodes.name: updateNodeExclusionStatusForStage
nodes.summary: Implicitly excludes all non-driver executors on a host for a live stage and records the stage as excluded on those executors.

nodes.name: updateExclusionStatusForStage
nodes.summary: Marks one executor as excluded for a live stage and adds the stage id to the executor's excluded stages.

nodes.name: updateExecExclusionStatus
nodes.summary: Overloaded helper: looks up the LiveExecutor by id, then sets isExcluded, updating the excluded-executor counters of AppStatusSource only on a real state change to avoid double counting.

nodes.name: updateNodeExcluded
nodes.summary: Applies an exclusion or un-exclusion to every non-driver executor whose hostname matches.

nodes.name: onJobStart
nodes.summary: Creates a LiveJob (name from the last stage, description, job group, tags and SQL execution id taken from the job properties, estimated task count), links it to its stages via getOrCreateStage, and writes the RDD operation graph (DAG visualization) of each stage to the store.

nodes.name: newRDDOperationCluster
nodes.summary: Recursively converts an RDDOperationCluster into the storable RDDOperationClusterWrapper.

nodes.name: onJobEnd
nodes.summary: Marks pending stages of the job as skipped, sets the job status from the JobResult, updates AppStatusSource counters, force-writes the job with checkTriggers so that retention cleanup can run, and updates the AppSummary of completed jobs.

nodes.name: onStageSubmitted
nodes.summary: Marks the stage ACTIVE, resolves its scheduling pool and owning live jobs, updates the job and pool entities, creates LiveRDD entities for cached RDDs, and publishes the stage.

nodes.name: onTaskStart
nodes.summary: Creates a LiveTask and updates the stage, job and executor counters (active tasks, locality summary, first launch time, speculation summary); once the saved tasks of a stage exceed spark.ui.retainedTasks it schedules cleanupTasks asynchronously on the store worker.

nodes.name: onTaskGettingResult
nodes.summary: Throttled write of the task so that the getting-result time already held in the mutable TaskInfo reaches the store.

nodes.name: onTaskEnd
nodes.summary: Finishes the LiveTask (error message from the end reason, metrics delta), then applies completed, failed, killed and active deltas to the LiveStage, its jobs, per-executor stage summaries, speculation summary and LiveExecutor, forces writes when a stage or executor goes idle, and triggers task cleanup above spark.ui.retainedTasks.

nodes.name: onStageCompleted
nodes.summary: Writes executor summaries, derives the final stage status (FAILED, COMPLETE or SKIPPED), updates the owning jobs and scheduler pool, clears executor exclusions, writes the stage with last=true when no tasks remain, and refreshes AppSummary; also drops dead executors no longer overlapping live stages.

nodes.name: removeExcludedStageFrom
nodes.summary: Removes a stage id from an executor's excludedInStages and publishes the executor.

nodes.name: onBlockManagerAdded
nodes.summary: Gets or creates the LiveExecutor (the driver has no executor-added event), sets hostPort, memory totals and resets used on-heap and off-heap memory, then publishes it.

nodes.name: onBlockManagerRemoved
nodes.summary: Intentionally empty handler; executor removal is covered by onExecutorRemoved.

nodes.name: onUnpersistRDD
nodes.summary: Removes the LiveRDD, subtracts its partitions and distributions from executor block counts and memory/disk usage, and deletes the RDDStorageInfoWrapper from the store.

nodes.name: onExecutorMetricsUpdate
nodes.summary: Applies task metric deltas from executor heartbeats to LiveTask, LiveStage and per-executor stage summaries, tracks peak executor metrics (live UI only), and flushes stale entities when liveUpdateMinFlushPeriod has elapsed.

nodes.name: onStageExecutorMetrics
nodes.summary: Updates peak executor-level memory metrics for live or dead executors and for the stage while replaying event logs.

nodes.name: updateStageLevelPeakExecutorMetrics
nodes.summary: Compares new executor metrics against the stage and per-executor stage peaks and writes them when a new peak is found.

nodes.name: onBlockUpdated
nodes.summary: Dispatches a block update to updateRDDBlock, updateStreamBlock or updateBroadcastBlock depending on the BlockId type.

nodes.name: flush
nodes.summary: Applies a given update function to every live stage (with executor summaries), job, executor, task, RDD and pool; used on store flush when replaying and for periodic flushing on heartbeats.

nodes.name: activeStages
nodes.summary: Returns the API view of live stages that have a submission time, sorted by stage id, for the console progress bar.

nodes.name: addDeltaToValue
nodes.summary: Adds a delta to a value but never lets the result go below zero.

nodes.name: updateRDDBlock
nodes.summary: Applies an RDD block update: adjusts executor memory/disk accounting, the LiveRDD partition and per-executor distribution, refreshes other RDDs' free-memory view, and updates the executor's RDD block count.

nodes.name: getOrCreateExecutor
nodes.summary: Returns the LiveExecutor for an id, creating it and bumping activeExecutorCount if needed.

nodes.name: getOrCreateOtherProcess
nodes.summary: Returns the LiveMiscellaneousProcess for an id, creating it when absent.

nodes.name: updateStreamBlock
nodes.summary: Writes a StreamBlockData row for a valid streaming block or deletes it when the storage level is no longer valid.

nodes.name: updateBroadcastBlock
nodes.summary: Adjusts the executor's memory and disk usage for a broadcast block update and writes the executor with throttling.

nodes.name: updateExecutorMemoryDiskInfo
nodes.summary: Applies memory and disk deltas to a LiveExecutor (on-heap or off-heap when memory info exists), clamped at zero.

nodes.name: getOrCreateStage
nodes.summary: Atomically gets or creates the LiveStage keyed by (stageId, attemptNumber) in liveStages and refreshes its StageInfo.

nodes.name: killedTasksSummary
nodes.summary: Counts killed tasks by reason (TaskKilled reason or TaskCommitDenied error string) in a per-stage or per-job map.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Unconditionally writes a live entity to the ElementTrackingStore; checkTriggers is enabled only when last is true, so the retention triggers are evaluated at final writes.

nodes.name: maybeUpdate
nodes.summary: Throttled write: only calls update for live apps when more than spark.ui.liveUpdate.period (liveUpdatePeriodNs) has passed since the entity's last write; in replay mode (period -1) it never writes.

nodes.name: liveUpdate
nodes.summary: Writes an entity only in a live app, avoiding redundant writes when replaying event logs.

nodes.name: cleanupExecutors
nodes.summary: Trigger action for ExecutorSummaryWrapper: when dead executors exceed spark.ui.retainedDeadExecutors, deletes the oldest inactive ExecutorSummaryWrapper rows.

nodes.name: cleanupJobs
nodes.summary: Trigger action for JobDataWrapper: when the count exceeds spark.ui.retainedJobs, deletes the oldest finished jobs by completion time (never running or unknown ones).

nodes.name: cleanupStagesWithInMemoryStore
nodes.summary: Stage cleanup optimized for InMemoryStore: scans StageDataWrapper rows once, deletes the oldest non-active stages (skipped stages first), and removes RDD graph data and cached quantiles for stages with no remaining attempts.

nodes.name: cleanupStagesInKVStore
nodes.summary: Stage cleanup for a disk-backed KVStore: reads StageDataWrapper by completionTime index, deletes the oldest non-active stages, then removes the RDD operation graph when no other attempt exists and clears cached quantiles.

nodes.name: cleanupStages
nodes.summary: Trigger action for StageDataWrapper: computes how many stages exceed spark.ui.retainedStages, picks the in-memory or KVStore cleanup variant, then removes executor stage summaries and task rows of the deleted stages in one pass each.

nodes.name: cleanupTasks
nodes.summary: Deletes the oldest task rows of a stage above spark.ui.retainedTasks (finished tasks first, running ones only as a last resort), updates the stage's savedTasks counter, and clears cached quantiles on live apps.

nodes.name: cleanupCachedQuantiles
nodes.summary: Deletes the CachedQuantile rows of a stage so task summary quantiles are recomputed.

nodes.name: calculateNumberToRemove
nodes.summary: Returns how many items to delete: at least a tenth of the retained size, or the excess over the retained size, and 0 when under the limit.

nodes.name: onMiscellaneousProcessAdded
nodes.summary: Creates or updates a LiveMiscellaneousProcess with log URLs, host port and cores and writes it to the store.

nodes.name: StageCompletionTime
nodes.summary: Private case class holding stageId, attemptId and completionTime used by the in-memory stage cleanup to sort stages by completion time.

nodes.name: LiveEntity.scala
nodes.summary: Defines LiveEntity and its Live* subclasses (job, task, stage, executor, RDD, resource profile, pool, process): mutable in-memory state that AppStatusListener updates as events arrive. Each one can render an immutable store/REST view through doUpdate and write it to the ElementTrackingStore, and LiveEntityHelpers holds the shared task-metric arithmetic.

nodes.name: LiveEntity
nodes.summary: Abstract base of all live entities. It remembers lastWriteTime and its write method stores the immutable view produced by the abstract doUpdate into the ElementTrackingStore, always checking the store triggers on the first write because a new element may push the stored count over a retention limit.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes doUpdate() to the ElementTrackingStore (checkTriggers is forced on the first write) and records the write time that AppStatusListener uses for throttling.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Abstract hook that returns the immutable wrapper object (JobDataWrapper, StageDataWrapper, ...) reflecting the latest listener state.

nodes.name: LiveJob
nodes.summary: Mutable state of a running job: task and stage counters, completed task indices, killed-task reasons, skipped stages and status. Its doUpdate builds v1.JobData and wraps it in a JobDataWrapper.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Builds a v1.JobData from the counters and returns a JobDataWrapper that also carries skipped stage ids and the SQL execution id.

nodes.name: LiveTask
nodes.summary: Mutable state of one task attempt: its TaskInfo, the latest v1.TaskMetrics and the error message. Metrics start at the sentinel value -1 so the store can tell that none were reported.

nodes.name: updateMetrics
nodes.summary: Replaces the task's metrics with values from a TaskMetrics object and returns the delta against the previous values (or the full values when none were reported), which the listener adds to stage and executor totals.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Computes the duration, stores metrics of non-successful tasks as negative values (SPARK-26260) and builds a TaskDataWrapper with all indexed task metric columns.

nodes.name: LiveResourceProfile
nodes.summary: Live holder of a resource profile (id, executor resources, task resources, max tasks per executor) written as a ResourceProfileWrapper.

nodes.name: toApi
nodes.summary: Converts the profile into the REST type v1.ResourceProfileInfo.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Wraps toApi() in a ResourceProfileWrapper.

nodes.name: LiveExecutor
nodes.summary: Mutable per-executor state: host, cores, task counts and times, memory and disk usage (including on-heap/off-heap totals), exclusion flags, logs, resources and peak ExecutorMetrics. The driver is also modelled as a LiveExecutor.

nodes.name: hostname
nodes.summary: Returns the host, or parses it out of hostPort when host is not set.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Builds v1.ExecutorSummary (with optional memory metrics and peak executor metrics) and returns an ExecutorSummaryWrapper.

nodes.name: LiveExecutorStageSummary
nodes.summary: Per-(stage attempt, executor) accumulation of task time, task outcome counts, summed metrics, exclusion flag and peak executor metrics.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Builds v1.ExecutorStageSummary and returns an ExecutorStageSummaryWrapper keyed by stage, attempt and executor id.

nodes.name: LiveSpeculationStageSummary
nodes.summary: Counters for speculative tasks of a stage attempt (total, active, completed, failed, killed).

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Builds v1.SpeculationStageSummary and returns a SpeculationStageSummaryWrapper.

nodes.name: LiveStage
nodes.summary: Mutable state of a stage attempt: task counters, completed indices, summed metrics, locality summary, per-executor summaries, speculation summary, owning jobs, scheduling pool and peak executor metrics. It also carries the cleaning flag and savedTasks counter that drive task cleanup against spark.ui.retainedTasks.

nodes.name: executorSummary
nodes.summary: Returns the LiveExecutorStageSummary for an executor, creating it on first use.

nodes.name: toApi
nodes.summary: Builds the public v1.StageData (counters, timings, shuffle and push-based shuffle metrics, accumulator updates, peak executor metrics); also used directly for the console progress bar.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Returns a StageDataWrapper from toApi(), the job ids and the locality summary.

nodes.name: LiveRDDPartition
nodes.summary: Data about one partition of a cached RDD, including the effective storage level derived from the memory and disk actually used. It is an element of the RDDPartitionSeq linked list (prev/next pointers).

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Recomputes the effective storage level from the used memory and disk and replaces the v1.RDDPartitionInfo value.

nodes.name: LiveRDDDistribution
nodes.summary: Per-executor share of a cached RDD (memory, disk, on-heap and off-heap usage), with a cached API view that is invalidated when updated.

nodes.name: toApi
nodes.summary: Lazily builds and caches v1.RDDDataDistribution including remaining executor memory.

nodes.name: LiveRDD
nodes.summary: Tracker for a persisted RDD: used memory and disk, its partitions (HashMap plus RDDPartitionSeq) and per-executor distributions. The storage level is fixed when the entity is created.

nodes.name: partition
nodes.summary: Gets or creates the LiveRDDPartition for a block name and appends it to the partition sequence.

nodes.name: removePartition
nodes.summary: Removes a partition from the map and from the partition sequence.

nodes.name: distribution
nodes.summary: Gets or creates the LiveRDDDistribution of an executor.

nodes.name: removeDistribution
nodes.summary: Drops the distribution of an executor and reports whether one existed.

nodes.name: distributionOpt
nodes.summary: Looks up the distribution of an executor without creating it.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Exposes the partition map to AppStatusListener.

nodes.name: getDistributions
nodes.summary: Exposes the distribution map to AppStatusListener.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Builds v1.RDDStorageInfo (with optional distributions and the partition sequence) and wraps it in an RDDStorageInfoWrapper.

nodes.name: SchedulerPool
nodes.summary: Live entity for a fair-scheduler pool holding the set of stage ids currently assigned to it, written as PoolData.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Returns PoolData with the pool name and its stage ids.

nodes.name: LiveEntityHelpers
nodes.summary: Companion-style utility object with helpers shared by the Live* classes: converting accumulables to API objects and creating, adding, subtracting and negating v1.TaskMetrics.

nodes.name: accuValuetoString
nodes.summary: Turns an accumulator value into a string, truncating long collection accumulators to 5 elements to avoid OOM (SPARK-30379).

nodes.name: newAccumulatorInfos
nodes.summary: Converts AccumulableInfo objects to v1.AccumulableInfo, dropping internal and SQL accumulables to save memory.

nodes.name: createMetrics
nodes.summary: Overloaded factory for v1.TaskMetrics: one variant takes all 34 metric values, the other fills every field with one default value (used for -1 sentinels and zero starts).

nodes.name: addMetrics
nodes.summary: Field-by-field sum of two v1.TaskMetrics with a multiplier (1 to add, -1 to subtract); the public two-argument overload at line 841 adds with multiplier 1.

nodes.name: subtractMetrics
nodes.summary: Subtracts the second metrics object from the first by calling addMetrics with -1.

nodes.name: makeNegative
nodes.summary: Encodes metrics as -value-1 so that failed-task metrics can be excluded from summary calculations and recovered with abs(metric + 1).

nodes.name: RDDPartitionSeq
nodes.summary: Immutable-looking Seq of v1.RDDPartitionInfo backed by a mutable linked list of LiveRDDPartition, giving O(1) add and remove and a thread-safe best-effort traversal; it is the sequence exposed in RDDStorageInfo.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Walks the list to the idx-th element and returns its value.

nodes.name: iterator
nodes.summary: Returns an iterator over the current list that tolerates concurrent additions and removals.

nodes.name: addPartition
nodes.summary: Appends a partition at the tail of the list in O(1).

nodes.name: removePartition
nodes.summary: Unlinks a partition in O(1) while keeping its own pointers so running iterations still work.

nodes.name: LiveMiscellaneousProcess
nodes.summary: Live entity for a non-executor process (id, host port, cores, log URLs) shown in the UI and REST API.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Builds v1.ProcessSummary and returns a ProcessSummaryWrapper.

nodes.name: ElementTrackingStore.scala
nodes.summary: KVStore wrapper that counts elements per type and fires registered triggers when a type grows past a threshold, so writers such as AppStatusListener can delete old data. It also provides one async worker thread (or the caller thread when disabled) and flush hooks.

nodes.name: ElementTrackingStore
nodes.summary: KVStore wrapper (companion object at lines 200-209) that delegates reads and deletes to the underlying store, and on write(value, checkTriggers) runs registered count triggers on a single-threaded worker named element-tracking-store-worker; with spark.appStateStore.asyncTracking.enable set to false they run on the calling thread. At most one trigger run per type is pending at a time (latch), and onFlush hooks run when the store is closed.

nodes.name: LatchedTriggers
nodes.summary: Private inner class holding the triggers of one element type with an AtomicBoolean latch, so that only one asynchronous trigger run is queued at a time.

nodes.name: fireOnce
nodes.summary: Atomically sets the pending latch and queues the trigger run through doAsync (returning WriteQueued), or returns WriteSkippedQueue when a run is already pending.

nodes.name: Trigger
nodes.summary: Private case class pairing a count threshold with the action to run once the count exceeds it.

nodes.name: addTrigger
nodes.summary: Registers an action for a stored class that fires once the element count exceeds a threshold; AppStatusListener uses it with the spark.ui.retained* limits.

nodes.name: onFlush
nodes.summary: Adds a hook that runs synchronously when the store is closed, used to flush live entities to the store when replaying event logs.

nodes.name: doAsync
nodes.summary: Submits a task to the single worker thread (or runs it on the same thread when async tracking is disabled), logging any failure through Utils.tryLog.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Overloaded write: write(value) stores the object in the wrapped KVStore; write(value, checkTriggers) additionally fires the latched triggers for the value class with the current count and returns a WriteQueueResult.

nodes.name: removeAllByIndexValues
nodes.summary: Deletes all rows of a class whose index matches any of the given values, delegating to the underlying store; a Scala Iterable overload converts to a Java collection.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Overloaded close: marks the store stopped, shuts the worker down (5 seconds), runs the flush hooks, and closes the parent store unless closeParent is false.

nodes.name: usingInMemoryStore
nodes.summary: True when the wrapped store is an InMemoryStore, letting AppStatusListener pick an optimized stage cleanup.

nodes.name: WriteQueueResult
nodes.summary: Sealed trait returned by write(value, checkTriggers), existing only to test single-fire trigger execution; implemented by WriteQueued and WriteSkippedQueue.

nodes.name: WriteQueued
nodes.summary: Result object meaning a trigger run was queued.

nodes.name: WriteSkippedQueue
nodes.summary: Result object meaning no trigger run was queued (checks disabled, store stopped, or a run already pending).

nodes.name: AppStatusStore.scala
nodes.summary: Defines AppStatusStore, the read-side facade over a KVStore that returns the REST API data classes (jobs, stages, tasks, executors, RDDs, environment) and is what the web UI and the /api/v1 REST resources query. Its companion builds the in-memory or RocksDB-backed live store with an ElementTrackingStore and AppStatusListener.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala class plus companion object; the companion object shares the class node id.

nodes.name: AppStatusStore
nodes.summary: Wraps a KVStore (live in-memory or disk, or one rebuilt by the history server) and exposes typed query methods that read the *Wrapper entries from storeTypes.scala and return the public v1 API classes. An optional AppStatusListener is kept for live apps only, and the companion object holds CURRENT_VERSION and createLiveStore.

nodes.name: applicationInfo
nodes.summary: Returns the single ApplicationInfo by reading the highest entry of ApplicationInfoWrapper; throws a friendly NoSuchElementException while Spark is still starting up.

nodes.name: environmentInfo
nodes.summary: Reads the one ApplicationEnvironmentInfoWrapper (keyed by its class name) and returns the environment info used by the REST /environment endpoint.

nodes.name: resourceProfileInfo
nodes.summary: Lists all ResourceProfileWrapper entries from the store as ResourceProfileInfo values.

nodes.name: jobsList
nodes.summary: Returns all JobData in reverse key order from JobDataWrapper, optionally filtered by a list of JobExecutionStatus values.

nodes.name: job
nodes.summary: Reads one JobData by job id from JobDataWrapper; throws NoSuchElementException if missing.

nodes.name: jobWithAssociatedSql
nodes.summary: Returns a job together with its optional SQL execution id, both taken from the same JobDataWrapper entry.

nodes.name: executorList
nodes.summary: Returns ExecutorSummary values from ExecutorSummaryWrapper, using the 'active' index when activeOnly is set, dropping the fallback block manager and patching the driver's GC time and total duration.

nodes.name: miscellaneousProcessList
nodes.summary: Lists ProcessSummary entries from ProcessSummaryWrapper, using the 'active' index when only active processes are wanted.

nodes.name: executorSummary
nodes.summary: Reads one ExecutorSummary by executor id. An overload at line 598 (stageId, attemptId) returns per-executor ExecutorStageSummary entries for a stage attempt via the 'stage' index of ExecutorStageSummaryWrapper.

nodes.name: activeStages
nodes.summary: Asks the optional live AppStatusListener for its active stages (used by the console progress bar); returns Nil when there is no listener, as with a history server store.

nodes.name: stageList
nodes.summary: Returns StageData for all stages from StageDataWrapper, optionally filtered by StageStatus, and expands each through newStageData when details or summaries are requested.

nodes.name: stageData
nodes.summary: Returns all attempts of one stage id using the 'stageId' index of StageDataWrapper, expanded by newStageData.

nodes.name: lastStageAttempt
nodes.summary: Returns the latest attempt of a stage id by scanning the 'stageId' index in reverse and taking the first entry.

nodes.name: stageAttempt
nodes.summary: Reads one stage attempt by (stageId, attemptId) and returns it with the ids of the jobs that contain it.

nodes.name: taskSummary
nodes.summary: Computes task metric quantiles for a stage attempt: serves cached CachedQuantile entries when the task count matches, otherwise scans TaskDataWrapper indices to compute the distributions and caches every 0.05 quantile back into the store.

nodes.name: taskList
nodes.summary: Three overloads that list TaskData for a stage attempt: latest N tasks, or a page sorted by a TaskSorting or index name and filtered by task status. They use the TaskDataWrapper indices and finish with constructTaskDataList.

nodes.name: speculationSummary
nodes.summary: Reads the SpeculationStageSummary for a stage attempt, returning None if it is not present.

nodes.name: rddList
nodes.summary: Lists RDDStorageInfo from RDDStorageInfoWrapper, keeping only RDDs with cached partitions unless cachedOnly is false.

nodes.name: asOption
nodes.summary: Runs a closure and turns a NoSuchElementException into None; used by callers to probe optional store entries.

nodes.name: newStageData
nodes.summary: Builds a StageData copy that optionally includes the task map, per-executor summaries, speculation summary, task metric distributions and executor metric distributions; returns the stored stage unchanged when neither details nor summaries are requested.

nodes.name: stageExecutorSummary
nodes.summary: Computes ExecutorMetricsDistributions quantiles (task time, input, shuffle, spill, peak memory) across the executors of a stage attempt, using getQuantilesValue.

nodes.name: rdd
nodes.summary: Reads one RDDStorageInfo by RDD id from RDDStorageInfoWrapper.

nodes.name: operationGraphForJob
nodes.summary: Reads the RDDOperationGraphWrapper of every stage in a job and converts them to RDDOperationGraph values, marking skipped stages in the root cluster name.

nodes.name: appSummary
nodes.summary: Reads the AppSummary singleton (completed job and stage counts) from the store; throws a startup message if absent.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the underlying KVStore and deletes the optional disk store directory.

nodes.name: constructTaskDataList
nodes.summary: Converts TaskDataWrapper values to TaskData through toApi, attaching each task's executor logs (cached per executor id), scheduler delay and getting-result time.

nodes.name: createLiveStore
nodes.summary: Companion factory for a live application: optionally creates a spark-ui directory from LIVE_UI_LOCAL_STORE_DIR, builds a KVStore through KVUtils.createKVStore (in-memory when no path), wraps it in an ElementTrackingStore, creates the AppStatusListener and returns the AppStatusStore.

nodes.name: KVUtils.scala
nodes.summary: KVUtils object: creates and opens the KVStore used for the UI and history server (InMemoryStore, LevelDB or RocksDB, with a JSON or protobuf serializer) and offers helpers that turn a KVStoreView into Scala sequences. Also defines the KVIndexParam annotation alias used to mark store index fields.

nodes.name: KVUtils
nodes.summary: Utility object for the status KVStore: backend and serializer selection (live stores use RocksDB with protobuf; history stores follow configuration), store opening with a metadata check, and closeable-iterator helpers. The type alias KVIndexParam (KVIndex @getter) annotates constructor parameters used as indices.

nodes.name: KVStoreScalaSerializer
nodes.summary: KVStoreSerializer subclass that registers the Jackson Scala module, skips absent values and removes the maximum JSON string length, so Scala types can be stored in the KVStore as JSON.

nodes.name: MetadataMismatchException
nodes.summary: Exception thrown by open when the metadata found in a disk store differs from the expected metadata.

nodes.name: backend
nodes.summary: Chooses the disk backend: always ROCKSDB for the live UI, otherwise the HYBRID_STORE_DISK_BACKEND configuration value.

nodes.name: serializer
nodes.summary: Chooses the serializer: protobuf for the live UI, otherwise serializerForHistoryServer.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Opens or creates a LevelDB or RocksDB store at a path, writes the supplied metadata for a new store or throws MetadataMismatchException when it differs.

nodes.name: serializerForHistoryServer
nodes.summary: Returns a KVStoreScalaSerializer (JSON) or a KVStoreProtobufSerializer according to the LOCAL_STORE_SERIALIZER setting.

nodes.name: createKVStore
nodes.summary: Creates the store used by the app status layer: with a path it opens listing.ldb or listing.rdb carrying FsHistoryProviderMetadata, deleting and recreating the data on version mismatch or corruption; with no path it returns an InMemoryStore.

nodes.name: viewToSeq
nodes.summary: Three overloads that materialize a KVStoreView into a Scala List (with a filter and max, with a filter and slice, or unfiltered), always closing the iterator.

nodes.name: mapToSeq
nodes.summary: Maps every value of a KVStoreView through a function into a List, closing the iterator; used throughout AppStatusStore.

nodes.name: storeTypes.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the classes persisted in the status KVStore: wrapper classes that hold the public API objects (ApplicationInfo, JobData, StageData, ExecutorSummary ...) with @KVIndex-annotated key and index methods, the exploded TaskDataWrapper with its many secondary indices (TaskIndexNames), and helper entries such as AppSummary, CachedQuantile and the RDD operation graph wrappers.

nodes.name: AppStatusStoreMetadata
nodes.summary: Case class holding a single store version number.

nodes.name: ApplicationInfoWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps ApplicationInfo; its @KVIndex key is the application id.

nodes.name: ApplicationEnvironmentInfoWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps ApplicationEnvironmentInfo; there is one per application so its key is the class name.

nodes.name: ExecutorSummaryWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps ExecutorSummary; indexed by executor id, by 'active' flag and by host parsed from hostPort.

nodes.name: JobDataWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps JobData together with the set of skipped stage ids and the optional SQL execution id; indexed by job id and by completionTime.

nodes.name: StageDataWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps StageData with the owning job ids and a task locality summary; the key is the array (stageId, attemptId) with extra indices stageId, active and completionTime.

nodes.name: TaskIndexNames
nodes.summary: Constants naming every TaskDataWrapper index, mapped to short strings to save space in a disk store.

nodes.name: TaskDataWrapper
nodes.summary: Stores a task as exploded primitive fields instead of a TaskData object to save memory, with many secondary indices (parent 'stage') used for sorting in the UI. toApi rebuilds TaskData; metrics of non-successful tasks are stored encoded and decoded with getMetricValue.

nodes.name: RDDStorageInfoWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps RDDStorageInfo; indexed by RDD id and by a 'cached' flag.

nodes.name: ResourceProfileWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps ResourceProfileInfo; keyed by profile id.

nodes.name: ExecutorStageSummaryWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps ExecutorStageSummary; keyed by (stageId, stageAttemptId, executorId) with a 'stage' index.

nodes.name: SpeculationStageSummaryWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps SpeculationStageSummary; keyed by (stageId, stageAttemptId) with a 'stage' index.

nodes.name: StreamBlockData
nodes.summary: Describes a stream block (name, executor, storage level, sizes) stored directly in the KVStore keyed by (name, executorId).

nodes.name: RDDOperationClusterWrapper
nodes.summary: Serializable form of an RDD operation cluster with child nodes and child clusters; toRDDOperationCluster rebuilds the UI cluster and marks barrier mode.

nodes.name: RDDOperationGraphWrapper
nodes.summary: Stored form of a stage's RDD operation graph (edges plus root cluster), indexed by stageId; toRDDOperationGraph converts it back for the UI.

nodes.name: PoolData
nodes.summary: Scheduler pool entry holding the stage ids of a pool, indexed by pool name.

nodes.name: AppSummary
nodes.summary: Single per-application summary (completed jobs and stages) keyed by its class name, used by the UI.

nodes.name: CachedQuantile
nodes.summary: Cached view of one quantile of a stage attempt's task metric distribution, keyed by (stageId, stageAttemptId, quantile) with a taskCount used to validate the cache.

nodes.name: ProcessSummaryWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps ProcessSummary; indexed by id, 'active' flag and host.

nodes.name: getMetricValue
nodes.summary: Decodes a stored metric: for non-SUCCESS tasks returns abs(metric + 1), otherwise the raw value (SPARK-26260).

nodes.name: toApi
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the public TaskData (with TaskMetrics and read/write metric objects when hasMetrics) from the exploded wrapper fields.

nodes.name: schedulerDelay
nodes.summary: Index method computing the scheduler delay via AppStatusUtils, or -1 when the task has no metrics.

nodes.name: gettingResultTime
nodes.summary: Index method computing the getting-result time via AppStatusUtils, or -1 when the task has no metrics.

nodes.name: toRDDOperationCluster
