nodes.summary: Recursively converts the wrapper and its children into an RDDOperationCluster, appending barrier mode to the name when any child node is a barrier.

nodes.name: toRDDOperationGraph
nodes.summary: Builds an RDDOperationGraph from the stored edges and the converted root cluster.

nodes.name: api.scala
nodes.summary: Declares the public REST API data model of Spark's status API: ApplicationInfo, JobData, StageData, TaskData, ExecutorSummary, RDDStorageInfo, metric distribution classes, environment and thread dump classes. REST resources return these classes and Jackson turns them into JSON; the same objects are stored inside the *Wrapper classes of the KVStore.
nodes.languageNotes: Mostly plain Scala classes with private[spark] constructors and val fields (not case classes), so only Spark can create them; Jackson annotations handle custom (de)serialization of ExecutorMetrics.

nodes.name: ApplicationInfo
nodes.summary: Case class describing an application: id, name, core and memory settings and its list of attempts. It is what GET /applications and /applications/{appId} return.

nodes.name: ApplicationAttemptInfo
nodes.summary: Case class for one application attempt (attemptId, start/end/lastUpdated times, duration, sparkUser, completed flag, Spark version, log source); also exposes epoch-millisecond getters.

nodes.name: ResourceProfileInfo
nodes.summary: Resource profile id with its executor and task resource requests.

nodes.name: ExecutorStageSummary
nodes.summary: Per-executor aggregate for one stage (task time, task counts, input/output, shuffle, spill, excluded flag, peak memory metrics).

nodes.name: SpeculationStageSummary
nodes.summary: Counts of speculative tasks (total, active, completed, failed, killed) for a stage.

nodes.name: ExecutorSummary
nodes.summary: Summary of one executor or the driver: host, active flag, blocks, memory and disk use, cores, task counts, GC time, shuffle totals, logs, peak memory metrics, resources and exclusion state.

nodes.name: MemoryMetrics
nodes.summary: On-heap and off-heap storage memory used and total for an executor.

nodes.name: ExecutorMetricsJsonDeserializer
nodes.summary: Jackson deserializer that converts a JSON map of metric names to values back into an Option of ExecutorMetrics.

nodes.name: ExecutorMetricsJsonSerializer
nodes.summary: Jackson serializer that writes ExecutorMetrics as a map keyed by metric name, taken from ExecutorMetricType.metricToOffset, or null when absent.

nodes.name: ExecutorPeakMetricsDistributionsJsonSerializer
nodes.summary: Jackson serializer that writes ExecutorPeakMetricsDistributions as a map of metric name to its quantile distribution.

nodes.name: JobData
nodes.summary: REST view of a job: id, name, submission and completion time, stage ids, status and task and stage counters (active, completed, skipped, failed, killed).

nodes.name: RDDStorageInfo
nodes.summary: REST view of a cached RDD: id, name, partition counts, storage level, memory and disk use, plus optional data distribution and partitions.

nodes.name: RDDDataDistribution
nodes.summary: Memory and disk use of an RDD on one executor address, with on-heap and off-heap breakdown.

nodes.name: RDDPartitionInfo
nodes.summary: Storage level, memory and disk use and executors of one cached RDD block.

nodes.name: StageData
nodes.summary: REST view of a stage attempt: status, task counters, times, aggregated task and shuffle metrics, name and scheduling pool, and optional detail (tasks, executor summaries, speculation summary, metric distributions).

nodes.name: TaskData
nodes.summary: REST view of one task attempt: ids, launch time, duration, executor and host, status, locality, accumulators, error message, optional TaskMetrics, executor logs, scheduler delay and getting-result time.

nodes.name: TaskMetrics
nodes.summary: Per-task metrics: deserialize and run time, CPU time, result size, GC, spill, peak execution memory, and input, output, shuffle read and shuffle write sub-metrics.

nodes.name: InputMetrics
nodes.summary: Bytes and records read by a task.

nodes.name: OutputMetrics
nodes.summary: Bytes and records written by a task.

nodes.name: ShufflePushReadMetrics
nodes.summary: Push-based shuffle read counters of a task (merged blocks, chunks, bytes and fetch fallbacks).

nodes.name: ShuffleReadMetrics
nodes.summary: Shuffle read counters of a task (remote/local blocks, wait time, bytes, records) plus ShufflePushReadMetrics.

nodes.name: ShuffleWriteMetrics
nodes.summary: Shuffle write bytes, time and records of a task.

nodes.name: TaskMetricDistributions
nodes.summary: Quantile distributions of each task metric in a stage, with nested input, output, shuffle read and shuffle write distributions.

nodes.name: InputMetricDistributions
nodes.summary: Quantile distributions of input bytes and records.

nodes.name: OutputMetricDistributions
nodes.summary: Quantile distributions of output bytes and records.

nodes.name: ShufflePushReadMetricDistributions
nodes.summary: Quantile distributions of push-based shuffle read counters.

nodes.name: ExecutorMetricsDistributions
nodes.summary: Quantile distributions across a stage's executors of task time, task counts, input/output, shuffle, spill and peak memory metrics.

nodes.name: ExecutorPeakMetricsDistributions
nodes.summary: Holds the quantiles and the per-executor ExecutorMetrics and serializes through ExecutorPeakMetricsDistributionsJsonSerializer; getMetricDistribution computes one metric's quantile values.

nodes.name: ShuffleReadMetricDistributions
nodes.summary: Quantile distributions of shuffle read counters, including the push-based distributions.

nodes.name: ShuffleWriteMetricDistributions
nodes.summary: Quantile distributions of shuffle write bytes, records and time.

nodes.name: AccumulableInfo
nodes.summary: Accumulator id, name, last update and current value as strings.

nodes.name: VersionInfo
nodes.summary: Holds the Spark version string returned by GET /api/v1/version.

nodes.name: ApplicationEnvironmentInfo
nodes.summary: Runtime info plus Spark, Hadoop, system and metrics properties, classpath entries and resource profiles; the resource profiles are only added on the REST response and are not stored with it.

nodes.name: RuntimeInfo
nodes.summary: Java version, Java home and Scala version of the running application.

nodes.name: StackTrace
nodes.summary: Case class wrapping stack trace lines with toString, html and mkString renderings.

nodes.name: ThreadStackTrace
nodes.summary: Case class for one thread dump entry (id, name, state, stack trace, locks, monitors, daemon and priority); toString imitates the JDK ThreadInfo format.

nodes.name: ProcessSummary
nodes.summary: Summary of a miscellaneous process: id, host and port, active flag, cores, add and remove time and process logs.

nodes.name: deserialize
nodes.summary: Reads a map of metric name to Long and builds an ExecutorMetrics from it.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Writes each metric in ExecutorMetricType.metricToOffset with its value from ExecutorMetrics, or null when the option is empty.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Writes a map from metric name to getMetricDistribution for every ExecutorMetricType metric.

nodes.name: getMetricDistribution
nodes.summary: Sorts the metric values of all executors and returns the requested quantiles using getQuantilesValue.

nodes.name: html
nodes.summary: Renders the stack trace lines as an HTML NodeSeq with line breaks between lines.

nodes.name: toString
nodes.summary: Formats the thread dump entry like the JDK ThreadInfo string, with lock info, native/suspended flags and the stack lines.

nodes.name: ApiRootResource.scala
nodes.summary: Entry point of the JAX-RS REST API: ApiRootResource mounts /v1 with applications, applications/{appId} and version, and getServletHandler builds the Jersey servlet at context path /api. Also defines the UIRoot trait shared by the live SparkUI and the History Server, the BaseAppResource base trait that resolves an app's SparkUI and checks view permissions, and the error exceptions.

nodes.name: ApiRootResource
nodes.summary: Root JAX-RS resource at path /v1. Sub-resource locators: applications returns ApplicationListResource, applications/{appId} returns OneApplicationResource, and GET version returns the Spark version. The companion object builds the Jersey servlet handler mounted under /api.

nodes.name: UIRoot
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by every root container that exposes application info as JSON (the History Server and the live application UI): run code against an app/attempt SparkUI, list application infos, write event logs (only supported by the history server) and check view permissions.

nodes.name: UIRootFromServletContext
nodes.summary: Stores and retrieves the UIRoot as a servlet context attribute so JAX-RS resources can find it.

nodes.name: ApiRequestContext
nodes.summary: Trait injecting the ServletContext and HttpServletRequest into resources and exposing uiRoot.

nodes.name: BaseAppResource
nodes.summary: Base trait for resources with app-specific data: binds the appId and attemptId path parameters, finds the SparkUI via UIRoot.withSparkUI, enforces view permissions and maps missing apps to NotFoundException.

nodes.name: ForbiddenException
nodes.summary: WebApplicationException with HTTP 403 built through UIUtils.buildErrorResponse.

nodes.name: NotFoundException
nodes.summary: WebApplicationException with HTTP 404 built through UIUtils.buildErrorResponse.

nodes.name: ServiceUnavailable
nodes.summary: WebApplicationException with HTTP 503 built through UIUtils.buildErrorResponse.

nodes.name: BadParameterException
nodes.summary: WebApplicationException with HTTP 400; a second constructor formats a message from parameter name, expected type and actual value.

nodes.name: applicationList
nodes.summary: Sub-resource locator for path applications, returning ApplicationListResource.

nodes.name: application
nodes.summary: Sub-resource locator for path applications/{appId}, returning OneApplicationResource.

nodes.name: version
nodes.summary: GET /v1/version returning a VersionInfo with SPARK_VERSION.

nodes.name: getServletHandler
nodes.summary: Creates the Jersey ServletContextHandler at context path /api scanning the status.api.v1 package, and registers the UIRoot in it.

nodes.name: withSparkUI
nodes.summary: Abstract method running a function with the SparkUI for an app and optional attempt; throws NoSuchElementException when it does not exist.

nodes.name: writeEventLogs
nodes.summary: Default implementation that only builds a 503 response saying event logs are available through the history server.

nodes.name: checkUIViewPermissions
nodes.summary: Abstract check whether a user may view the given app/attempt UI.

nodes.name: setUiRoot
nodes.summary: Stores the UIRoot as an attribute of the servlet context handler.

nodes.name: getUiRoot
nodes.summary: Reads the UIRoot back from the servlet context attribute.

nodes.name: withUI
nodes.summary: Runs a function with the SparkUI of the requested app through UIRoot.withSparkUI after checking the remote user's view permission; unknown apps become NotFoundException.

nodes.name: checkUIViewPermissions
nodes.summary: Checks the remote user's view permission through UIRoot without loading the SparkUI; throws Forbidden or NotFound exceptions.

nodes.name: OneApplicationResource.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the per-application REST endpoints under /api/v1/applications/{appId}: jobs, executors, threads, stages, storage/rdd, environment, logs and an {attemptId} sub-resource. Handlers read data through withUI(_.store...) from AppStatusStore (live KVStore or one rebuilt by the history server) and apply redaction to the environment.

nodes.name: AbstractApplicationResource
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource (JSON) implementing the shared endpoints for an application: GET jobs, jobs/{jobId}, executors, executors/{executorId}/threads, threads, allexecutors, allmiscellaneousprocess, storage/rdd, storage/rdd/{rddId}, environment, logs, plus sub-resource stages (StagesResource) and a final {attemptId} locator. The same set is reused under /applications/{appId}/{attemptId}.

nodes.name: OneApplicationResource
nodes.summary: Concrete resource for /applications/{appId}: inherits all endpoints and adds GET returning the ApplicationInfo from UIRoot.

nodes.name: OneApplicationAttemptResource
nodes.summary: Concrete resource for /applications/{appId}/{attemptId}: inherits all endpoints and adds GET returning the matching ApplicationAttemptInfo.

nodes.name: jobsList
nodes.summary: GET jobs: returns the job list from AppStatusStore.jobsList, filtered by the repeated status query parameter.

nodes.name: oneJob
nodes.summary: GET jobs/{jobId}: returns one job via AppStatusStore.job or a 404 with 'unknown job'.

nodes.name: executorList
nodes.summary: GET executors: returns only active executors from AppStatusStore.executorList(true).

nodes.name: threadDump
nodes.summary: GET executors/{executorId}/threads: validates the executor id, then asks the live SparkContext for the thread dump of an active executor; unavailable for inactive or unknown executors.

nodes.name: getTaskThreadDump
nodes.summary: GET threads: returns the thread dump of a running task identified by taskId and executorId through SparkContext.

nodes.name: allExecutorList
nodes.summary: GET allexecutors: returns active and dead executors from AppStatusStore.executorList(false).

nodes.name: allProcessList
nodes.summary: GET allmiscellaneousprocess: returns all ProcessSummary entries.

nodes.name: stages
nodes.summary: Sub-resource locator for path stages, returning StagesResource.

nodes.name: rddList
nodes.summary: GET storage/rdd: lists cached RDDs from AppStatusStore.rddList().

nodes.name: rddData
nodes.summary: GET storage/rdd/{rddId}: returns one RDDStorageInfo or a 404.

nodes.name: environmentInfo
nodes.summary: GET environment: builds ApplicationEnvironmentInfo from the store and redacts and sorts Spark, Hadoop, system and metrics properties and the classpath, adding resource profiles.

nodes.name: getEventLogs
nodes.summary: GET logs: streams a zip of the event logs from UIRoot.writeEventLogs as an attachment; retries with attemptId 1 for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: applicationAttempt
nodes.summary: Last sub-resource locator, for path {attemptId}, returning OneApplicationAttemptResource (404 if the attemptId is already set).

nodes.name: checkExecutorId
nodes.summary: Validates that an executor id is the driver or numeric, otherwise throws BadParameterException.

nodes.name: checkAndGetSparkContext
nodes.summary: Returns the live SparkContext from the SparkUI or a 503 saying thread dumps are not available through the history server.

nodes.name: getApp
nodes.summary: GET: returns the ApplicationInfo for appId from UIRoot.getApplicationInfo or a 404.

nodes.name: getAttempt
nodes.summary: GET: finds the attempt with the requested attemptId inside the ApplicationInfo or returns a 404.

nodes.name: JettyUtils.scala
nodes.summary: Jetty glue for the Spark web UIs. JettyUtils builds servlet, redirect, static-file and proxy context handlers and starts the Jetty server (with optional SSL and an HTTP to HTTPS redirect); ServerInfo wraps the running server so handlers can be added and removed behind the UI filters and the security filter.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala file with a utility object, a case class and two private helper classes that extend Jetty/servlet types.

nodes.name: JettyUtils
nodes.summary: Object of static helpers for the web UI server. It turns responders (HttpServletRequest => JValue/Seq[Node]/String) into servlets through implicit conversions, builds ServletContextHandlers for pages, redirects, static resources and reverse proxying, and starts Jetty on a free port.

nodes.name: ServletParams
nodes.summary: Parameter holder pairing a responder function with a content type and a function that turns the result into the response string; the implicit converters in JettyUtils create it for JSON, HTML and plain-text responders.

nodes.name: ServerInfo
nodes.summary: Case class describing a started Jetty server (server, bound port, optional secure port). addHandler wraps a ServletContextHandler in a CompressionHandler, applies the configured UI filters plus the HttpSecurityFilter and registers it on the root handler collection; removeHandler and stop undo that.

nodes.name: ProxyRedirectHandler
nodes.summary: Private Jetty Handler.Wrapper installed as the server handler when a proxy redirect URI is configured; it rewrites Location headers of redirects so they point at the proxy server, using UIUtils.uiRoot for the proxy base.

nodes.name: HttpsRedirectFilter
nodes.summary: Private servlet Filter that redirects non-secure requests to the HTTPS port, rebuilding the URI with IPv6 host handling and decoding the request URI and query string first to avoid double encoding.

nodes.name: createServlet
nodes.summary: Builds an HttpServlet from ServletParams: doGet sets the content type, runs the responder and writes the result, maps IllegalArgumentException to a 400 error, logs and rethrows other exceptions, and rejects TRACE (SPARK-5983).

nodes.name: createServletHandler
nodes.summary: Two overloads. The first wraps a responder (ServletParams) in a servlet via createServlet; the second mounts any HttpServlet on a ServletContextHandler at basePath + path. This is how WebUI pages become Jetty context handlers.

nodes.name: createRedirectHandler
nodes.summary: Creates a handler that redirects srcPath to destPath (prefixed by basePath) for the allowed HTTP methods (GET by default), running an optional beforeRedirect callback; SparkUI uses it for the root redirect and the job and stage kill links.

nodes.name: createStaticHandler
nodes.summary: Creates a ServletContextHandler with a DefaultServlet that serves static files from a classpath resource base, throwing if the resource path cannot be found.

nodes.name: createProxyHandler
nodes.summary: Creates a /proxy handler built on Jetty ProxyServlet that maps the first path segment to a UI address through idToUiAddress, rewrites the target and fixes Location headers of proxied responses.

nodes.name: startJettyServer
nodes.summary: Starts a Jetty Server on a daemon QueuedThreadPool: configures the error handler, the ContextHandlerCollection (wrapped in ProxyRedirectHandler when a proxy redirect URI is set), an optional SSL connector, the HTTP connector (which redirects to HTTPS when SSL is on), and returns a ServerInfo; on failure it stops what it started.

nodes.name: createRedirectHttpsHandler
nodes.summary: Builds the context handler bound to the redirect connector that installs an HttpsRedirectFilter for all paths.

nodes.name: createProxyURI
nodes.summary: Builds the target URI for a proxied request from the proxy prefix, the target base address, the request path and the query string, returning null if the path does not start with the prefix.

nodes.name: createProxyLocationHeader
nodes.summary: Rewrites a Location header returned by a proxied server so that it points back to the /proxy/<id> URL on the client-facing host.

nodes.name: addFilter
nodes.summary: Adds a named filter class with init parameters to a ServletContextHandler for all paths and dispatcher types.

nodes.name: toVirtualHosts
nodes.summary: Converts connector names into Jetty virtual host strings ("@name") used to bind handlers to specific connectors.

nodes.name: addHandler
nodes.summary: Registers a ServletContextHandler on the running server: binds it to the Spark connector, adds the configured and security filters, wraps it in a CompressionHandler, adds it to the root collection and starts both.

nodes.name: removeHandler
nodes.summary: Finds the CompressionHandler wrapping the given handler, removes and stops it, then stops the handler itself if it is running.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops the Jetty server and its thread pool, working around the QueuedThreadPool idle-timeout issue (SPARK-30385).

nodes.name: addFilters
nodes.summary: Applies filters from the spark.ui.filters setting (with their params) to a handler and always appends the HttpSecurityFilter last so it runs after user-installed authentication filters.

nodes.name: doFilter
nodes.summary: Filter entry point: for non-secure requests, sends a redirect to the HTTPS URI built by createRedirectURI.

nodes.name: createRedirectURI
nodes.summary: Builds the HTTPS redirect URI from scheme, secure port and the current request, bracketing IPv6 hosts and decoding the URI and query before re-encoding.

nodes.name: SparkUI.scala
nodes.summary: Defines SparkUI, the top-level web UI of a Spark application, and SparkUITab, the base class of its tabs. SparkUI extends WebUI, attaches the Jobs, Stages, Storage, Environment and Executors tabs plus REST and static handlers, and reads all page data from an AppStatusStore.
nodes.languageNotes: Companion object SparkUI holds the static resource directory and the create factory; the class constructor is private.

nodes.name: SparkUI
nodes.summary: Top-level UI of a Spark application: extends WebUI and the UIRoot trait, takes an AppStatusStore, optional SparkContext and SecurityManager. It starts with an "Spark is starting up" placeholder handler, builds all tabs in initialize(), and later swaps in the real handlers via attachAllHandlers. The companion object provides STATIC_RESOURCE_DIR, getUIPort and the create factory.

nodes.name: SparkUITab
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for the application UI tabs; it extends WebUITab and exposes the parent SparkUI values pages need (appName, appSparkVersion, sparkUser and appStartTime from the status store).

nodes.name: attachAllHandlers
nodes.summary: Removes the startup placeholder handler from the running server, attaches all handlers collected so far, and marks the UI ready so later handlers attach immediately.

nodes.name: attachHandler
nodes.summary: Overrides WebUI.attachHandler: records the handler but only registers it on the server once readyToAttachHandlers is true.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Builds the UI: attaches the JobsTab, StagesTab, StorageTab, EnvironmentTab, an optional DriverLogTab (and /log handler) and the ExecutorsTab, then adds the static resource handler, the "/" to "/jobs/" redirect, the REST API handler, an optional Prometheus handler and the job and stage kill redirect handlers.

nodes.name: getSparkUser
nodes.summary: Returns the Spark user from the first application attempt in the store, falling back to the user.name system property or "<unknown>".

nodes.name: bind
nodes.summary: Overrides WebUI.bind: starts the Jetty server and mounts only the startup placeholder handler; real handlers are attached later by attachAllHandlers once the application is fully started.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops the server through WebUI.stop and logs the stopped web UI URL.

nodes.name: getApplicationInfoList
nodes.summary: Builds a single-element ApplicationInfo (with one running attempt) describing the live application, with an overload that filters it and takes at most max entries; used through the UIRoot interface by REST handlers.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Factory in the SparkUI companion object that constructs a SparkUI backed by an AppStatusStore (the class constructor is private).

nodes.name: WebUI.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the generic web UI hierarchy: WebUI (server owner holding tabs and handlers), WebUITab (a group of pages under a prefix), WebUIPage (a leaf page with render and renderJson) and DelegatingServletContextHandler. Attaching a page creates Jetty handlers through JettyUtils.

nodes.name: WebUI
nodes.summary: Abstract top-level UI component that owns the Jetty server, a list of tabs and the servlet handlers. attachTab/attachPage turn pages into /prefix and /prefix/json handlers via JettyUtils.createServletHandler; bind starts the server and attaches the collected handlers.

nodes.name: WebUITab
nodes.summary: Abstract tab: a prefix plus a list of pages. attachPage prefixes the page path with the tab prefix, and headerTabs returns the parent UI tabs sorted by displayOrder for the navigation bar.

nodes.name: WebUIPage
nodes.summary: Abstract leaf page of the UI hierarchy: render(request) returns an XML node sequence for HTML and renderJson(request) returns JSON (JNothing by default).

nodes.name: DelegatingServletContextHandler
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over a ServletContextHandler exposing prependFilterMapping, addFilter, filterCount and getContextPath.

nodes.name: attachTab
nodes.summary: Attaches every page of the tab to this UI and records the tab.

nodes.name: attachPage
nodes.summary: Creates two servlet handlers for the page (HTML from page.render at /prefix and JSON from page.renderJson at /prefix/json) with createServletHandler, attaches them and remembers them per page.

nodes.name: attachHandler
nodes.summary: Two overloads that register a ServletContextHandler (or a servlet at a context path and path spec) and add it to the running server through ServerInfo.addHandler if the server exists.

nodes.name: detachHandler
nodes.summary: Two overloads that remove a handler (or the handler mounted at a context path) from this UI and from the running server.

nodes.name: addStaticHandler
nodes.summary: Attaches a static resource handler, built with JettyUtils.createStaticHandler, at /static by default.

nodes.name: initServer
nodes.summary: Chooses the bind host (SPARK_LOCAL_IP or a wildcard address) and starts the Jetty server through JettyUtils.startJettyServer.

nodes.name: bind
nodes.summary: Binds to the HTTP server once: starts it with initServer, adds all collected handlers, records the ServerInfo and logs the web URL; exits the JVM on failure.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops the server behind this UI (asserts it was bound).

nodes.name: attachPage
nodes.summary: Prepends the tab prefix to the page prefix and adds the page to the tab.

nodes.name: headerTabs
nodes.summary: Returns the parent UI tabs sorted by displayOrder, used to render the navigation header.

nodes.name: ExecutorsTab.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the Executors tab of the Spark UI. ExecutorsTab attaches ExecutorsPage and, when enabled in the config, thread dump and heap histogram pages; ExecutorsPage emits a mostly empty shell that the executorspage.js module fills in the browser.

nodes.name: ExecutorsTab
nodes.summary: SparkUITab with prefix "executors". Its init() reads the thread dump and heap histogram settings (enabled only when a SparkContext is present) and attaches ExecutorsPage plus the optional ExecutorThreadDumpPage and ExecutorHeapHistogramPage.

nodes.name: ExecutorsPage
nodes.summary: WebUIPage at the root of the Executors tab. render returns an "active-executors" div, an offcanvas detail panel and module script tags (utils.js, executorspage.js) with a small inline script, wrapped by UIUtils.headerSparkPage with DataTables enabled.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Attaches the executors page and conditionally the thread dump and heap histogram pages.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Builds the page content (container div, offcanvas panel, script tags and an inline module script that passes the thread dump and heap histogram flags to executorspage.js) and wraps it with UIUtils.headerSparkPage.

nodes.name: JobsTab.scala
nodes.summary: Defines JobsTab, the Jobs tab of the Spark UI. It attaches AllJobsPage and JobPage, tells whether the fair scheduler is in use, and handles the job kill request by cancelling a running job through the SparkContext.

nodes.name: JobsTab
nodes.summary: SparkUITab with prefix "jobs" that attaches AllJobsPage and JobPage, exposes the SparkContext, conf and killEnabled of the parent SparkUI, and reads scheduling-mode information from the AppStatusStore.

nodes.name: isFairScheduler
nodes.summary: True only for a live UI (SparkContext present) whose stored spark properties show the FAIR scheduler mode.

nodes.name: handleKillRequest
nodes.summary: Handles the job kill link: if kill is enabled and the user has modify permission, looks up the job by the id parameter in the store and, if RUNNING, calls SparkContext.cancelJob then sleeps 100 ms so the refreshed page shows it as killed.

nodes.name: UIUtils.scala
nodes.summary: Utility object used by every Spark web UI page: formatting of dates, durations and numbers, base-URI handling, the shared HTML page skeletons (headerSparkPage, basicSparkPage), listing tables, progress bars, DAG visualization markup, tooltips and safe job description rendering.
nodes.languageNotes: Pages are built with Scala XML literals; expressions inside braces are embedded into the generated HTML.

nodes.name: UIUtils
nodes.summary: Singleton of helper functions for generating XML/HTML pages with Spark content. It defines the table CSS classes, the header node groups (common, timeline, DAG viz, DataTables), the page frames used by all tabs, and formatting and escaping helpers.

nodes.name: formatDate
nodes.summary: Formats a Date or an epoch-millisecond timestamp as yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss in the system time zone.

nodes.name: formatDuration
nodes.summary: Formats a millisecond duration as a short string: "N ms" below 100 ms, then seconds, minutes (one decimal under 10 min) and hours.

nodes.name: formatDurationVerbose
nodes.summary: Formats a duration as a verbose string such as "5 second 35 ms" using year, week, day, hour, minute and second units; returns an empty string on error.

nodes.name: formatBatchTime
nodes.summary: Formats a batch time with or without milliseconds depending on the batch interval, optionally dropping the yyyy/MM/dd part.

nodes.name: formatNumber
nodes.summary: Formats a number as a human-readable string with T, B, M or K suffixes once it reaches twice the unit size.

nodes.name: uiRoot
nodes.summary: Overloads returning the UI base path used when the UI sits behind a proxy: spark.ui.proxyBase system property, then APPLICATION_WEB_PROXY_BASE, then the Knox X-Forwarded-Context header, else an empty string.

nodes.name: prependBaseUri
nodes.summary: Builds a link by concatenating the UI root, a base path and a resource; every static asset and page link in the headers uses it.

nodes.name: commonHeaderNodes
nodes.summary: Returns the meta, stylesheet and script tags shared by all pages (Bootstrap, jQuery, sorttable, webui.js and others) plus an inline setUIRoot script guarded by a CSP nonce.

nodes.name: timelineHeaderNodes
nodes.summary: Returns the stylesheet and script tags for the vis timeline library and timeline-view.js, added to pages that draw event timelines.

nodes.name: headerSparkPage
nodes.summary: Builds the full application page: head with common (and optional visualization, DataTables, timeline) headers, a navbar listing the parent UI tabs with the active tab highlighted, the app name, an optional help tooltip, the page content and the footer.

nodes.name: basicSparkPage
nodes.summary: Builds a simpler page frame with the Spark CSS/JS, logo, version and title but no tab navigation; its comment says it is used for the scheduler UI.

nodes.name: sparkFooter
nodes.summary: Builds the page footer with the Spark version, the application start time (and an uptime span) and the user name.

nodes.name: listingTable
nodes.summary: Generic HTML table builder: renders the header row (with optional classes, widths and tooltips) and one row per item produced by generateDataRow, with optional striping and sortable CSS classes.

nodes.name: makeProgressBar
nodes.summary: Builds the stacked progress bar for jobs and stages from started, completed, failed, skipped and killed counts, with a label and a hover title that lists failed, skipped and kill reasons.

nodes.name: showDagVizForJob
nodes.summary: Returns the expandable DAG Visualization element for a job from its RDDOperationGraphs (showDagVizForStage is the single-stage variant).

nodes.name: showDagViz
nodes.summary: Private builder of the "DAG Visualization" element: emits per-stage metadata divs holding the dot file, incoming and outgoing edges and the cached, barrier and indeterminate RDD ids that spark-dag-viz.js reads.

nodes.name: tooltipSpan
nodes.summary: Wraps content in a span carrying a Bootstrap 5 tooltip.

nodes.name: tooltipLink
nodes.summary: Wraps content in an anchor carrying a Bootstrap 5 tooltip.

nodes.name: makeDescription
nodes.summary: Renders a job or stage description: parses it as XML, accepts only a, span and br tags with class/href attributes and root-relative links, prefixes links with basePathUri (or strips tags when plainText), and falls back to escaped text otherwise.

nodes.name: decodeURLParameter
nodes.summary: Repeatedly URL-decodes a parameter until it stops changing (for values encoded by the YARN web app proxy); an overload does the same for a multivalued parameter map.

nodes.name: durationDataPadding
nodes.summary: Pads batch duration data so each batch has an entry for every duration label (missing labels become 0).

nodes.name: detailsUINode
nodes.summary: Returns the "+details" toggle and collapsed stack-trace block for multiline messages, or nothing for single-line ones.

nodes.name: errorSummary
nodes.summary: Derives a short summary of an error message (error class in brackets, text before the first newline or colon, or the whole message) and whether the message is multiline.

nodes.name: errorMessageCell
nodes.summary: Builds a table cell with the error summary and its expandable details.

nodes.name: logPageOnloadScript
nodes.summary: Builds the inline window.onload initLogPage(...) script for log pages, escaping the already URL-encoded log parameters for the JavaScript string.

nodes.name: formatImportJavaScript
nodes.summary: Builds a JavaScript import statement for named methods from a static module path under the UI root.

nodes.name: AllJobsPage.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the Jobs page of the Spark UI (AllJobsPage) and its table support classes. The page lists active, completed and failed jobs in paged tables and, when enabled, shows an event timeline of jobs and executor add/remove events.

nodes.name: AllJobsPage
nodes.summary: Page showing the list of ongoing and recently finished jobs. render reads jobs, application info, executors and environment info from the AppStatusStore, shows scheduling mode and counts of active, completed and failed jobs, an optional event timeline, and one collapsible table per status.

nodes.name: JobTableRowData
nodes.summary: Row model holding a JobData together with the precomputed last stage name and description, duration, submission time, description markup and detail URL.

nodes.name: JobDataSource
nodes.summary: PagedDataSource that converts jobs to JobTableRowData once, sorts them by the requested column (Job Id, Description, Submitted or Duration; stage and task progress columns are unsortable) and slices pages.

nodes.name: JobPagedTable
nodes.summary: PagedTable of jobs: reads sort, page size and page parameters from the request, builds page links, table headers (Job Id, Description, Submitted, Duration, Stages, Tasks) and each row with kill link, detail link and a task progress bar.

nodes.name: makeJobEvent
nodes.summary: Builds timeline item strings for jobs with a known status and submission time: the most recent MAX_TIMELINE_JOBS ones, with a class by status (succeeded, failed, running), start and end times and an escaped tooltip.

nodes.name: makeExecutorEvent
nodes.summary: Builds timeline item strings for executor added and removed events (with the removal reason) for the most recent MAX_TIMELINE_EXECUTORS executors.

nodes.name: makeTimeline
nodes.summary: Builds the application Event Timeline section: the executors and jobs groups with legends, a note when events are truncated, a zoom checkbox, and a script calling drawApplicationTimeline; returns nothing when the timeline is disabled.

nodes.name: jobsTable
nodes.summary: Creates the paged job table for one status (JobPagedTable, current page from the request) or an error alert if rendering fails.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the Spark Jobs page: splits jobs into active, completed and failed, builds the summary list, the event timeline and a collapsible table for each non-empty group, then wraps it with headerSparkPage including help text and timeline assets.

nodes.name: jobRow
nodes.summary: Converts a JobData into a JobTableRowData, using the last stage name and description as fallback description and building the detail URL.

nodes.name: ordering
nodes.summary: Returns the Ordering for the sort column and direction, throwing IllegalArgumentException for unsortable or unknown columns.

nodes.name: headers
nodes.summary: Defines the job table headers (title, sortable flag, tooltip) and builds the header row.

nodes.name: row
nodes.summary: Renders one job row: id with job group, description with optional kill link and name link, submitted time, duration, stage progress and a progress bar of tasks.

nodes.name: JobPage.scala
nodes.summary: Defines JobPage, the "Details for Job" page of the Spark UI. It shows job status, timing, associated SQL query, a stage event timeline, the job DAG visualization and tables of active, pending or skipped, completed and failed stages.

nodes.name: JobPage
nodes.summary: WebUIPage with prefix "job" that renders statistics and the stage list of one job (id request parameter). It reads the job and its stages from the AppStatusStore, groups stages by state and renders them with StageTableBase.

nodes.name: makeStageEvent
nodes.summary: Builds timeline item strings for stages (the most recent MAX_TIMELINE_STAGES) with status class, start and end time and an escaped tooltip.

nodes.name: makeExecutorEvent
nodes.summary: Builds timeline item strings for executor added and removed events for the job timeline.

nodes.name: makeTimeline
nodes.summary: Builds the job Event Timeline section with executors and stages groups, legends, truncation notes and a script calling drawJobTimeline; empty when the timeline is disabled.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the job details: loads the job and associated SQL execution id (or a "no information" page), fetches each stage (substituting a placeholder PENDING StageData if missing), splits them into active, pending or skipped, completed and failed, and builds the summary list, timeline, DAG visualization and stage tables.

nodes.name: StagePage.scala
nodes.summary: Defines StagePage, the "Details for Stage" page, and the ApiHelper object with table header names, sort column mapping and helper predicates shared by the jobs and stages pages. The page shows a stage summary, DAG visualization and a paged task event timeline, and loads stagepage.js for the rest.

nodes.name: StagePage
nodes.summary: WebUIPage with prefix "stage" for one stage attempt (id and attempt parameters). It reads the stage, locality summary and tasks from the AppStatusStore, renders a summary list, the DAG visualization, a "showAdditionalMetrics" placeholder and the task event timeline, and adds module scripts (utils.js, stagepage.js).

nodes.name: ApiHelper
nodes.summary: Object with the task table header labels, COLUMN_TO_INDEX (header to TaskIndexNames mapping), predicates such as hasInput, hasOutput, hasShuffleRead, hasShuffleWrite and hasBytesSpilled, and lastStageNameAndDescription for job rows.

nodes.name: getLocalitySummaryString
nodes.summary: Formats the per-locality task counts (Process local, Node local, Rack local, Any) as a sorted "name: count" string.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the stage page: validates id and attempt parameters, loads the stage (or shows "No information"/"No tasks have started yet"), clamps the timeline paging, builds the summary list (submitted, duration, resource profile id, total task time, locality, input, output, shuffle and spill sizes, associated job ids), the DAG visualization, the timeline and the script container.

nodes.name: makeTimeline
nodes.summary: Builds the task assignment Event Timeline for one page of tasks: per task it computes proportions of scheduler delay, deserialization, shuffle read, executor computing, shuffle write, serialization and getting-result time as SVG bars, groups by executor, adds a paging form and calls drawTaskAssignmentTimeline.

nodes.name: indexName
nodes.summary: Maps a task table sort column to its TaskIndexNames store index, throwing IllegalArgumentException for invalid columns.

nodes.name: lastStageNameAndDescription
nodes.summary: Returns the name and description of the job last stage (highest stage id, attempt 0), falling back to the job name.

nodes.name: SQLAppStatusListener.scala
nodes.summary: Spark listener that turns scheduler and SQL events into the SQL tab state. It reacts to SparkListenerSQLExecutionStart/End, adaptive plan updates, driver accumulator updates, job, stage and task events, and keeps a live SQLExecutionUIData per execution in an ElementTrackingStore. Per-task SQL metric values are tracked in LiveStageMetrics and aggregated per accumulator id into display strings.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala pattern matching on case class events in onOtherEvent; the private companion object (lines 633-635) only defines UNKNOWN_INDEX.

nodes.name: SQLAppStatusListener
nodes.summary: SparkListener that maintains SQL execution state. It tracks live executions and per-stage metrics in concurrent maps, writes SQLExecutionUIData (and the plan graph) to the store, and removes the oldest completed executions once the retained-executions limit is exceeded. A live flag controls whether intermediate state is flushed periodically or only written at the end (log replay). The private companion object (lines 633-635) holds UNKNOWN_INDEX = -1.

nodes.name: LiveExecutionData
nodes.summary: Mutable in-memory record of one SQL execution (description, plan text, metrics, jobs, stages, driver accumulator updates, completion info and aggregated metric strings). It extends LiveEntity and converts itself to an immutable SQLExecutionUIData in doUpdate. endEvents counts job and execution end events so the listener knows when to stop tracking.

nodes.name: LiveStageMetrics
nodes.summary: Per-stage, per-attempt store of SQL metric values reported by tasks. For every accumulator id it keeps an array with one slot per task index (so speculative duplicates do not double count), ignores updates for already-completed indices, and tracks the maximum value and its task id for metrics that need a max.

nodes.name: onJobStart
nodes.summary: For jobs that carry a SQL execution id, finds or restores the LiveExecutionData (reading an existing SQLExecutionUIData from the store if present), creates LiveStageMetrics for each stage when metrics exist, marks the job RUNNING and records its stages.

nodes.name: onStageSubmitted
nodes.summary: Resets the LiveStageMetrics object when a new attempt of a SQL stage is submitted.

nodes.name: onJobEnd
nodes.summary: Records SUCCEEDED or FAILED for the job in every execution that owns it, increments the end-event count and updates the execution.

nodes.name: onExecutorMetricsUpdate
nodes.summary: Forwards in-flight task accumulator updates from executor heartbeats to the matching stage metrics.

nodes.name: onTaskStart
nodes.summary: Registers the task id and index with the stage metrics for the current attempt.

nodes.name: onTaskEnd
nodes.summary: On task end, takes accumulator updates from the live task metrics (via withExternalAccums) or from the event-log accumulables and passes them to updateStageMetrics together with the success flag.

nodes.name: liveExecutionMetrics
nodes.summary: Returns the aggregated metric strings of a live execution, reusing stored values if present or aggregating now; used by the status store for running queries.

nodes.name: aggregateMetrics
nodes.summary: Aggregates SQL metrics per accumulator id. It chooses an aggregation function per metric (a custom V2 metric class loaded by name, or MetricUtils.stringValue for built-in SQLMetric types), concatenates task values from all stages, appends driver-side values, tracks the max task value across stages, and returns a Map from accumulator id to a display string.

nodes.name: updateStageMetrics
nodes.summary: Applies a task's accumulator updates to the LiveStageMetrics for that stage when the attempt id matches.

nodes.name: toStoredNodes
nodes.summary: Recursively converts SparkPlanGraphNode and SparkPlanGraphCluster values into storable SparkPlanGraphNodeWrapper objects.

nodes.name: onExecutionStart
nodes.summary: Handles SparkListenerSQLExecutionStart: builds the SparkPlanGraph from the SparkPlanInfo, collects its SQLPlanMetrics by accumulator id, writes the graph wrapper to the store, and fills the LiveExecutionData fields (description, details, plan text, configs, submission time).

nodes.name: onAdaptiveExecutionUpdate
nodes.summary: Handles an adaptive execution plan update: rebuilds and stores the plan graph, adds any new metrics and replaces the physical plan description.

nodes.name: onAdaptiveSQLMetricUpdate
nodes.summary: Adds the SQLPlanMetric entries from SparkListenerSQLAdaptiveSQLMetricUpdates to the execution.

nodes.name: onExecutionEnd
nodes.summary: Handles SparkListenerSQLExecutionEnd: sets completion time and error message, then asynchronously aggregates the final metrics, cleans stale stage data, bumps the end-event count and force-writes the execution.

nodes.name: removeStaleMetricsData
nodes.summary: Drops LiveStageMetrics objects for stages that no other live execution uses.

nodes.name: onDriverAccumUpdates
nodes.summary: Appends driver-side accumulator updates (SparkListenerDriverAccumUpdates) to the live execution.

nodes.name: onOtherEvent
nodes.summary: Dispatches SQL-specific events (execution start, adaptive plan and metric updates, execution end, driver accumulator updates) to their handlers and ignores all other events.

nodes.name: getOrCreateExecution
nodes.summary: Returns the LiveExecutionData for an execution id, creating it atomically if missing.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Writes the execution to the store: finishes and removes it once all job and execution end events arrived, force-writes on request, otherwise writes only if the live update period has elapsed.

nodes.name: isSQLStage
nodes.summary: True if any live execution contains the given stage id.

nodes.name: cleanupExecutions
nodes.summary: Deletes the oldest completed executions and their plan graphs when the stored count exceeds the retained-executions limit.

nodes.name: doUpdate
nodes.summary: Creates an immutable SQLExecutionUIData snapshot from the current mutable fields.

nodes.name: addMetrics
nodes.summary: Appends SQLPlanMetric entries and records each accumulator id to metric type mapping.

nodes.name: registerTask
nodes.summary: Remembers which task index a task id belongs to.

nodes.name: updateTaskMetrics
nodes.summary: Stores a task's metric values in the slot of its task index (parsing String values from event logs as Long), updates the max value and task id for metrics that need a max, and marks the index complete when the task succeeded.

nodes.name: metricValues
nodes.summary: Returns the per-accumulator arrays of task values for this stage.

nodes.name: maxMetricValues
nodes.summary: Returns (accumulator id, max value, task id, stage id, attempt id) tuples for metrics that track a max.

nodes.name: SQLAppStatusStore.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the stored data model and read-only view for the SQL tab. SQLAppStatusStore queries a KVStore for SQLExecutionUIData, plan graphs and metric values (falling back to the live listener for running queries). The file also declares SQLExecutionUIData, SQLPlanMetric and the wrapper classes used to persist a SparkPlanGraph.

nodes.name: SQLAppStatusStore
nodes.summary: Stateless view over a KVStore with SQL-specific queries: list or count executions, read one execution, read the plan graph, and get metric values. executionMetrics reads the stored aggregated values first and, for running executions, asks the SQLAppStatusListener.

nodes.name: SQLExecutionUIData
nodes.summary: Stored record for one SQL execution: ids, description, details, physical plan text, modified configs, SQLPlanMetric list, submission and completion times, error message, job statuses, stage ids, aggregated metricValues (only filled after the execution ends) and an optional queryId. executionStatus derives RUNNING, COMPLETED or FAILED.

nodes.name: SparkPlanGraphWrapper
nodes.summary: Persistable form of a SparkPlanGraph keyed by execution id; holds node wrappers and edges and converts back with toSparkPlanGraph.

nodes.name: SparkPlanGraphClusterWrapper
nodes.summary: Persistable form of a SparkPlanGraphCluster (id, name, description, child node wrappers and metrics) that can rebuild the cluster.

nodes.name: SparkPlanGraphNodeWrapper
nodes.summary: Holder for either a plain node or a cluster wrapper (exactly one must be set), so mixed node types can be stored and restored.

nodes.name: SQLPlanMetric
nodes.summary: Case class naming one metric of a plan node: display name, accumulator id and metric type. The accumulator id is the key under which task values are aggregated.

nodes.name: executionsList
nodes.summary: Returns all stored SQLExecutionUIData, or a page of them when offset and length are given (two overloads).

nodes.name: execution
nodes.summary: Reads one SQLExecutionUIData by id, returning None if it is not in the store.

nodes.name: executionMetrics
nodes.summary: Returns the metric id to display-string map for an execution: from the store if aggregated, else from the live listener, with a second store read in case the execution just finished.

nodes.name: planGraph
nodes.summary: Reads the stored SparkPlanGraphWrapper for an execution and converts it to a SparkPlanGraph.

nodes.name: executionStatus
nodes.summary: Computes COMPLETED, FAILED or RUNNING from the error message, completion time and job statuses (to handle event logs from old versions).

nodes.name: toSparkPlanGraph
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a SparkPlanGraph from the stored node wrappers and edges.

nodes.name: toSparkPlanGraphCluster
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a SparkPlanGraphCluster with its child nodes from the wrapper.

nodes.name: toSparkPlanGraphNode
nodes.summary: Returns the plain node, or the rebuilt cluster, after asserting exactly one of them is set.

nodes.name: SQLListener.scala
nodes.summary: Declares the SQL-specific scheduler events that SQLAppStatusListener consumes (SparkListenerSQLExecutionStart/End, adaptive plan and metric updates, driver accumulator updates) as @DeveloperApi case classes extending SparkListenerEvent, plus a Jackson converter for Long pairs.

nodes.name: SparkListenerSQLAdaptiveExecutionUpdate
nodes.summary: Event announcing an updated adaptive plan: execution id, physical plan description and the new SparkPlanInfo.

nodes.name: SparkListenerSQLAdaptiveSQLMetricUpdates
nodes.summary: Event carrying additional SQLPlanMetric entries for an execution under adaptive execution.

nodes.name: SparkListenerSQLExecutionStart
nodes.summary: Event posted when a SQL execution starts: execution id, optional root execution id, description, details, physical plan text, SparkPlanInfo, start time, modified configs, job tags, job group id and an optional queryId.

nodes.name: SparkListenerSQLExecutionEnd
nodes.summary: Event posted when a SQL execution ends: id, end time, optional error message (empty string means success) and queryId. Extra JSON-ignored fields hold the execution name, duration, QueryExecution and failure for in-process listeners.

nodes.name: SparkListenerDriverAccumUpdates
nodes.summary: Event that updates SQL metric values for driver-side accumulators: an execution id and (accumulator id, value) pairs, deserialized with LongLongTupleConverter.

nodes.name: LongLongTupleConverter
nodes.summary: Jackson Converter that turns a deserialized pair of Integer or Long objects into a (Long, Long) tuple, working around primitive deserialization limits (SPARK-18462).

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Converts each element of the pair from Integer or Long to Long.

nodes.name: getInputType
nodes.summary: Declares the Jackson input type as a tuple of Objects.

nodes.name: getOutputType
nodes.summary: Declares the Jackson output type as a tuple of Longs.

nodes.name: StageTable.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the table that lists stages in the Spark UI: StageTableBase wraps a paged table, StagePagedTable renders headers and rows (id, pool, description, submitted, duration, task progress bar, input, output, shuffle read/write, failure reason), and StageDataSource converts v1.StageData into sortable row data.
nodes.languageNotes: Rows and headers are built with Scala XML literals (inline XML) and concatenated with ++ as Seq[Node]; the classes are private[ui].

nodes.name: StagesTab.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the Stages tab of the Spark UI. It attaches the all-stages, single-stage, pool and (optionally) task thread dump pages, decides whether to show pool info, and handles the "(kill)" link request for a stage.

nodes.name: StageTableBase
nodes.summary: Entry wrapper for the stage table. Reads the "<stageTag>.page" request parameter (default 1), builds a StagePagedTable with the stages and display flags (isFairScheduler, killEnabled, isFailedStage), and exposes toNodeSeq: the rendered table, or an alert-danger block with the exception text if rendering throws IllegalArgumentException or IndexOutOfBoundsException.

nodes.name: StageTableRowData
nodes.summary: Plain data holder for one displayed stage row: the v1.StageData, ids, scheduling pool, description, submission time, duration, and input/output/shuffle byte counts each with a pre-formatted "with unit" string. Precomputing these avoids rebuilding strings while sorting.

nodes.name: StagePagedTable
nodes.summary: PagedTable implementation that renders the stages table. It defines the table id/css class, paging and sort form fields, page links, the header row (Stage Id, optional Pool Name, Description, Submitted, Duration, Tasks: Succeeded/Total, Input, Output, Shuffle Read, Shuffle Write, optional Failure Reason) and each row, including the progress bar, kill link and expandable details.

nodes.name: StageDataSource
nodes.summary: PagedDataSource over stages. It maps each v1.StageData to a StageTableRowData, sorts the rows once by the chosen column and direction, and serves page slices.

nodes.name: StagesTab
nodes.summary: SparkUITab with prefix "stages" showing progress of all stages of the SparkContext. Attaches AllStagesPage, StagePage, PoolPage and, when thread dumps are enabled and a live SparkContext exists, TaskThreadDumpPage; exposes sc, conf, killEnabled and threadDumpEnabled.

nodes.name: pageLink
nodes.summary: Builds the URL for a given page number, carrying the page, sort column (URL-encoded), desc flag and page size, and ending with the table header anchor.

nodes.name: goButtonFormPath
nodes.summary: Builds the form path used by the "go to page" button, keeping the current sort column and direction.

nodes.name: headers
nodes.summary: Builds the header row. Each column has a title, a sortable flag and an optional tooltip (Duration, Input, Output, Shuffle Read, Shuffle Write); Pool Name appears only for the fair scheduler and Failure Reason only for failed stages. Validates the sort column before rendering.

nodes.name: row
nodes.summary: Wraps one stage row in a tr whose id is "stage-<stageId>-<attemptId>" and delegates the cells to rowContent.

nodes.name: rowContent
nodes.summary: Renders the cells of a stage row: stage id (with "(retry n)" for later attempts), pool link when using the fair scheduler, description, submission time, duration, task progress bar (active, complete, failed, killed), input, output, shuffle read, shuffle write, and the failure reason for failed stages. Falls back to missingStageRow when the stage data is absent.

nodes.name: makeDescription
nodes.summary: Builds the Description cell: optional description text, an optional "(kill)" link when killing is enabled, a name link to the stage page, and a "+details" toggle that expands the stage details text plus links to cached RDDs read from the store.

nodes.name: missingStageRow
nodes.summary: Renders a placeholder row with "No data available for this stage" and empty cells when stage data is missing.

nodes.name: stageRow
nodes.summary: Converts a v1.StageData into a StageTableRowData: formats submission time ("Unknown" if absent), computes duration from the first launched task to completion (or the current time), and formats input, output, shuffle read and shuffle write bytes with units (empty when zero).

nodes.name: ordering
nodes.summary: Returns the Ordering for the requested sort column (Stage Id, Pool Name, Description, Submitted, Duration, Input, Output, Shuffle Read, Shuffle Write), reversed when desc; throws IllegalArgumentException for the unsortable Tasks column or unknown columns.

nodes.name: dataSize
nodes.summary: Returns the number of sorted rows.

nodes.name: sliceData
nodes.summary: Returns the rows for one page range from the pre-sorted data.

nodes.name: isFairScheduler
nodes.summary: True only for a live UI (SparkContext defined) whose stored Spark properties contain the scheduler mode set to FAIR; used to decide whether pool information is shown.

nodes.name: handleKillRequest
nodes.summary: Handles the kill link: if killing is enabled and the remote user has modify permission, reads the "id" parameter, looks up the latest attempt of that stage, and if it is ACTIVE or PENDING cancels the stage with "killed via the Web UI" and sleeps 100 ms so the refreshed page shows it killed.

nodes.name: ExecutionPage.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the SQL tab "execution" detail page (Details for Query <id>). It looks up one execution in SQLAppStatusStore and renders a summary table, a plan visualization built from SparkPlanGraph, the physical plan text, the associated jobs table, and modified SQL and Pandas API configs.
nodes.languageNotes: Pages are built from Scala XML literals; the summary table is filled client-side by DataTables from static JS, so the template intentionally has no thead/tbody (SPARK-56259).

nodes.name: ExecutionPage
nodes.summary: WebUIPage("execution") for one SQL query, selected by the required "id" request parameter. render fetches SQLExecutionUIData, metrics and the plan graph from SQLAppStatusStore and concatenates sections: summary (with sub/parent execution links), Plan Visualization, Plan Details, Associated Jobs, SQL / DataFrame Properties and Pandas API Properties, wrapped by UIUtils.headerSparkPage with DataTables and timeline enabled. Shows "No information to display for query <id>" if the execution is unknown.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the page for the execution id in the request (required, parsed to Long). Builds a placeholder table (data-execution-id) filled client-side, lists Parent Execution and Sub Executions links when UI_SQL_GROUP_SUB_EXECUTION_ENABLED is on, adds download (SVG, DOT, TXT), Copy Plan and Copy Link controls, then appends the visualization, plan text, jobs and config sections.

nodes.name: planVisualizationResources
nodes.summary: Emits the link and script tags for the plan visualization: spark-sql-viz.css, d3.min.js, dagre-d3.min.js, graphlib-dot.min.js and spark-sql-viz.js, each prefixed with the base URI.

nodes.name: planVisualization
nodes.summary: Renders the Plan Visualization section: checkboxes to show the stage and task id of the max metric and to show metrics in graph nodes, a search and zoom toolbar, and a details side panel. It embeds the graph as a hidden metadata block: graph.makeDotFile(metrics) in "dot-file" and graph.makeNodeDetailsJson(metrics) in "node-details", which the JavaScript draws per plan node with its metric values.

nodes.name: jobURL
nodes.summary: Builds the URL of a job page from the tab base path and job id.

nodes.name: jobTimeline
nodes.summary: Renders a vis-timeline of job start and end times for this execution when UI_TIMELINE_ENABLED is set, using at most UI_TIMELINE_JOBS_MAXIMUM latest jobs. Each job becomes an event with a CSS class from its status (succeeded, failed, running, unknown), escaped description and duration; jobs missing from the store are skipped.

nodes.name: physicalPlanDescription
nodes.summary: Renders the collapsible Plan Details section with the physical plan text in a pre block. If the text contains both Initial Plan and Final Plan sections, it adds Unified and Split tabs, the split tab showing the two plans side by side.

nodes.name: extractInitialAndFinalPlans
nodes.summary: Scans the plan description line by line for the "== Final Plan ==" and "== Initial Plan ==" markers and collects the lines under each until a line starting with "(" and containing ")" (not "(+" or "(-") ends the section. Returns trimmed (initialPlan, finalPlan), both empty if there are no such sections.

nodes.name: jobsTable
nodes.summary: Renders the Associated Jobs table (newest job first): job id link, description, submitted time, duration, "succeeded/total" stages with failed and skipped counts, and a task progress bar. Includes the job timeline and skips jobs no longer in the store.

nodes.name: modifiedConfigs
nodes.summary: Renders the collapsible "SQL / DataFrame Properties" table of modified configs (excluding pandas_on_Spark. keys) sorted by name, using UIUtils.listingTable; returns nothing when empty.

nodes.name: modifiedPandasOnSparkConfigs
nodes.summary: Renders the collapsible "Pandas API Properties" table. Strips the pandas_on_Spark. prefix and shows each JSON value in a simple Python repr style (null as None, booleans capitalized, strings quoted).

nodes.name: propertyHeader
nodes.summary: Column headers (Name, Value) for the config tables.

nodes.name: propertyRow
nodes.summary: Renders one config key/value pair as a table row.

nodes.name: SparkPlanGraph.scala
nodes.summary: Builds the graph shown on the SQL tab for one query. SparkPlanGraph.apply walks a SparkPlanInfo tree and produces SparkPlanGraphNode objects (with SQLPlanMetric lists), SparkPlanGraphCluster objects for WholeStageCodegen groups and SparkPlanGraphEdge links from child to parent. The graph can be rendered as a DOT file or as JSON node details for the side panel.
nodes.languageNotes: The case class SparkPlanGraph and its companion object share one class id; the companion holds apply and the recursive plan walker.

nodes.name: SparkPlanGraph
nodes.summary: Case class holding the nodes and edges of a plan graph, with allNodes (all nodes including those inside WholeStageCodegen clusters), makeDotFile and makeNodeDetailsJson. The companion object (lines 89-209) builds a graph from a SparkPlanInfo through apply, reusing a single node for repeated exchanges and subqueries.

nodes.name: SparkPlanGraphNode
nodes.summary: One node of the plan graph: a generated Long id, the operator name, a description and the SQLPlanMetric list that the operator tracks. It can render itself as a DOT node.

nodes.name: SparkPlanGraphCluster
nodes.summary: A graph node that groups child nodes for one WholeStageCodegen subtree. Its DOT output is a subgraph whose label is the short stage name plus the pipeline duration total when that metric value is available.

nodes.name: SparkPlanGraphEdge
nodes.summary: Case class for an edge from a child node id (fromId) to its parent node id (toId). Its DOT form carries the "number of output rows" metric value of the child as a label when one exists.

nodes.name: makeDotFile
nodes.summary: Renders the graph as a DOT digraph string: node declarations first, then edges with optional row-count labels.

nodes.name: makeNodeDetailsJson
nodes.summary: Produces a JSON object keyed by "node<id>" or "cluster<id>" with each node's name, description, metric values and (for clusters) child ids, for the detail side panel.

nodes.name: truncateLabel
nodes.summary: Shortens long labels that contain dot-separated qualified names to 36 characters using a middle ellipsis; other labels are returned unchanged.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Entry point that creates a SparkPlanGraph from the root SparkPlanInfo by running the recursive builder with a fresh id generator.

nodes.name: buildSparkPlanGraphNode
nodes.summary: Recursive walker over SparkPlanInfo. WholeStageCodegen nodes become clusters; InputAdapter, query-stage wrappers and ReusedSubquery are skipped; re-used exchanges and subqueries point at the existing node; every other operator becomes a node with an edge to its parent.

nodes.name: makeDotNode
nodes.summary: Builds the DOT line for a node with its id, truncated name label and escaped description tooltip.

nodes.name: makeDotNode
nodes.summary: Builds a DOT subgraph for the cluster, labelling it with the "(n)" stage number and total pipeline duration, and nesting the DOT output of its child nodes.

nodes.name: makeDotEdge
nodes.summary: Builds the DOT edge line, adding a row-count label from the child node's "number of output rows" metric when its value is known.

nodes.name: AnalysisException.scala
nodes.summary: Defines AnalysisException, the checked-in-spirit error thrown when a query fails to analyze. It carries an error class, message parameters, an optional line/position, query context, SQLSTATE and message template, and implements SparkThrowable so tooling can read them.

nodes.name: AnalysisException
nodes.summary: Exception class (extends Exception with SparkThrowable, Serializable and WithOrigin) thrown when a query is invalid. The message is normally rendered from an error class plus message parameters through SparkThrowableHelper.getMessage; line, startPosition and query context come from an Origin.

nodes.name: this
nodes.summary: The auxiliary constructors. Callers either pass a ready message, or an errorClass plus a Map of messageParameters (optionally with Origin, QueryContext array, cause or summary), in which case the message is built with SparkThrowableHelper.getMessage and the Origin supplies line, startPosition and query context. One variant takes errorClass, sqlState and messageTemplate directly for callers without a local JSON error definition.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Builds a new AnalysisException with selected fields replaced. The first overload is the older seven-argument form (keeps sqlState and messageTemplate); the second lists all nine fields with defaults taken from this instance.

nodes.name: withPosition
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the exception with line, startPosition and query context taken from the given Origin, and keeps the original stack trace. Used to attach source position info after the exception was created.

nodes.name: getMessage
nodes.summary: Overrides Throwable.getMessage to return getSimpleMessage.

nodes.name: getSimpleMessage
nodes.summary: Formats the message, appending " line N" and " pos M" when the line or startPosition is known. The source comment says it outputs an exception without the logical plan, for testing only.

nodes.name: getCondition
nodes.summary: SparkThrowable accessor that returns the error class (the error condition name), or null when none is set.

nodes.name: getQueryContext
nodes.summary: SparkThrowable accessor that returns the QueryContext array stored in the exception.

nodes.name: getMessageParameters
nodes.summary: SparkThrowable accessor that exposes the messageParameters Scala Map as a java.util.Map.

nodes.name: origin
nodes.summary: Lazy val required by WithOrigin; builds an Origin from the stored line and startPosition.

nodes.name: Encoder.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the Encoder[T] trait, the contract that converts a JVM object of type T to and from the internal Spark SQL representation. Instances come from implicits (spark.implicits._) in Scala or from static factories on Encoders in Java.

nodes.name: Encoder
nodes.summary: Serializable trait with just two members, schema (the StructType of the encoded object viewed as a Row) and clsTag (a ClassTag for building arrays of T). Marked @implicitNotFound to give a friendly error when no implicit Encoder[T] is in scope; the docs state that encoders should be thread-safe.

nodes.name: Column.scala
nodes.summary: Defines Column, the Scala/Java DataFrame API handle for an expression. A Column wraps a ColumnNode expression tree, and each operator (===, &&, +, cast, as, when/otherwise, asc/desc, over ...) returns a new Column around a larger tree. The file also holds TypedColumn (a Column plus an Encoder), ColumnName (a Column with StructField helpers) and the companion Column object with factory helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Operators are ordinary Scala methods with symbolic names (===, =!=, &&, ||, +, ...), and each has a Java-friendly alias (equalTo, notEqual, and, or, plus ...) that is skipped in this graph.

nodes.name: Column
nodes.summary: The expression handle of the DataFrame API: class Column(val node: ColumnNode) extends Logging with TableValuedFunctionArgument. All operators build a new Column around a new ColumnNode (UnresolvedFunction, Alias, Cast, SortOrder ...), so nothing is evaluated until the tree is analyzed. toString prints node.sql and equals/hashCode compare normalized nodes. The companion object (lines 33-82) provides apply and the fn helpers that create UnresolvedFunction nodes; the class itself starts at line 140.

nodes.name: TypedColumn
nodes.summary: A Column that also carries an Encoder[U] for its result type, created through Column.as[U]. Dataset.select-style operations can use the encoder to convert results into JVM types. It only overrides name to keep the encoder when aliased.

nodes.name: ColumnName
nodes.summary: A Column built from a name that also offers helpers (boolean, int, string, decimal, timestamp, array, map, struct ...) that produce a StructField with that name and the matching DataType. The source describes it as a convenient class used for constructing schema.

nodes.name: fnWithOptions
nodes.summary: Calls a SQL function by name with an options map as the last argument. If the options iterator is empty the map column is dropped; otherwise the pairs are flattened into lit(k), lit(v) arguments of a map(...) column.

nodes.name: fn
nodes.summary: Companion helpers (fn overloads, internalFn) that create a Column from an UnresolvedFunction node with the given name and argument nodes, optionally distinct or internal. Most Column operators funnel through here.

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Overrides Column.name so that aliasing a TypedColumn returns another TypedColumn with the same encoder.

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Two Columns are equal when their nodes are equal after normalization; hashCode uses the same normalized node.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Extracts a value from a complex type: array element by ordinal, map value by key, struct field by name, or the field of every struct in an array of structs. Builds an UnresolvedExtractValue node with lit(extraction).
Equality test. Wraps the other value in lit, warns through checkTrivialPredicate if both sides are the same column, and builds the "=" function call.

nodes.name: checkTrivialPredicate
nodes.summary: Private helper that logs a warning (with LEFT_EXPR and RIGHT_EXPR) when a column is compared with itself, hinting that aliases may be needed.
Inequality test, defined as the negation of ===.
Null-safe equality test that builds the "<=>" function call, with the same trivial-predicate check as ===.

nodes.name: when
nodes.summary: Appends a (condition, value) branch to a CaseWhenOtherwise node; only valid on a Column produced by when(), and throws IllegalArgumentException once otherwise() has been applied.

nodes.name: otherwise
nodes.summary: Sets the default branch of a CaseWhenOtherwise node; throws IllegalArgumentException if called twice or on a Column not produced by when().

nodes.name: between
nodes.summary: Range predicate written as (this >= lowerBound) && (this <= upperBound).

nodes.name: isNull
nodes.summary: True if the current expression is null; builds the "isNull" function call.

nodes.name: isNotNull
nodes.summary: True if the current expression is not null; builds the "isNotNull" function call.
Boolean OR, built as the "or" function call.
Boolean AND, built as the "and" function call.
Sum of this expression and another, built as the "+" function call.
Subtraction, built as the "-" function call.
Multiplication, built as the "*" function call.
Division, built as the "/" function call.

nodes.name: isin
nodes.summary: Membership predicate: true if the value is in the list of arguments, built as the "in" function. An overload takes a Dataset and builds a SubqueryExpression of type IN (a single null Dataset is treated as a value), and isInCollection delegates here.

nodes.name: like
nodes.summary: SQL LIKE pattern match against a literal string.

nodes.name: rlike
nodes.summary: SQL RLIKE (regular expression) match against a literal string.

nodes.name: getItem
nodes.summary: Extracts an array element or map value by key; simply delegates to apply.

nodes.name: withField
nodes.summary: Adds or replaces a field in a struct column. Requires non-null fieldName and col and builds an UpdateFields node.

nodes.name: dropFields
nodes.summary: Drops fields from a struct column by chaining one UpdateFields node per name via foldLeft.

nodes.name: getField
nodes.summary: Gets a struct field by name; delegates to apply.

nodes.name: substr
nodes.summary: Substring of a column given start position and length as Columns; an Int overload wraps the numbers with lit.

nodes.name: alias
nodes.summary: Gives the column a name; same as name and as(String).

nodes.name: as
nodes.summary: Aliases the column; overloads accept a Seq or Array of aliases (multi-column output), a Symbol, or an alias with Metadata. Separately, as[U: Encoder] (line 176) returns a TypedColumn that remembers the Encoder.

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Wraps the node in an internal.Alias node; this is where alias and the as overloads end up.

nodes.name: cast
nodes.summary: Casts to a DataType by wrapping the node in internal.Cast; the String overload parses the type with DataTypeParser.parseDataType.

nodes.name: try_cast
nodes.summary: Like cast but builds internal.Cast with the Try evaluation mode, so invalid values give null instead of an error.

nodes.name: sortOrder
nodes.summary: Private helper that wraps the node in an internal.SortOrder with the given direction and null ordering; a second sortOrder returns the node itself if it already is a SortOrder, otherwise asc.node.

nodes.name: desc
nodes.summary: Descending sort expression; defined as desc_nulls_last.

nodes.name: desc_nulls_last
nodes.summary: Descending sort with nulls last; uses sortOrder(Descending, NullsLast).

nodes.name: asc
nodes.summary: Ascending sort expression; defined as asc_nulls_first.

nodes.name: asc_nulls_first
nodes.summary: Ascending sort with nulls first; uses sortOrder(Ascending, NullsFirst).

nodes.name: explain
nodes.summary: Prints the expression to stdout: the full node tree when extended is true, otherwise node.sql.

nodes.name: over
nodes.summary: Defines a windowing column by applying a WindowSpec to this column via window.withAggregate; the no-argument overload uses Window.spec for an empty analytic clause.

nodes.name: Encoders.scala
nodes.summary: Static factory object for creating Encoders: boxed Java types (BOOLEAN, INT, STRING ...), date/time, binary, geometry, Java beans, Rows, Kryo or Java serialization, tuples, Scala products and primitives, and user defined types. Most factories simply return a prebuilt AgnosticEncoder.

nodes.name: Encoders
nodes.summary: Object of methods for creating an Encoder (the docs say "Methods for creating an [[Encoder]]"). Upper-case members like STRING and INT are for Java callers and return nullable boxed-type encoders; scalaInt and friends return primitive encoders; bean, row, kryo, javaSerialization, tuple, product and udt build encoders for richer types by delegating to JavaTypeInference, RowEncoder, ScalaReflection, serialization codecs or AgnosticEncoders.

nodes.name: BOOLEAN
nodes.summary: Encoder for nullable java.lang.Boolean (BoxedBooleanEncoder). The Scala primitive version is scalaBoolean.

nodes.name: INT
nodes.summary: Encoder for nullable java.lang.Integer (BoxedIntEncoder).

nodes.name: LONG
nodes.summary: Encoder for nullable java.lang.Long (BoxedLongEncoder).

nodes.name: DOUBLE
nodes.summary: Encoder for nullable java.lang.Double (BoxedDoubleEncoder).

nodes.name: CHAR
nodes.summary: Encoder for nullable char(length) strings (CharEncoder), since 4.0.0.

nodes.name: VARCHAR
nodes.summary: Encoder for nullable varchar(length) strings (VarcharEncoder), since 4.0.0.

nodes.name: STRING
nodes.summary: Encoder for nullable String values (StringEncoder); the usual choice for Java Dataset<String>.

nodes.name: DECIMAL
nodes.summary: Encoder for nullable java.math.BigDecimal (default Java decimal encoder).

nodes.name: DATE
nodes.summary: Encoder for java.sql.Date mapped to DateType (strict date encoder).

nodes.name: LOCALDATE
nodes.summary: Encoder for java.time.LocalDate mapped to Catalyst DateType, since 3.0.0.

nodes.name: LOCALDATETIME
nodes.summary: Encoder for java.time.LocalDateTime mapped to TimestampNTZType, since 3.4.0.

nodes.name: TIMESTAMP
nodes.summary: Encoder for java.sql.Timestamp mapped to timestamp type (strict timestamp encoder).

nodes.name: INSTANT
nodes.summary: Encoder for java.time.Instant mapped to TimestampType, since 3.0.0.

nodes.name: BINARY
nodes.summary: Encoder for arrays of bytes (BinaryEncoder).

nodes.name: GEOMETRY
nodes.summary: Encoder for the Geometry data type, built from a GeometryType, since 4.1.0.

nodes.name: DURATION
nodes.summary: Encoder for java.time.Duration mapped to DayTimeIntervalType, since 3.2.0.

nodes.name: PERIOD
nodes.summary: Encoder for java.time.Period mapped to YearMonthIntervalType, since 3.2.0.

nodes.name: bean
nodes.summary: Creates an encoder for a Java Bean class via JavaTypeInference.encoderFor. The class must be concrete and public; supported fields include primitives, boxed types, String, BigDecimal/BigInteger, date-time types, collections and nested beans.

nodes.name: row
nodes.summary: Creates an Encoder[Row] for a given schema (imported as SchemaInference, the RowEncoder object), since 3.5.0.

nodes.name: kryo
nodes.summary: Encoder that serializes objects of type T with Kryo into a single binary field (class-tag version for Scala; an overload takes a Class). Delegates to genericSerializer with KryoSerializationCodec.

nodes.name: javaSerialization
nodes.summary: Encoder that uses generic Java serialization into a single binary field. The docs note it is extremely inefficient and should be a last resort. Delegates to genericSerializer with JavaSerializationCodec.

nodes.name: validatePublicClass
nodes.summary: Private check that the class is public; throws ExecutionErrors.notPublicClassError otherwise.

nodes.name: genericSerializer
nodes.summary: Private helper behind kryo and javaSerialization: rejects primitive classes, validates that the class is public, then returns a TransformingEncoder over BinaryEncoder with the given codec provider.

nodes.name: tupleEncoder
nodes.summary: Private[sql] helper that converts the given Encoders to agnostic encoders and builds a ProductEncoder.tuple.

nodes.name: tuple
nodes.summary: Encoder for tuples of 1 to 5 elements, composed from the element encoders (separate overloads per arity, all call tupleEncoder).

nodes.name: product
