nodes.summary: Invokes onTaskSucceeded on every executor plugin, logging failures.

nodes.name: onTaskFailed
nodes.summary: Invokes onTaskFailed with the failure reason on every executor plugin, logging failures.

nodes.name: ApproximateActionListener.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the job listener used by approximate single-result actions such as count, which can hand back a partial answer after a timeout.

nodes.name: ApproximateActionListener
nodes.summary: JobListener for an approximate single-result action. It merges each task result into an ApproximateEvaluator, and awaitResult returns a PartialResult after the timeout (possibly incomplete) or as soon as all tasks finish, filling in the final value of an already returned partial result later.

nodes.name: taskSucceeded
nodes.summary: Synchronized callback that merges a task result into the evaluator, counts finished tasks, and when all are done sets the final value of any returned PartialResult and wakes waiters.

nodes.name: jobFailed
nodes.summary: Records the failure exception and wakes any thread waiting in awaitResult.

nodes.name: awaitResult
nodes.summary: Blocks until the job fails, all tasks finish, or the timeout (measured from listener creation) elapses, then returns a complete or partial PartialResult or throws the recorded failure.

nodes.name: AsyncRDDActions.scala
nodes.summary: Provides asynchronous RDD actions (count, collect, take, foreach) that return FutureAction handles, exposed through an implicit conversion.

nodes.name: AsyncRDDActions
nodes.summary: Serializable helper class with the asynchronous counterparts of RDD actions, each submitting a job through the SparkContext and returning a FutureAction. Its private companion object (lines 144-147) holds a daemon cached thread pool execution context used by takeAsync.

nodes.name: countAsync
nodes.summary: Submits a job that counts elements per partition and sums them into an AtomicLong, returning a FutureAction[Long].

nodes.name: collectAsync
nodes.summary: Submits a job that turns each partition into an array and returns a FutureAction with all elements flattened into a Seq.

nodes.name: takeAsync
nodes.summary: Returns a FutureAction for the first num elements. It runs jobs over growing batches of partitions (scale-up factor from config) chained with future callbacks, inside a ComplexFutureAction, until enough elements are found or all partitions are scanned.

nodes.name: foreachAsync
nodes.summary: Cleans the function and submits a job applying it to every element, returning a FutureAction[Unit].

nodes.name: foreachPartitionAsync
nodes.summary: Submits a job applying a function to each partition iterator, returning a FutureAction[Unit].

nodes.name: BinaryFileRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the RDD that reads binary files through a StreamFileInputFormat, producing (path, stream) pairs.

nodes.name: BinaryFileRDD
nodes.summary: NewHadoopRDD subclass keyed by file path that reads files through a StreamFileInputFormat subclass. It computes its partitions from the format splits after applying a minimum partition hint.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Sets a parallel status-listing thread count if unset, instantiates the input format, passes it the minimum partitions hint, and wraps each raw split in a NewHadoopPartition.

nodes.name: BlockRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines an RDD backed by existing blocks in the block manager, with one partition per block id.

nodes.name: BlockRDDPartition
nodes.summary: Partition implementation that pairs a BlockId with its partition index.

nodes.name: BlockRDD
nodes.summary: RDD whose partitions each correspond to a block id; compute reads the block from the local BlockManager and preferred locations come from block locations. removeBlocks deletes the blocks and marks the RDD invalid, after which all operations fail.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Asserts validity and creates one BlockRDDPartition per block id.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Looks up the partition block in the local BlockManager and returns its data iterator, or throws a block-not-found error.

nodes.name: getPreferredLocations
nodes.summary: Returns the hosts holding the partition block, taken from the lazily computed block-id-to-location map.

nodes.name: removeBlocks
nodes.summary: Removes every backing block through the BlockManagerMaster and marks the RDD invalid. Irreversible.

nodes.name: assertValid
nodes.summary: Throws an error if the blocks of this RDD have been removed.

nodes.name: CountEvaluator.scala
nodes.summary: Evaluator for approximate counts that merges per-task counts and returns a bounded estimate using a Poisson model.

nodes.name: CountEvaluator
nodes.summary: ApproximateEvaluator for counts: sums task counts and reports exact bounds when all outputs are merged, an unbounded estimate when nothing useful is merged, and otherwise a confidence interval from its companion object (lines 48-65).

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Counts one more merged output and adds the task count to the running sum.

nodes.name: currentResult
nodes.summary: Returns the exact value when all outputs are merged, an infinite upper bound when nothing was counted, otherwise the interval computed by bound for the merged fraction.

nodes.name: bound
nodes.summary: Companion function: treats the unseen remainder of the count as Poisson distributed and derives lower and upper bounds for the given confidence, returning a BoundedDouble.

nodes.name: GroupedCountEvaluator.scala
nodes.summary: Evaluator for approximate counts by key that returns a map from key to a bounded count estimate.

nodes.name: GroupedCountEvaluator
nodes.summary: ApproximateEvaluator for counts by key: merges per-task OpenHashMap counts and returns a map of key to BoundedDouble, using exact bounds when complete and CountEvaluator.bound for partial progress.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Adds each key count from a task result into the running per-key sums.

nodes.name: currentResult
nodes.summary: Builds the per-key BoundedDouble map: exact when all outputs merged, empty when none, otherwise intervals from CountEvaluator.bound.

nodes.name: ApproximateEvaluator.scala
nodes.summary: Declares the trait for evaluators that incrementally merge task results and can report a current result at any time.

nodes.name: ApproximateEvaluator
nodes.summary: Trait with merge(outputId, taskResult) and currentResult(); implementations compute a function incrementally from multiple task results so that partial evaluation is possible at any point.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Abstract method that merges one task result into the evaluator state.

nodes.name: currentResult
nodes.summary: Abstract method returning the result computed from the outputs merged so far.

nodes.name: FileCommitProtocol.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the FileCommitProtocol abstraction that describes how a Spark job commits its output files (job and task setup, temp file naming, commit, abort), its companion factory, the TaskCommitMessage wrapper and the FileNameSpec case class. Used by Hadoop-based writers and other implementations that must be serializable and are created on the driver.

nodes.name: FileCommitProtocol
nodes.summary: Abstract class (annotated Unstable) defining the job and task lifecycle for committing outputs: driver calls setupJob, executors call setupTask then commitTask or abortTask, and the driver finishes with commitJob or abortJob. The companion object provides instantiate (reflective construction by class name) and getStagingDir. Implementations must be serializable and have a (jobId, path) or (jobId, path, dynamicPartitionOverwrite) constructor.

nodes.name: TaskCommitMessage
nodes.summary: Serializable wrapper around an arbitrary object that a task returns to the driver after commitTask; the driver hands the collected messages to commitJob.

nodes.name: EmptyTaskCommitMessage
nodes.summary: Singleton TaskCommitMessage carrying a null payload, for commit protocols that have nothing to report from a task.

nodes.name: FileNameSpec
nodes.summary: Final case class holding a file name prefix and suffix; FileCommitProtocol uses it to build the full path of a newly added file.

nodes.name: setupJob
nodes.summary: Abstract driver-side hook that sets up a job; must be called before any other method.

nodes.name: commitJob
nodes.summary: Abstract driver-side hook that commits a job after all writes succeed, receiving the TaskCommitMessage of every task.

nodes.name: abortJob
nodes.summary: Abstract driver-side hook that aborts a job after writes fail; documented as best-effort since the driver may crash first.

nodes.name: setupTask
nodes.summary: Abstract executor-side hook that sets up a task; must precede other task-related methods.

nodes.name: newTaskTempFile
nodes.summary: Asks the protocol for the full path of a new file under an optional sub-directory. The FileNameSpec overload delegates to the deprecated (dir, ext) overload (lines 99-102, which throws mustOverrideOneMethodError) when the prefix is empty and otherwise throws UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: newTaskTempFileAbsPath
nodes.summary: Like newTaskTempFile but for an absolute output directory with weaker guarantees. The FileNameSpec overload delegates to the deprecated (absoluteDir, ext) overload (lines 139-143) when the prefix is empty and otherwise throws UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: commitTask
nodes.summary: Abstract executor-side hook that commits a task after its writes succeed and returns a TaskCommitMessage.

nodes.name: abortTask
nodes.summary: Abstract executor-side hook that aborts a task after its writes failed; best-effort.

nodes.name: deleteWithJob
nodes.summary: Requests deletion of a path as part of the job commit; the default implementation deletes it immediately through the FileSystem.

nodes.name: onTaskCommit
nodes.summary: Driver callback invoked after each task commits, giving access to its commit message before the job finishes; the default only logs at debug level.

nodes.name: instantiate
nodes.summary: Factory that loads a FileCommitProtocol by class name and constructs it reflectively, preferring the (jobId, outputPath, dynamicPartitionOverwrite) constructor and falling back to (jobId, outputPath); the fallback requires dynamicPartitionOverwrite to be false.

nodes.name: getStagingDir
nodes.summary: Returns the staging directory path (.spark-staging-<jobId>) under the given output path.

nodes.name: HadoopMapRedCommitProtocol.scala
nodes.summary: Provides HadoopMapRedCommitProtocol, a serializable commit protocol that reuses the OutputCommitter configured on a mapred JobConf instead of creating one from the OutputFormat.

nodes.name: HadoopMapRedCommitProtocol
nodes.summary: Subclass of HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol that backs the protocol with the OutputCommitter obtained from the old mapred JobConf; used when saving through the old mapred API.

nodes.name: setupCommitter
nodes.summary: Overrides committer creation: casts the task context configuration to JobConf, takes its OutputCommitter, logs the committer class name and returns it.

nodes.name: HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol.scala
nodes.summary: Implements HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol, the FileCommitProtocol backed by a Hadoop mapreduce OutputCommitter. It stages files written to absolute locations and, with dynamic partition overwrite, partition directories under a staging dir and moves them into place on job commit.

nodes.name: HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol
nodes.summary: Serializable commit protocol wrapping a transient Hadoop OutputCommitter. It tracks files staged for absolute paths and written partition paths per task, and on commitJob renames them to their final locations, optionally deleting and replacing partition directories when dynamicPartitionOverwrite is true. Instantiated by FileCommitProtocol.instantiate and by the Hadoop write config helpers.

nodes.name: setupCommitter
nodes.summary: Creates the OutputCommitter by instantiating the task's OutputFormat class, passing it the configuration when it is Configurable, and asking it for its committer.

nodes.name: newTaskTempFile
nodes.summary: Returns the temp path for a new task file under the committer's work path (or the output path); for FileOutputCommitter with dynamicPartitionOverwrite it asserts a partition dir is given and records it in partitionPaths.

nodes.name: newTaskTempFileAbsPath
nodes.summary: Returns a UUID-prefixed temp path inside the staging dir for a file destined for an absolute directory and remembers the temp-to-final mapping for job commit.

nodes.name: getFilename
nodes.summary: Builds the output file name from the spec prefix, mapreduce.output.basename (default part), zero-padded split id, job id and spec suffix.

nodes.name: setupJob
nodes.summary: Creates job, task and attempt ids, writes them to the Hadoop configuration, builds a TaskAttemptContextImpl, creates the committer via setupCommitter and calls its setupJob.

nodes.name: commitJob
nodes.summary: Commits the wrapped committer, then moves staged absolute-path files to their destinations, and with dynamicPartitionOverwrite replaces final partition directories with the staged ones; finally deletes the staging dir. Throws IOException if a rename fails.

nodes.name: abortJob
nodes.summary: Aborts the committer with FAILED state and deletes the staging dir, logging and swallowing IOExceptions so the root cause of the failure is not lost.

nodes.name: setupTask
nodes.summary: Creates the committer for the task, calls its setupTask and initializes the task-local maps of staged absolute-path files and partition paths.

nodes.name: commitTask
nodes.summary: Commits the task through SparkHadoopMapRedUtil.commitTask and returns a TaskCommitMessage holding the staged absolute-path file map and the written partition paths.

nodes.name: abortTask
nodes.summary: Aborts the task on the committer and makes a best-effort delete of files staged for absolute paths, logging and ignoring IOExceptions.

nodes.name: HadoopWriteConfigUtil.scala
nodes.summary: Declares HadoopWriteConfigUtil, the serializable interface for creating the job and task contexts, commit protocol, record writer and OutputFormat used when saving an RDD with a Hadoop OutputFormat from either the mapred or mapreduce API.

nodes.name: HadoopWriteConfigUtil
nodes.summary: Abstract serializable class with one group of methods each for creating JobContext/TaskAttemptContext, the commit protocol, the writer, the OutputFormat and for validating the configuration. Implementations are created on the driver, used by tasks, and must throw IllegalArgumentException when the wrong Hadoop API is referenced.

nodes.name: createJobContext
nodes.summary: Abstract method creating the JobContext from a job tracker id and job id.

nodes.name: createTaskAttemptContext
nodes.summary: Abstract method creating the TaskAttemptContext for a job tracker id, job id, split id and task attempt id.

nodes.name: createCommitter
nodes.summary: Abstract method creating the HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol for a job id.

nodes.name: initWriter
nodes.summary: Abstract method that opens the record writer for a split inside a task.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Abstract method writing one key-value pair with the current writer.

nodes.name: closeWriter
nodes.summary: Abstract method closing the current record writer.

nodes.name: initOutputFormat
nodes.summary: Abstract method initializing the OutputFormat class from the job context.

nodes.name: assertConf
nodes.summary: Abstract method verifying the Hadoop configuration against the SparkConf before writing.

nodes.name: SparkHadoopWriter.scala
nodes.summary: Implements the RDD-to-Hadoop save path: SparkHadoopWriter runs the driver-side job and per-partition write tasks with commit and abort handling, while HadoopMapRedWriteConfigUtil and HadoopMapReduceWriteConfigUtil adapt the old mapred and new mapreduce APIs to the HadoopWriteConfigUtil interface.

nodes.name: SparkHadoopWriter
nodes.summary: Private[spark] object that saves an RDD of key-value pairs through a Hadoop OutputFormat. The driver sets up a job and commit protocol, runs one write task per partition, commits the job if all tasks succeed and otherwise aborts it.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Driver entry point: creates the job context and committer, sets a write job UUID, runs executeTask for every partition via SparkContext.runJob, commits the job with timing logs, and on any failure aborts the job and throws SparkException.

nodes.name: executeTask
nodes.summary: Executor-side write of one RDD partition: sets up the task, initializes the writer, writes every pair while updating output metrics, closes the writer and commits the task; on error closes the writer, aborts the task and wraps the failure in a SparkException.

nodes.name: HadoopMapRedWriteConfigUtil
nodes.summary: Private[spark] HadoopWriteConfigUtil built on a SerializableJobConf for the old mapred API: creates job/task contexts, a HadoopMapRedCommitProtocol committer, a RecordWriter from the JobConf output format, and validates output format, key and value classes and output specs.

nodes.name: createJobContext
nodes.summary: Builds a JobContextImpl from the JobConf and a JobID made from the tracker id and job id.

nodes.name: createTaskAttemptContext
nodes.summary: Adds per-task local settings to the JobConf through HadoopRDD.addLocalConfiguration and creates a MAP-type TaskAttemptContextImpl.

nodes.name: createCommitter
nodes.summary: Adds local configuration to the JobConf and instantiates HadoopMapRedCommitProtocol through FileCommitProtocol.instantiate using the mapred.output.dir path.

nodes.name: initWriter
nodes.summary: Names the output part-NNNNN, resolves the FileSystem from the output path, and obtains a RecordWriter from the JobConf output format, requiring it to be non-null.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes one key-value pair through the open RecordWriter; requires the writer to be initialized.

nodes.name: closeWriter
nodes.summary: Closes the RecordWriter when it exists.

nodes.name: initOutputFormat
nodes.summary: Remembers the JobConf output format class if it is not set yet.

nodes.name: getOutputFormat
nodes.summary: Instantiates the stored output format class; requires initOutputFormat to have been called.

nodes.name: assertConf
nodes.summary: Checks that the output format, key class and value class are set, adds credentials, and, if output spec validation is enabled, calls checkOutputSpecs on the output format.

nodes.name: HadoopMapReduceWriteConfigUtil
nodes.summary: Private[spark] HadoopWriteConfigUtil built on a SerializableConfiguration for the new mapreduce API: creates job/task contexts, a HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol committer, a RecordWriter from the OutputFormat, and validates output specs.

nodes.name: createJobContext
nodes.summary: Builds a TaskAttemptContextImpl from the configuration and a MAP-type attempt id to serve as the job context.

nodes.name: createTaskAttemptContext
nodes.summary: Creates a REDUCE-type TaskAttemptID from the tracker id, job id, split id and attempt id and wraps it in a TaskAttemptContextImpl.

nodes.name: createCommitter
nodes.summary: Instantiates HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol through FileCommitProtocol.instantiate using the mapreduce.output.fileoutputformat.outputdir path.

nodes.name: initWriter
nodes.summary: Creates the OutputFormat, sets its configuration when it is Configurable, and obtains a RecordWriter from the task context, requiring it to be non-null.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes one key-value pair through the open RecordWriter; requires the writer to be initialized.

nodes.name: closeWriter
nodes.summary: Closes the RecordWriter and clears it; logs a warning if it was already closed.

nodes.name: initOutputFormat
nodes.summary: Remembers the output format class from the job context if it is not set yet.

nodes.name: getOutputFormat
nodes.summary: Instantiates the stored output format class; requires initOutputFormat to have been called.

nodes.name: assertConf
nodes.summary: When output spec validation is enabled, calls checkOutputSpecs on the output format with the job context.

nodes.name: SparkHadoopWriterUtils.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the private[spark] SparkHadoopWriterUtils object with helpers used when saving an RDD through a Hadoop OutputFormat (old mapred or new mapreduce API). It builds job IDs, qualifies output paths, decides whether output spec validation is enabled, and updates task output metrics.

nodes.name: SparkHadoopWriterUtils
nodes.summary: Singleton holding the common utilities for saving an RDD with a Hadoop OutputFormat: job and job tracker ID creation, output path qualification, an output spec validation switch (a DynamicVariable) and throttled bytes/records written metric updates (every 256 records).

nodes.name: createJobID
nodes.summary: Creates a Hadoop JobID from a job tracker ID string and a job number, throwing IllegalArgumentException if the number is negative. An overload takes a Date, creates a tracker ID via createJobTrackerID and delegates here (lines 56-59).

nodes.name: createJobTrackerID
nodes.summary: Builds a job tracker ID by formatting the given time as yyyyMMddHHmmss and appending a non-negative random long.

nodes.name: createPathFromString
nodes.summary: Converts an output path string into a fully qualified Hadoop Path using the file system from the JobConf, rejecting null paths and missing file systems with IllegalArgumentException.

nodes.name: isOutputSpecValidationEnabled
nodes.summary: Returns true when spark.hadoop.validateOutputSpecs is enabled in the SparkConf and the disableOutputSpecValidation dynamic variable has not turned validation off. It is a function rather than a val so the dynamic setting can take effect.

nodes.name: initHadoopOutputMetrics
nodes.summary: Returns the task's OutputMetrics together with a callback that reports the bytes written to the file system on the current thread.

nodes.name: maybeUpdateOutputMetrics
nodes.summary: Updates bytes written and records written on OutputMetrics only when the record count is a multiple of 256, to limit the cost of querying the file system callback.

nodes.name: BoundedDouble.scala
nodes.summary: Defines BoundedDouble, a Double estimate carrying a confidence level and low and high error bounds. It is the result type produced by the approximate evaluators in the partial package.

nodes.name: BoundedDouble
nodes.summary: Immutable value class holding mean, confidence, low and high. toString prints the [low, high] interval, and equals and hashCode compare all four fields (NaN makes equality false, as for Double).

nodes.name: equals
nodes.summary: Field-wise equality over mean, confidence, low and high; any NaN value makes the comparison false.

nodes.name: hashCode
nodes.summary: Hash code computed by XOR of the hash codes of the four fields.

nodes.name: PartialResult.scala
nodes.summary: Defines PartialResult[R], a handle for an approximate result that is available immediately and whose final value arrives later. Callers can block for the final value or register one completion handler and one failure handler.

nodes.name: PartialResult
nodes.summary: Holds an initial (possibly partial) value plus an optional final value or failure. getFinalValue blocks via wait/notifyAll, onComplete and onFail register single handlers, map derives a PartialResult[T], and setFinalValue/setFailure (private[spark]) complete it once.

nodes.name: getFinalValue
nodes.summary: Blocks the calling thread until a final value or failure is set, then returns the value or throws the stored exception.

nodes.name: onComplete
nodes.summary: Registers the single completion handler (throwing if called twice) and invokes it immediately if the final value is already known.

nodes.name: onFail
nodes.summary: Registers the single failure handler (throwing if called twice) and invokes it immediately if a failure was already recorded.

nodes.name: map
nodes.summary: Returns a new PartialResult[T] by applying f to the initial value, with an anonymous subclass that applies f to the final value and forwards onComplete and onFail to this instance.

nodes.name: setFinalValue
nodes.summary: Internal setter that stores the final value (throwing if set twice), runs the completion handler if present and wakes threads waiting in getFinalValue.

nodes.name: getFinalValueInternal
nodes.summary: Private accessor returning the optional final value, used by the toString of the mapped result.

nodes.name: setFailure
nodes.summary: Internal setter that stores the failure (throwing if set twice), runs the failure handler if present and wakes waiting threads.

nodes.name: toString
nodes.summary: Prints (final: value) when the final value is set, otherwise (partial: initialValue).

nodes.name: FixedLengthBinaryRecordReader.scala
nodes.summary: Defines FixedLengthBinaryRecordReader, the Hadoop RecordReader returned by FixedLengthBinaryInputFormat. It reads one fixed-size binary record at a time from an input split, keyed by record index.

nodes.name: FixedLengthBinaryRecordReader
nodes.summary: private[spark] RecordReader[LongWritable, BytesWritable] that opens the split's file, seeks to the split start and returns successive records of the configured length (key = start position / record length, value = the record bytes). It rejects compressed files.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Reads the FileSplit bounds, throws IOException if the file has a compression codec, gets the record length from FixedLengthBinaryInputFormat, opens the file and seeks to the split start.

nodes.name: nextKeyValue
nodes.summary: Sets the key to the record index and, while the current position is before the split end, reads one record into the reused buffer, advances the position and returns true; otherwise returns false.

nodes.name: getProgress
nodes.summary: Computes progress through the split as (currentPosition - splitStart) / (splitEnd - splitStart), capped at 1.0, and 0 for an empty split.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the underlying file input stream if it was opened.

nodes.name: MeanEvaluator.scala
nodes.summary: Defines MeanEvaluator, an ApproximateEvaluator that merges per-task StatCounters and reports the current mean estimate as a BoundedDouble with a confidence interval.

nodes.name: MeanEvaluator
nodes.summary: private[spark] ApproximateEvaluator[StatCounter, BoundedDouble] for means. It merges task StatCounters and, while not all outputs have arrived, derives a confidence interval from the sample variance using a normal distribution for more than 100 values and a t-distribution otherwise.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Counts one more merged output and merges the task's StatCounter into the running counter.

nodes.name: currentResult
nodes.summary: Returns an exact bound when all outputs are merged, an infinite interval when there is no data or one value, and otherwise mean plus or minus a confidence factor times the standard error.

nodes.name: SumEvaluator.scala
nodes.summary: Defines SumEvaluator, an ApproximateEvaluator that estimates a total from the merged tasks by multiplying estimated mean and count and combining their variances into a confidence interval.

nodes.name: SumEvaluator
nodes.summary: private[spark] ApproximateEvaluator[StatCounter, BoundedDouble] for sums. It extrapolates the unobserved part of the data from the merged fraction p, uses the variance of a product of independent variables and a normal or t-distribution factor to bound the result, and adds the observed sum.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Counts one more merged output and merges the task's StatCounter into the running counter.

nodes.name: currentResult
nodes.summary: Returns an exact sum when all outputs are merged, an infinite interval with no data, and otherwise an estimated sum with bounds from mean, count and variance estimates (infinite bounds when the variance is NaN or only one value was seen).

nodes.name: package.scala
nodes.summary: Declares the empty package object org.apache.spark.partial, whose scaladoc describes the package as support for approximate results and refers to RDD.countApprox.

nodes.name: SparkHadoopMapRedUtil.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the SparkHadoopMapRedUtil object that commits a task's Hadoop output after checking with the driver's output commit coordinator whether this attempt may commit.

nodes.name: SparkHadoopMapRedUtil
nodes.summary: Singleton helper with a single commitTask method that wraps a MapReduce OutputCommitter. It is used when a task finishes writing output and must commit it, coordinating with the driver so that only one attempt per partition commits.

nodes.name: commitTask
nodes.summary: Commits a task's output through the given OutputCommitter. If needsTaskCommit is true and spark.hadoop.outputCommitCoordination.enabled is set (default true), it asks the driver's OutputCommitCoordinator via canCommit; if denied it aborts the task and throws CommitDeniedException, otherwise it commits (aborting and rethrowing on IOException). The nested performCommit helper times and logs the commit.

nodes.name: BlockDataManager.scala
nodes.summary: Declares the BlockDataManager trait, the interface through which the network layer reads, writes and releases locally stored blocks and diagnoses shuffle corruption.

nodes.name: BlockDataManager
nodes.summary: Private[spark] trait describing the block operations the transfer service needs from the local block store: get local or host-local shuffle block data, put a block or a block stream with a storage level, list local disk dirs, release locks and diagnose shuffle checksum corruption. It is passed to BlockTransferService.init and used by NettyBlockRpcServer to answer remote requests.

nodes.name: diagnoseShuffleBlockCorruption
nodes.summary: Abstract method that verifies shuffle checksums to diagnose the possible cause of shuffle data corruption for a block, given the reader's checksum and algorithm, and returns a Cause.

nodes.name: getLocalDiskDirs
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor returning the local directories used by the BlockManager to save blocks to disk.

nodes.name: getHostLocalShuffleData
nodes.summary: Abstract method returning host-local shuffle block data as a ManagedBuffer from the given dirs; throws if the block cannot be found or read.

nodes.name: getLocalBlockData
nodes.summary: Abstract method returning local block data as a ManagedBuffer; throws if the block cannot be found or read.

nodes.name: putBlockData
nodes.summary: Abstract method that stores a block locally with the given storage level and class tag; returns true if stored and false if the put failed or the block already existed.

nodes.name: putBlockDataAsStream
nodes.summary: Abstract method for a block that will arrive as a stream: returns a StreamCallbackWithID that later receives the block data.

nodes.name: releaseLock
nodes.summary: Abstract method releasing locks acquired by putBlockData and getLocalBlockData for a block, optionally tied to a TaskContext.

nodes.name: BlockTransferService.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract BlockTransferService, a BlockStoreClient with a built-in server that fetches and uploads blocks between nodes and exposes blocking variants of both.

nodes.name: BlockTransferService
nodes.summary: Private[spark] abstract class that fetches and uploads sets of blocks; each instance contains both a client and a server. Subclasses implement init, port, hostName and uploadBlock, and the class adds blocking convenience methods fetchBlockSync and uploadBlockSync. It must be initialized with a BlockDataManager before fetch or upload methods are usable.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Abstract method that initializes the service with the BlockDataManager used to fetch or put local blocks; fetchBlocks from BlockStoreClient is available only after it is invoked.

nodes.name: port
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor for the port the service listens on, valid only after init.

nodes.name: hostName
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor for the host name the service listens on, valid only after init.

nodes.name: uploadBlock
nodes.summary: Abstract method that uploads a single block to a remote node and returns a Future[Unit]; available only after init.

nodes.name: fetchBlockSync
nodes.summary: Blocking special case of fetchBlocks that fetches exactly one block. It registers a BlockFetchingListener completing a Promise: file-segment and encrypted buffers are returned as is, other buffers are copied into a new NioManagedBuffer; then it waits for the result with ThreadUtils.awaitResult.

nodes.name: uploadBlockSync
nodes.summary: Blocking variant of uploadBlock: calls uploadBlock and waits for the returned future to complete (declared to throw IOException).

nodes.name: NettyBlockRpcServer.scala
nodes.summary: Defines NettyBlockRpcServer, the RpcHandler that serves block-related RPCs (open blocks, fetch shuffle blocks, upload block, local dirs, corruption diagnosis) against a BlockDataManager.

nodes.name: NettyBlockRpcServer
nodes.summary: RpcHandler that serves requests to open and upload blocks. For OpenBlocks and FetchShuffleBlocks it registers one transport chunk per requested block with a OneForOneStreamManager and replies with a StreamHandle; it also handles UploadBlock, GetLocalDirsForExecutors and DiagnoseCorruption, and streamed uploads via receiveStream. It is created by NettyBlockTransferService.init for the local BlockDataManager.

nodes.name: receive
nodes.summary: Decodes a BlockTransferMessage (warning on or ignoring corrupted buffers) and dispatches on its type: OpenBlocks and FetchShuffleBlocks fetch local block data and register a stream; UploadBlock stores a block via putBlockData and replies or fails; GetLocalDirsForExecutors validates app and executor ids and returns local dirs; DiagnoseCorruption returns a CorruptionCause.

nodes.name: receiveStream
nodes.summary: Handles an UploadBlockStream header by deserializing its metadata and delegating to putBlockDataAsStream, returning the StreamCallbackWithID that will receive the block bytes.

nodes.name: deserializeMetadata
nodes.summary: Private helper that deserializes the (StorageLevel, ClassTag) metadata sent with an uploaded block using the injected Serializer.

nodes.name: getStreamManager
nodes.summary: Returns the OneForOneStreamManager used to register block streams.

nodes.name: NettyBlockTransferService.scala
nodes.summary: Defines NettyBlockTransferService, the Netty-based BlockTransferService that starts a transport server with NettyBlockRpcServer and fetches or uploads blocks with retries and optional authentication.

nodes.name: NettyBlockTransferService
nodes.summary: Private[spark] BlockTransferService implementation that uses Netty. init builds a TransportConf (via SparkTransportConf), optional auth bootstraps, a TransportContext with a NettyBlockRpcServer, a client factory and a server; fetchBlocks and uploadBlock use that client factory and close releases them. It is constructed with a SparkConf, SecurityManager, SerializerManager, bind address, host name, port, core count and an optional driver endpoint ref.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the service: builds the TransportConf for the shuffle module, creates auth bootstraps when authentication is enabled, creates the TransportContext with a NettyBlockRpcServer, the client factory and the server, records the app id and logs the bound address.

nodes.name: createServer
nodes.summary: Private helper that creates and binds the TransportServer, retrying on other ports through Utils.startServiceOnPort.

nodes.name: shuffleMetrics
nodes.summary: Returns a MetricSet combining the metrics of the client factory and the server; requires the service to be initialized.

nodes.name: fetchBlocks
nodes.summary: Fetches blocks from a remote executor using OneForOneBlockFetcher, wrapped in a RetryingBlockTransferor when maxIORetries > 0. On IOException it asks the driver endpoint whether the executor is still alive and throws ExecutorDeadException if not; any failure at start is reported to the listener for every block id.

nodes.name: uploadBlock
nodes.summary: Uploads a block to a remote node and returns a Future. It serializes the StorageLevel and ClassTag as metadata and sends the block as a stream (UploadBlockStream) for shuffle blocks or blocks larger than the remote-fetch-to-memory limit, otherwise as an UploadBlock RPC.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the server, the client factory and the transport context when they were created.

nodes.name: SparkTransportConf.scala
nodes.summary: Defines SparkTransportConf, a utility that turns a SparkConf into a TransportConf for a given module, thread allocation, role and SSL settings.

nodes.name: SparkTransportConf
nodes.summary: Singleton utility that converts a SparkConf inside a JVM (executor, driver or standalone shuffle service) into a TransportConf reflecting the cores usable by that JVM. Used by NettyBlockTransferService.init to create the transport configuration.

nodes.name: fromSparkConf
nodes.summary: Clones the SparkConf, derives default server and client thread counts from the usable core count, lets role-specific settings override module settings (order role > module > default), builds a ConfigProvider (from the SSL options when given, otherwise from the conf) and returns a TransportConf for the module.

nodes.name: CheckpointRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines CheckpointRDD, the abstract base for RDDs that recover checkpointed data from storage, and its simple CheckpointRDDPartition.

nodes.name: CheckpointRDDPartition
nodes.summary: Private[spark] Partition implementation holding only an index; used for partitions of RDDs that recover checkpointed data.

nodes.name: CheckpointRDD
nodes.summary: Private[spark] abstract RDD (with no dependencies) that recovers checkpointed data from storage. It overrides doCheckpoint, checkpoint and localCheckpoint as no-ops so a checkpoint RDD is never checkpointed again.

nodes.name: DoubleRDDFunctions.scala
nodes.summary: Defines DoubleRDDFunctions, extra numeric operations on RDDs of Doubles (sum, stats, mean, variance, standard deviation, approximate mean and sum, and histograms).

nodes.name: DoubleRDDFunctions
nodes.summary: Class wrapping an RDD[Double] that adds numeric aggregates through an implicit conversion: sum, a one-pass stats StatCounter and the mean, variance and standard deviations derived from it, timeout-bound meanApprox and sumApprox, and histogram computation with evenly spaced or user-provided buckets.

nodes.name: sum
nodes.summary: Adds up the elements with fold(0.0).

nodes.name: stats
nodes.summary: Returns a StatCounter capturing count, mean and variance in one pass: builds a StatCounter per partition with mapPartitions and merges them with reduce.

nodes.name: mean
nodes.summary: Computes the mean of the RDD's elements from stats().

nodes.name: variance
nodes.summary: Computes the population variance from stats().

nodes.name: stdev
nodes.summary: Computes the population standard deviation from stats().

nodes.name: sampleStdev
nodes.summary: Computes the sample standard deviation (divides by N-1) from stats().

nodes.name: sampleVariance
nodes.summary: Computes the sample variance (divides by N-1) from stats().

nodes.name: popStdev
nodes.summary: Computes the population standard deviation from stats(); annotated Since 2.1.0.

nodes.name: popVariance
nodes.summary: Computes the population variance from stats(); annotated Since 2.1.0.

nodes.name: meanApprox
nodes.summary: Approximate mean within a timeout: runs runApproximateJob with per-partition StatCounters and a MeanEvaluator, returning a PartialResult of BoundedDouble at the given confidence (default 0.95).

nodes.name: sumApprox
nodes.summary: Approximate sum within a timeout: runs runApproximateJob with per-partition StatCounters and a SumEvaluator, returning a PartialResult of BoundedDouble at the given confidence (default 0.95).

nodes.name: histogram
nodes.summary: Overloaded histogram. This node covers the (buckets: Array[Double], evenBuckets: Boolean = false) overload, which counts elements into user-provided sorted buckets (open to the right, last closed) using a binary-search bucket function, or an O(1) function when evenBuckets is true, then merges per-partition counters with reduce. The (bucketCount: Int) overload at lines 124-151 computes min and max, builds evenly spaced buckets, throws a SparkCoreErrors error for empty, infinite or NaN data and calls this overload.

nodes.name: EmptyRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines EmptyRDD, an internal RDD with no partitions and no elements. Computing a partition of it raises an error.

nodes.name: EmptyRDD
nodes.summary: RDD subclass with zero partitions (getPartitions returns an empty array) and a compute method that always throws an empty-RDD error.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Always throws the error created by SparkCoreErrors.emptyRDDError, since an empty RDD has no partition to compute.

nodes.name: JdbcRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the deprecated JdbcRDD, which runs a parameterized SQL query over a JDBC connection split into numPartitions ranges of a numeric key, plus its JdbcPartition and a companion with Java-friendly create factories.
nodes.languageNotes: The class is marked deprecated in favour of the JDBC data source. The class and its companion object share one class node id.

nodes.name: JdbcPartition
nodes.summary: Partition holding the inclusive lower and upper bound values bound to the query placeholders for one JdbcRDD partition.

nodes.name: JdbcRDD
nodes.summary: Deprecated RDD that executes a SQL query with two ? placeholders on a JDBC connection and reads results. Partitions are built by splitting the inclusive lowerBound..upperBound range; each task opens a connection, streams rows through mapRow, and closes everything on completion. The companion object (lines 141-229) provides resultSetToObjectArray, the ConnectionFactory trait and create factories.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Splits the inclusive [lowerBound, upperBound] range into numPartitions contiguous sub-ranges and returns one JdbcPartition per range.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Returns a NextIterator that opens a connection, prepares the statement, sets the fetch size (streaming mode for URLs starting with jdbc:mysql:, otherwise 100), binds the partition bounds and executes the query. getNext maps each ResultSet row with mapRow; close releases the result set, statement and connection, and is also registered as a task completion listener.

nodes.name: resultSetToObjectArray
nodes.summary: Default row mapper in the companion object: converts the current ResultSet row into an Array[Object] of its column values.

nodes.name: JdbcRDD.ConnectionFactory
nodes.summary: Serializable trait with a getConnection method, used by the Java-friendly create methods to obtain an open JDBC Connection.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Java-friendly factory that builds a JdbcRDD from a ConnectionFactory and a Java Function row mapper and wraps it in a JavaRDD. An overload (lines 213-228) uses resultSetToObjectArray as the mapper and delegates to this version.

nodes.name: LocalCheckpointRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines LocalCheckpointRDD, a placeholder CheckpointRDD for locally checkpointed RDDs. It exists only to give an informative error if a cached block is lost or the original RDD is unpersisted.

nodes.name: LocalCheckpointRDD
nodes.summary: CheckpointRDD built from a SparkContext, RDD id and partition count (or from an RDD via an auxiliary constructor). It creates one CheckpointRDDPartition per partition and is only computed when the fully cached original RDD is gone.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Throws a checkpoint-block-not-found error naming the RDDBlockId (rddId, partition index) that should have been in block storage.

nodes.name: MapPartitionsWithEvaluatorRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines MapPartitionsWithEvaluatorRDD, an RDD that applies a PartitionEvaluator created from a PartitionEvaluatorFactory to each partition of its parent RDD.

nodes.name: MapPartitionsWithEvaluatorRDD
nodes.summary: RDD with a single parent that reuses the parent partitions. For each partition it creates an evaluator from the factory and evaluates it on the parent iterator; clearDependencies also drops the parent reference.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Creates an evaluator via evaluatorFactory.createEvaluator, obtains the first parent iterator for the split and returns evaluator.eval(split.index, input).

nodes.name: PartitionPruningRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines PartitionPruningRDD and its PruneDependency, which expose only the parent partitions accepted by a filter on partition index so that tasks are not launched on the others.
nodes.languageNotes: The class and its companion object share one class node id.

nodes.name: PartitionPruningRDDPartition
nodes.summary: Partition of a pruned RDD that records the new index and the corresponding parent partition (parentSplit).

nodes.name: PruneDependency
nodes.summary: Narrow dependency that keeps only parent partitions whose index passes partitionFilterFunc and maps each child partition id back to its parent partition index.

nodes.name: getParents
nodes.summary: Returns the single parent partition index for the given pruned partition id by reading its parentSplit.

nodes.name: PartitionPruningRDD
nodes.summary: Developer API RDD for avoiding tasks on partitions that cannot contribute, for example when the key range of a range-partitioned RDD is filtered. Its only dependency is a PruneDependency; compute reads from the parent partition. The companion object (lines 72-82) provides create for use when the element type is not known at compile time.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Delegates to the first parent iterator using the parent partition stored in the pruned partition.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Returns the pruned partitions held by the PruneDependency.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Companion factory that creates a PartitionPruningRDD using the parent RDD element ClassTag.

nodes.name: PartitionerAwareUnionRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the partitioner-aware union RDDs, which combine several RDDs partitioned the same way into one RDD with the same number of partitions, with each output partition reading the matching partition of every parent. Preferred locations are chosen as the most common location of the parent partitions.

nodes.name: PartitionerAwareUnionRDDPartition
nodes.summary: Partition holding, for a given index, the matching partition of every parent RDD. The parent partition array is refreshed in writeObject at task serialization time.

nodes.name: writeObject
nodes.summary: Custom Java serialization hook that recomputes the parent partitions array before the default write, run under Utils.tryOrIOException.

nodes.name: PartitionerAwareUnionRDDBase
nodes.summary: Abstract base RDD with one OneToOneDependency per parent, taking its partitioner from the first RDD. It builds partitions from the partitioner partition count, computes a partition by concatenating the iterators of all parent partitions, and selects preferred locations from the scheduler.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Creates one PartitionerAwareUnionRDDPartition for each partition of the first parent partitioner.

nodes.name: getPreferredLocations
nodes.summary: Collects the current preferred hosts of each parent partition and returns the location preferred by the largest number of parent partitions, or none if there are no locations.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Returns the concatenation of the iterators of every parent RDD for its matching parent partition.

nodes.name: clearDependencies
nodes.summary: Calls the superclass implementation and nulls the parent RDD sequence so it can be garbage collected.

nodes.name: currPrefLocs
nodes.summary: Asks the SparkContext for the current preferred locations of a parent partition and returns their hosts.

nodes.name: PartitionerAwareUnionRDD
nodes.summary: Concrete union that requires every parent RDD to have the same defined partitioner, so m RDDs with p partitions yield one RDD with p partitions and that partitioner.

nodes.name: SQLPartitioningAwareUnionRDD
nodes.summary: Variant that does not check the parents partitioners, relying on the caller to ensure the parents are partitioned in the same way (the source notes SQL shuffle RDDs have no partitioner defined). It takes an explicit numPartitions and validates it against any defined partitioner.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Creates numPartitions union partitions from the explicit partition count rather than from the partitioner.

nodes.name: PartitionwiseSampledRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines PartitionwiseSampledRDD, which samples each partition of its parent with a clone of a user-supplied RandomSampler seeded with a distinct per-partition seed.

nodes.name: PartitionwiseSampledRDDPartition
nodes.summary: Serializable partition that keeps the parent partition and the random seed assigned to it, with the parent index.

nodes.name: PartitionwiseSampledRDD
nodes.summary: RDD that samples each parent partition with a RandomSampler. It optionally keeps the parent partitioner, derives the per-partition seeds from one base seed, reuses the parent preferred locations, and reports an indeterminate output level when the parent order is unordered.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Creates one sampled partition per parent partition, assigning each a seed drawn from a Random created from the base seed.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Clones the sampler, sets the partition seed and applies it to the parent partition iterator.

nodes.name: getOutputDeterministicLevel
nodes.summary: Returns INDETERMINATE when the parent output is UNORDERED, otherwise defers to the superclass level.

nodes.name: PipedRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines PipedRDD, which streams each parent partition as lines into an external command and returns the command output lines, plus a private companion with a command tokenizer and thread name prefixes.
nodes.languageNotes: The class and its private companion object share one class node id.

nodes.name: PipedRDD
nodes.summary: RDD[String] that launches an external process per partition, feeds it the parent elements (optionally through printPipeContext and printRDDElement), and iterates over its stdout. It uses writer and reader threads, can run in a separate per-task working directory, and fails with an IllegalStateException on a non-zero exit status. The companion object (lines 237-250) holds tokenize and the thread name prefixes.

nodes.name: PipedRDD.NotEqualsFileNameFilter
nodes.summary: FilenameFilter that accepts every file name except one given name, used to skip the tasks directory when symlinking files into a task working directory.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Builds a ProcessBuilder with the extra and Hadoop-split environment variables, optionally prepares a task working directory with symlinks, starts the process, and runs a stderr reader thread and a stdin writer thread. A task completion listener destroys the process and interrupts the threads. It returns an iterator over stdout lines that waits for the exit status at the end, cleans up the directory and rethrows any exception from the child threads.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Companion helper that splits a command string into words using a StringTokenizer.

nodes.name: SortedMergeCoalescedRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines an RDD that coalesces partitions while keeping sorted order through a k-way merge, together with its partition class and the priority-queue merge iterator it uses.

nodes.name: SortedMergeCoalescedRDD
nodes.summary: RDD that coalesces the partitions of a parent RDD into a given number of output partitions using a PartitionCoalescer, and merges the grouped parent partitions with a k-way merge so that local ordering is preserved. It is used when the input partitions are already sorted and that ordering must survive coalescing, unlike CoalescedRDD which only concatenates.

nodes.name: SortedMergePartition
nodes.summary: Partition of SortedMergeCoalescedRDD that records which parent partition indices were coalesced into it and an optional preferred location. It re-resolves the parent Partition objects at serialization time through a custom writeObject.

nodes.name: SortedMergeIterator
nodes.summary: Iterator that merges several already-sorted iterators using a min-heap built on a mutable PriorityQueue. It defers advancing the iterator of the last returned element until the next call to next(), so the returned element stays valid even if the underlying reader reuses its buffer.

nodes.name: QueueEntry
nodes.summary: Private case class pairing an element with the iterator it came from, used as the priority queue entry inside SortedMergeIterator.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Asks the PartitionCoalescer to group the parent partitions and wraps each group in a SortedMergePartition holding the parent indices and the preferred location.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Computes one coalesced partition: returns an empty iterator for no parents, the parent iterator unchanged for one parent, and a SortedMergeIterator over all parent iterators otherwise.

nodes.name: getDependencies
nodes.summary: Declares a NarrowDependency on the parent RDD whose getParents maps each output partition to its coalesced parent partition indices.

nodes.name: getPreferredLocations
nodes.summary: Returns the preferred location recorded in the SortedMergePartition as a sequence.

nodes.name: clearDependencies
nodes.summary: Clears the parent reference after calling the superclass implementation so the parent RDD can be released.

nodes.name: writeObject
nodes.summary: Custom Java serialization hook that refreshes the parents field from the parent RDD partitions at task serialization time before writing the default fields.

nodes.name: hasNext
nodes.summary: Returns true when the queue is non-empty or the pending iterator still has elements.

nodes.name: next
nodes.summary: Advances the previously pending iterator into the queue, then dequeues the smallest element and marks its iterator as pending; throws NoSuchElementException when the queue is empty.

nodes.name: SubtractedRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines SubtractedRDD, a cogroup-style RDD specialised for set difference of key-value RDDs: it keeps only the first RDD's entries in memory and streams the second RDD to remove matching keys.

nodes.name: SubtractedRDD
nodes.summary: Optimized variant of cogroup for subtracting one pair RDD from another by key. Only entries from rdd1 are held in a hash map while rdd2 is streamed to remove keys, which helps when rdd1 is much smaller than rdd2; each parent gets a one-to-one dependency if it already uses the target partitioner, otherwise a shuffle dependency.

nodes.name: getDependencies
nodes.summary: Builds one dependency per parent: OneToOneDependency when the parent's partitioner equals the given partitioner, otherwise a ShuffleDependency with that partitioner.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Creates one CoGroupPartition per output partition; narrow parents get a NarrowCoGroupSplitDep while shuffled parents get None.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Reads rdd1 into a hash map of key to buffered values, then reads rdd2 (through the narrow dependency or a shuffle reader from the shuffle manager) and removes each of its keys, finally iterating the remaining entries.

nodes.name: clearDependencies
nodes.summary: Clears the references to rdd1 and rdd2 after calling the superclass implementation.

nodes.name: ZippedPartitionsWithEvaluatorRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines ZippedPartitionsWithEvaluatorRDD, which zips the partitions of two RDDs and processes each pair through a PartitionEvaluator created from a factory.

nodes.name: ZippedPartitionsWithEvaluatorRDD
nodes.summary: RDD that zips the partitions of two parent RDDs of the same element type and, for each zipped partition, creates an evaluator from a PartitionEvaluatorFactory and lets it produce the output iterator from the two parent iterators. It extends ZippedPartitionsBaseRDD for partition pairing and preferred locations.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Creates an evaluator from the factory, fetches the zipped parent partitions and calls eval with the partition index and the iterators of rdd1 and rdd2.

nodes.name: ZippedWithIndexRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines ZippedWithIndexRDD and its partition class, which pair each element of an RDD with a global index ordered first by partition index and then by position within the partition.

nodes.name: ZippedWithIndexRDDPartition
nodes.summary: Partition wrapper that holds the parent partition and the global start index of its first element; its index is the parent's index.

nodes.name: ZippedWithIndexRDD
nodes.summary: RDD that zips a parent RDD with element indices: the first item of the first partition gets 0 and the last item of the last partition gets the largest index. At construction it computes the start index of every partition by running a job that counts all partitions except the last, using an ancestor that is known to keep partition sizes when possible.

nodes.name: getAncestorWithSamePartitionSizes
nodes.summary: Walks up through MapPartitionsRDD and MapPartitionsWithEvaluatorRDD parents that preserve partition sizes, stopping at a checkpointed or persisted RDD or any other RDD, so the counting job can run on a cheaper ancestor.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Wraps each parent partition in a ZippedWithIndexRDDPartition with its precomputed start index.

nodes.name: getPreferredLocations
nodes.summary: Delegates to the parent RDD's preferred locations for the wrapped parent partition.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Gets the parent iterator for the wrapped partition and zips it with indices starting at the partition's start index via Utils.getIteratorZipWithIndex.

nodes.name: coalesce-public.scala
nodes.summary: Public developer API for customizing RDD coalescing: the PartitionCoalescer trait and the PartitionGroup class that holds a group of partitions with a preferred location.

nodes.name: PartitionCoalescer
nodes.summary: DeveloperApi trait that defines how the partitions of a given RDD are coalesced: coalesce takes the maximum number of partitions and the parent RDD and returns an array of PartitionGroups, each representing one coalesced partition.

nodes.name: PartitionGroup
nodes.summary: DeveloperApi class representing a group of Partitions with an optional preferred location; it exposes the buffer of partitions and their count.

nodes.name: coalesce
nodes.summary: Abstract method that coalesces the partitions of the parent RDD into at most maxPartitions groups and returns them as an array of PartitionGroup.

nodes.name: PeriodicRDDCheckpointer.scala
nodes.summary: Defines PeriodicRDDCheckpointer, which persists RDDs, unpersists old ones and checkpoints at a fixed interval while removing older checkpoint files.

nodes.name: PeriodicRDDCheckpointer
nodes.summary: RDD specialization of PeriodicCheckpointer. After update() is called with each newly created RDD it persists it, keeps at most three persisted RDDs, and checkpoints the new RDD when the checkpoint interval is reached, deleting older checkpoint files. It requires a storage level other than NONE and defaults to MEMORY_ONLY.

nodes.name: checkpoint
nodes.summary: Checkpoints the given RDD by calling its checkpoint method.

nodes.name: isCheckpointed
nodes.summary: Reports whether the given RDD is checkpointed.

nodes.name: persist
nodes.summary: Persists the RDD at the configured storage level only if it is not already persisted.

nodes.name: unpersist
nodes.summary: Unpersists the given RDD.

nodes.name: getCheckpointFiles
nodes.summary: Returns the checkpoint file of the RDD, if any, as an iterable of paths.

nodes.name: InputFileBlockHolder.scala
nodes.summary: Holds the file name, start offset and length of the input block currently being read by a Spark task, in an inheritable thread local, for use by input file readers and the input file name function.

nodes.name: InputFileBlockHolder
nodes.summary: Singleton object that stores the current task's input file path, block start offset and block length in an InheritableThreadLocal wrapping an AtomicReference, so a write in a child thread is visible to the parent thread. The source says it is used by HadoopRDD, FileScanRDD, NewHadoopRDD and the InputFileName function in Spark SQL.

nodes.name: FileBlock
nodes.summary: Private wrapper around the input file information: file path as UTF8String, start offset and length, with an auxiliary constructor giving empty path and -1 values.

nodes.name: setThreadLocalValue
nodes.summary: Replaces the thread-local atomic reference with the one passed in, so another thread can share the same holder.

nodes.name: getThreadLocalValue
nodes.summary: Returns the current thread-local atomic reference as an Object so it can be handed to another thread.

nodes.name: getInputFilePath
nodes.summary: Returns the current file path, or an empty string if unknown.

nodes.name: getStartOffset
nodes.summary: Returns the starting offset of the block being read, or -1 if unknown.

nodes.name: getLength
nodes.summary: Returns the length of the block being read, or -1 if unknown.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Validates the arguments and sets the thread-local input block; callers must register a task completion listener that calls unset.

nodes.name: unset
nodes.summary: Removes the thread-local value, restoring the default empty block.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Forces creation of the thread-local value in the calling (parent) thread by reading it.

nodes.name: SequenceFileRDDFunctions.scala
nodes.summary: Provides saveAsSequenceFile for RDDs of key-value pairs through an implicit conversion, mapping keys and values to Hadoop Writable types as needed.

nodes.name: SequenceFileRDDFunctions
nodes.summary: Extra functions on RDDs of (key, value) pairs for writing a Hadoop SequenceFile, available through an implicit conversion. It is kept separate from PairRDDFunctions because it needs additional implicit parameters to convert keys and values to Writable.

nodes.name: saveAsSequenceFile
nodes.summary: Saves the RDD as a SequenceFile using Writable classes inferred from the key and value types, mapping values and/or keys to Writable only when their classes differ from the expected Writable classes, then delegates to saveAsHadoopFile with SequenceFileOutputFormat and an optional compression codec.

nodes.name: WholeTextFileRDD.scala
nodes.summary: Defines WholeTextFileRDD, an RDD in which each whole text file becomes a single (path, content) record.

nodes.name: WholeTextFileRDD
nodes.summary: NewHadoopRDD subclass that reads a set of text files and turns each file into one record of Text key and Text value. It uses WholeTextFileInputFormat and a minimum number of partitions to compute its splits.

nodes.name: getPartitions
nodes.summary: Sets the list-status thread count if unset, instantiates the input format (applying the configuration if it is Configurable), sets the minimum partitions, gets the splits and wraps each in a NewHadoopPartition.

nodes.name: package.scala
nodes.summary: Package object for org.apache.spark.rdd. It defines the type alias IsWritable[A] as a function from A to a Hadoop Writable and carries the package documentation that points to the RDD class.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala package object holding a type alias; it declares no classes or methods.

nodes.name: RDDOperationScope.scala
nodes.summary: Defines RDDOperationScope, a named, optionally nested code block that all RDDs created inside it point to, and its companion helpers that set and restore the scope stored as a JSON local property on the SparkContext. Used by RDD operations to label the operations that created an RDD.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala class with a companion object; the scope is serialized with a Jackson ObjectMapper using the Scala module.

nodes.name: RDDOperationScope
nodes.summary: A named code block representing an operation that instantiates RDDs, with an optional parent scope and an id. Instances serialize to and from JSON, and the companion object provides withScope helpers that install a scope for a body of code and restore the previous scope afterwards.
nodes.languageNotes: Class with Jackson annotations; the companion object extends Logging and keeps a global AtomicInteger scope counter.

nodes.name: toJson
nodes.summary: Serializes this scope to a JSON string using the shared object mapper; toString delegates to it.

nodes.name: getAllScopes
nodes.summary: Returns the chain of scopes this scope belongs to, ordered from the outermost ancestor to this scope itself.

nodes.name: fromJson
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON string back into an RDDOperationScope with the shared object mapper.

nodes.name: nextScopeId
nodes.summary: Returns a globally unique scope id from an atomic counter.

nodes.name: withScope
nodes.summary: Runs a body so that all RDDs created in it share one scope. Three overloads exist: the first derives the scope name from the caller's method name in the stack trace, the second generates a scope id, and the widest one (this node) takes an explicit scope id, saves the old scope and no-override properties on the SparkContext, installs the new scope and restores the old state in a finally block. Nesting and ignoring the parent scope are controlled by flags.

nodes.name: JobExecutionStatus.java
nodes.summary: Java enum listing the execution states of a job (RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, UNKNOWN) with a case-insensitive fromString parser.
nodes.languageNotes: Public Java enum whose parser delegates to EnumUtil.parseIgnoreCase.

nodes.name: JobExecutionStatus
nodes.summary: Public enum of job execution states: RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED and UNKNOWN. Its static fromString method converts a string to a constant ignoring case.

nodes.name: fromString
nodes.summary: Parses a string into a JobExecutionStatus constant, ignoring case, by delegating to EnumUtil.parseIgnoreCase.

nodes.name: SparkExecutorInfo.java
nodes.summary: Declares the SparkExecutorInfo interface, a serializable read-only view of an executor exposing host, port, cache size, running task count and on-heap and off-heap storage memory figures.
nodes.languageNotes: Java interface of accessor-style methods; the source warns it is not designed to be implemented outside of Spark.

nodes.name: SparkExecutorInfo
nodes.summary: Serializable interface that exposes information about Spark executors: host, port, cacheSize, numRunningTasks, and used and total on-heap and off-heap storage memory. The documentation says it is not designed to be implemented outside of Spark because methods may be added.

nodes.name: SparkFirehoseListener.java
nodes.summary: Java class that forwards every SparkListener callback to one onEvent method so users can receive all listener events by overriding a single method. It is written in Java so that a new SparkListener method causes a compilation error until it is added here.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Scala listener interface in Java; most overrides are final one-line forwarders to onEvent.

nodes.name: SparkFirehoseListener
nodes.summary: Implements SparkListenerInterface and routes each event callback (stage, task, job, environment, block manager, executor, node, exclusion, resource profile and other events) to the single overridable onEvent method. Users extend it and override onEvent to receive all SparkListener events.
nodes.languageNotes: Most handlers are final; a few (for example onBlockUpdated and onOtherEvent) are left overridable. The many one-line forwarding methods are not given separate nodes.

nodes.name: onEvent
nodes.summary: Empty extension point that every other callback in the class calls with its event; subclasses override it to handle all listener events.

nodes.name: package.scala
nodes.summary: Declares the package object for org.apache.spark, whose scaladoc is the top-level overview of the core package. It exposes version and build metadata constants (version, short version, branch, revision, build user, repo URL, build date, doc root) read from SparkBuildInfo.

nodes.name: spark
nodes.summary: Package object for org.apache.spark holding eight public vals that expose build information: SPARK_VERSION, SPARK_VERSION_SHORT (computed with VersionUtils.shortVersion), SPARK_BRANCH, SPARK_REVISION, SPARK_BUILD_USER, SPARK_REPO_URL, SPARK_BUILD_DATE and SPARK_DOC_ROOT.

nodes.name: Aggregator.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the Aggregator case class, a developer API bundle of createCombiner, mergeValue and mergeCombiners functions used to aggregate values by key through an external append-only map, updating spill and peak memory task metrics afterwards.

nodes.name: Aggregator
nodes.summary: Case class holding the three aggregation functions (createCombiner, mergeValue, mergeCombiners) with type parameters K, V and C. It builds ExternalAppendOnlyMap instances to combine raw values or already-combined values by key, then records memory and disk spill and peak execution memory on the task metrics of the given TaskContext.

nodes.name: combineValuesByKey
nodes.summary: Creates an ExternalAppendOnlyMap from the three functions, inserts all key-value pairs from the iterator, updates task metrics and returns an iterator of (key, combiner) pairs.

nodes.name: combineCombinersByKey
nodes.summary: Like combineValuesByKey but for input that is already combined: uses identity as the create function and mergeCombiners for merging, updates task metrics and returns the merged (key, combiner) iterator.

nodes.name: updateMetrics
nodes.summary: Private helper that, when the TaskContext is not null, adds the map's memory bytes spilled, disk bytes spilled and peak memory used to the task metrics.

nodes.name: BarrierCoordinator.scala
nodes.summary: Driver-side coordination for barrier stages: an RPC endpoint that collects barrier() and allGather() sync requests from BarrierTaskContext, replies to all tasks once every task has sent a request, and fails them on timeout or mismatched sync types. Also defines the request message, the request method enumeration and the per-stage-attempt id.

nodes.name: ContextBarrierId
nodes.summary: Private case class identifying a barrier stage attempt by stageId and stageAttemptId, with a toString of the form 'Stage N (Attempt M)'. Used as the key of the coordinator's state map.

nodes.name: BarrierCoordinator
nodes.summary: RPC endpoint (ThreadSafeRpcEndpoint) that handles global sync requests from BarrierTaskContext. It keeps one ContextBarrierState per active stage attempt, listens for stage completion to clean those states, schedules timeout tasks, and replies to every blocked task with the collected messages once all requests arrive.

nodes.name: ContextBarrierState
nodes.summary: Private inner class holding the state of barrier() calls for one stage attempt: the barrier epoch, pending RpcCallContext requesters, per-partition messages, the set of request methods and a timeout task. A state is created on the first barrier() call of a stage attempt and recycled when the stage completes.

nodes.name: BarrierCoordinatorMessage
nodes.summary: Private[spark] sealed serializable trait that is the parent type of messages sent to the BarrierCoordinator.

nodes.name: RequestToSync
nodes.summary: Case class message from a BarrierTaskContext to the BarrierCoordinator carrying numTasks, stageId, stageAttemptId, taskAttemptId, barrierEpoch, partitionId, a string message and the RequestMethod that triggered the sync.

nodes.name: RequestMethod
nodes.summary: Enumeration with the values BARRIER and ALL_GATHER, naming the BarrierTaskContext method that triggered a sync request.

nodes.name: onStart
nodes.summary: Calls super.onStart and registers the stage-completed listener on the listener bus status queue.

nodes.name: onStop
nodes.summary: Clears all barrier states, removes the listener from the listener bus, cancels pending timer futures, shuts down the timer executor and calls super.onStop.

nodes.name: cleanupBarrierStage
nodes.summary: Removes the ContextBarrierState for a stage attempt from the states map and clears it if present.

nodes.name: receiveAndReply
nodes.summary: Handles RequestToSync messages: gets or creates the ContextBarrierState for the stage attempt and hands the request and RpcCallContext to its handleRequest.

nodes.name: initTimerTask
nodes.summary: Creates the TimerTask that, on timeout, sends a SparkException failure to every pending requester and cleans up the barrier stage.

nodes.name: cancelTimerTask
nodes.summary: Cancels all scheduled timeout futures and clears the future list.

nodes.name: handleRequest
nodes.summary: Processes one sync request under the state lock: fails all requesters if different request methods are mixed, validates the task count and barrier epoch, starts the timeout on the first request, records the requester and message, and replies to all with the collected messages when every task has reported, then advances the epoch.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Resets the state after a failure or stage completion: sets the epoch to -1, clears the requesters and cancels the timeout task.

nodes.name: BarrierTaskContext.scala
nodes.summary: Defines BarrierTaskContext, the experimental TaskContext used by tasks in a barrier stage, with barrier(), allGather() and getTaskInfos(), plus its companion object that returns the active context. Barrier calls send RequestToSync messages to the driver-side coordinator and block until all tasks reply.

nodes.name: BarrierTaskContext
nodes.summary: Experimental TaskContext (since 2.4.0) that wraps a given TaskContext, delegating most methods to it, and adds barrier(), allGather() and getTaskInfos() for tasks in a barrier stage. It resolves the driver-side 'barrierSync' endpoint, tracks a local barrier epoch, and logs waiting progress every minute. The companion object (lines 302-319) provides get() and a daemon timer used for those logs.
nodes.languageNotes: Class and companion object share one node; the many one-line delegate overrides to the wrapped TaskContext are not given their own nodes.

nodes.name: logProgressInfo
nodes.summary: Logs a task progress message with task attempt id, stage id and attempt, optionally the waited time, and the current barrier epoch.

nodes.name: runBarrier
nodes.summary: Core sync routine: logs entry, schedules a once-per-minute progress log, sends a RequestToSync via askAbortable with a 365 day timeout, polls every second and aborts the future if the task was killed, then increments the epoch and returns the messages from all tasks.

nodes.name: barrier
nodes.summary: Public experimental API that sets a global barrier and blocks until all tasks in the stage have reached it; calls runBarrier with an empty message and RequestMethod.BARRIER. Its scaladoc warns that every task must make the same number of barrier() calls.

nodes.name: allGather
nodes.summary: Public experimental API (since 3.0.0) that blocks until all tasks in the stage reach it and returns the array of messages passed in by every task; calls runBarrier with RequestMethod.ALL_GATHER.

nodes.name: getTaskInfos
nodes.summary: Returns a BarrierTaskInfo for every task in the barrier stage by splitting the 'addresses' local property on commas.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Companion object method returning the currently active BarrierTaskContext by casting TaskContext.get(); usable inside user functions of a barrier stage.

nodes.name: BarrierTaskInfo.scala
nodes.summary: Defines BarrierTaskInfo, an experimental class that carries the executor address of a barrier task. Instances are returned by BarrierTaskContext.getTaskInfos.

nodes.name: BarrierTaskInfo
nodes.summary: Experimental class (since 2.4.0) with a single public val address, the IPv4 host:port address of the executor a barrier task runs on. Its constructor is private[spark].

nodes.name: ContextAwareIterator.scala
nodes.summary: Defines ContextAwareIterator, a deprecated developer API iterator wrapper that stops yielding elements once the task has completed or been interrupted.

nodes.name: ContextAwareIterator
nodes.summary: Deprecated (since 4.0.0) DeveloperApi Iterator that wraps a delegate iterator together with a TaskContext. Per its scaladoc it exists so that consuming a parent iterator in another thread stops after the task ends, avoiding access to a closed parent that may use off-heap memory.

nodes.name: hasNext
nodes.summary: Returns true only if the task context is neither completed nor interrupted and the delegate iterator has a next element.

nodes.name: next
nodes.summary: Returns the next element from the delegate iterator.

nodes.name: ContextCleaner.scala
nodes.summary: Implements the ContextCleaner, an asynchronous cleaner that tracks RDDs, shuffle dependencies, broadcasts, accumulators, checkpoint data and Spark listeners with weak references and cleans their state in a daemon thread once they are garbage collected. Also defines the cleanup task case classes and the CleanerListener callback trait.

nodes.name: CleanupTask
nodes.summary: Private sealed trait that is the parent of the cleanup task case classes processed by the ContextCleaner.

nodes.name: CleanRDD
nodes.summary: Private case class cleanup task carrying an RDD id.

nodes.name: CleanShuffle
nodes.summary: Private case class cleanup task carrying a shuffle id.

nodes.name: CleanBroadcast
nodes.summary: Private case class cleanup task carrying a broadcast id.

nodes.name: CleanAccum
nodes.summary: Private case class cleanup task carrying an accumulator id.

nodes.name: CleanCheckpoint
nodes.summary: Private case class cleanup task carrying the id of an RDD whose reliable checkpoint data should be removed.

nodes.name: CleanSparkListener
nodes.summary: Private case class cleanup task carrying a SparkListener to be removed from the listener bus.

nodes.name: CleanupTaskWeakReference
nodes.summary: Private WeakReference subclass that carries a CleanupTask. When the referent becomes only weakly reachable the reference is added to the given reference queue, which the cleaning thread reads.

nodes.name: ContextCleaner
nodes.summary: Private[spark] asynchronous cleaner created with a SparkContext and ShuffleDriverComponents. It registers weak references for RDDs, accumulators, shuffle dependencies, broadcasts, RDD checkpoint data and listener owners, runs a daemon cleaning thread that handles queued references (blocking behaviour set by config), and triggers a periodic System.gc() so cleanup happens even with little driver memory pressure. The companion object (lines 311-313) holds the 100 ms reference queue poll timeout.
nodes.languageNotes: Class and private companion object share one node.

nodes.name: CleanerListener
nodes.summary: Private[spark] trait of callbacks (rddCleaned, shuffleCleaned, broadcastCleaned, accumCleaned, checkpointCleaned) invoked by the ContextCleaner after each kind of item has been cleaned.

nodes.name: attachListener
nodes.summary: Adds a CleanerListener to the queue of listeners notified when objects are cleaned.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts the daemon cleaning thread named 'Spark Context Cleaner' and schedules a periodic System.gc() at the configured interval.

nodes.name: stop
